HeadHunters_Patrol_Pyro_Hard.description:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there? 

The route starts at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to <EM4>bring a friend</EM4> to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutposts_Eliminate.description:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.

Ling_Pyro_Medium_RecoverCargo.description:
Hi,

Got a relatively straightforward one for you if you're interested.

One of our pilot ignored a maintenance warning and sure enough, a couple of hours later their ship broke down over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. They're on their way back to the office now but we could do with a reliable hauler whose got a ship big enough to transport <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> to complete the haul for us.

Think you could help us out? You just need to pick up the stranded shipment and deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.  And I probably don't have to say this, but a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> would probably be handy to have along.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_HH_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

One of the folks over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> just hit me up about a pile of cargo, <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>  

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti_Interstellar_Bul.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Red Wind needs an experienced pilot to transport a large shipment of raw revenant tree pollen from <EM4>Jackson's Swap</EM4> to these locations:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>CRU-L4 Shallow Fields Station</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>CRU-L5 Beautiful Glen Station</EM4>

This might seems self-evident, but the rep from CFP asked us to assure you that it's okay under UEE law to transport revenant tree pollen as long as it hasn't been processed. 

Be sure that your ship can carry up to <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4> before you accept the contract. And buy a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> if you don't have one already to make loading and unloading as painless as possible.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_VH_LastDitch_BombingRunS.description:
When will people learn that they can't just do whatever they feel like on Headhunter turf? These idiots are planning a big job and thought that I'd just let them get away with it? No way in hell.

I want you to fly to Last Ditch and destroy their fuel tanks and data servers. Show them what the Headhunters really think of them.

Let's see them try to pull off anything after that.

-Stows out

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_TradepostToOutpost_3box.description:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

There’s a few boxes waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that need to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Can you get those supplies to the outpost for us? This might be a simple supply run, but doing these consistently only strengthens our position in the system. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_H_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
One of the local Judges has been trying to get info on some of new gangs in the area. You know, see if anyone's got eyes on what we got. That kinda thing. Anyway, we sent [TargetName] undercover to try and suss out if anyone's getting bright ideas to try and make a move.

Anyway, [TargetName|First] was heading to [Location|Address] to make a deal with some local grunts or whatever but we haven't heard back. Judge is afraid [TargetName|Last] might've been sniffed then snuffed, so we want you to head there and see what's what.

Go find what happened to [TargetName|Last] and get our cargo back. Odds are you'll need to shwack anyone you come across because if [TargetName|Last] is dead, these assholes killed a Headhunter.

Once you get the cargo, drop it off at [Destination|Address] and get a nice little payday.

Stows out.

UnafilliatedCFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_3Asteroid.description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat. 

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting. 

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.  

Interested?

57 65 65 76 69 6c

Headhunters_BombingRun_Stanton_VE.description:
Headhunters didn't get to be what it is today by playing nice. We've tracked down the hideout of a bunch of scraggy upstarts that have been making inroads into our territory. Need you to send a message.

Head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and blow the crap out of their fuel tanks. They'll think twice about muscling in on our operations when their ships are grounded.

-Stows out

HH_Pyro_RegionD_XTOutpost_EliminateAll.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from [Location|Address]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_XTOutpost_MissingPer.description:
Unfortunately, one of our community partners, [TargetName], has been missing for a few days. Their family contacted Citizens for Prosperity for help and I told them we would do what we could. That said, with so much time passed, I’m not too hopeful.

Whatever their current state is, we're looking for someone to be our eyes on the ground for this one. There’s a strong chance that they were headed to [Location|Address], an area known to be very dangerous.

If you can track them down and confirm their status, one way or another, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_HHOutpost_MissingPers.description:
One of our people, [TargetName], was supposed to be doing some preliminary scouting work over at The Golden Riviera, but they never reported in. We’re hoping that they just ran into some bad luck, but too often out here even the smallest misstep can prove fatal.

I’d appreciate someone heading that way and seeing if they can be located. It’d be great if you find them alive, but if not, some closure is the least we can do for their family.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_RegionD_HH_RuinTo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

FoxwellEnforcement_Patrol_Pyro_VeryHard.description:
A client needs our help. Outlaws are roaming certain sectors where they do business and attacking anyone they come across. Our client has already lost several ships and can’t afford to lose anymore. 

We need someone to patrol those areas and draw out any hostile forces. The job begins with you heading to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scanning. Then we’ll share a handful of other patrol points for you to scan. 

From the sound of it, these packs of ships feature skilled and aggressive pilots. Best be ready to rumble if you run into any of them. Would be good to have at least <EM4>two trusted pilots</EM4> by your side for this one.

At the end of a successful patrol, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>

Stay chilly,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_Stanton_OrgansMeds.description:
Hiya,

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.

As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Refueling_Multi_Pyro_Moderate.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FuelType]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

HH_Pyro_RegionD_OutpostToStation_1box_Si.description:
Looking for someone to hand deliver a cargo crate. The package has got to go from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>the entrance inside Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>. 

Be fast and discreet about it, ok?  A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CrimBase_MRT_MultiDefen.description:
It appears that we've lost contact with a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity ships at [Location|Address] after they reported being attacked in their last comm. 

We believe they will be able to hold off the perpetrators until help arrives, but not indefinitely. We need you to rush to their coordinates and deal with the outlaws before its too late.

Unfortunately, we cannot afford even for a single of these vessels to be lost. As such, this contract will only be considered complete if all ships survive the onslaught. 

Can you help us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionD_VHRT_CitizensForProsperi.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TargetName] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TargetName|Last] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [Location|Address], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_KillShip.description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near [Location|Address]. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutposts_Theft.description:
We’ve been watching Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] for a while. Felt like a primo XenoThreat spot to hit, since there are fewer guards around protecting the goods, but didn’t want to kick down the door until we knew something worthwhile was inside. Well, that glorious day has come.   

Got word that the latest delivery left [Item] there. We want to get our hands on it, so are looking for someone who can swipe it and then bring it to [Destination|Address]. Sure the forces there won’t make it easy for you, but do this right and try to get out before anyone from the main outpost knows what’s going on.    

- Stows

HeadHunters_Nyx_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
Looking for a hauler to pick up some cargo for me. Thing is, there’s a catch.

The cargo’s in the back of an abandoned ship located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. As you may have figured, this ain’t our cargo, but it sure as hell doesn’t deserve to go to anyone else. I’ll be damned if those CFP assholes get their hands on it before we do.

Be lucky as hell if we were the first to know about this, but I’d wager there’s gonna be more ships swarming around there than flies on a kopion carcass. If you got some pals you can trust, bring them along and ghost those assholes. And don’t forget your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> of course.

You manage to get that cargo and bring it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>, I can get you a nice cut of the sale.

Stows out.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_FPSMine_Stanton_Rank.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on <EM4>Daymar and Aberdeen</EM4>. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

BHG_Rockcracker_Zone2_EliminateSpecific.description:

--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TargetName] 
SYSTEM: Nyx
RISK ASSESSMENT: Medium
LAST KNOWN LOCATION:  [Location|Address]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: Claw Salamanders
NOTES: These old, abandoned QV Breaker Stations should be approached with caution. Not only are they are in a state of significant disrepair, but they are frequently inhabited by dangerous fauna and outlaws, like the target's associate gang members.


BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

IDS_RecoverEncryptedData.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.

The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we <EM4>update our intel.</EM4>

We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old <EM4>QV Logistics station.</EM4>

The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the <EM4>encrypted data</EM4> and use the <EM4>decryption key</EM4> to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.

Good luck. We’ll be in touch.


Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

EckhartSecurity_ShipAmbush_Pyro_Intro.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’re looking for contractors with combat experience who are willing to get their hands dirty so to speak. A client of ours was double-crossed by a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and we’ve been waiting for an opportunity to deal with the issue. After tracking them for several weeks, we’ve identified <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> as the ideal spot to intercept them. It features an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting for the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>.

Intel suggests that they may travel with an escort. If they do, you’ll have to deal with them too. Since this is your first contract, we will have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. There’s a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> in this for the main contractor too.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_XTBase_Rank3_ChainMissin.description:
Those XenoThreat assholes ambushed one of our outposts. We eventually kicked their ass out of there but once the cowards knew they'd been beat, they took [TargetName] hostage as a Human shield. We let 'em go, because we don't betray our own like that, but we're not planning on letting this stand. 

Word is that they fled to their base at [Location|Address]. We need someone to break in, find [TargetName|Last], and relay the info back to me. There's a lot of creds in it for you if you do the job right. 

Keep in mind this isn't their only outpost in the system. If they give you the slip, you may need to track them to another sector. 

Stows out.

Adagio_RG_ShipSalvage_Stanton_Rank2_RMC_.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>.  We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

HeadHunters_DefendShip_Stanton_Super.description:
Got ourselves in a real mess here. A Headhunters ship on an important mission got attacked near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Can’t get too into the specifics but it’s absolutely vital that they survive. The People’s Alliance know this too because they’re throwing everything they can at ‘em.

Not gonna pull any punches. This is a serious-ass situation that many wouldn’t survive. If you do, I’ll sing your praises and make sure you’re paid well.   

-Stows

RedWind_Stanton_VeryHard_RecoverCargo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Putting out a call for a highly skilled pilot who can recover our client’s cargo. Please only accept this contract if you have experience dealing with extremely hostile situations involving multiple combatants. Additional crew members and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> are highly recommended.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

The cargo should be in the bay of the abandoned ship. The client has already expressed frustration regarding the cargo’s delay so please work quickly and efficiently.

BE RESILIENT – Life is hard and sometimes you have to roll with the punches. Keep going and don’t let it bring you down.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_CFP_Outp.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

One of the folks over at <EM4>Bueno Ravine</EM4> just hit me up about a pile of cargo, <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>  

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_Stage1_RegionLink_ToRegi.description:
Not sure what happened, but a ship moving some important supplies across the system disappeared around [Location|Address]. Our crew at The Golden Riviera really needs that cargo for an upcoming operation. Any chance you could go looking for the ship and help complete the delivery?

Have no idea what happened, but my bet’s that they got ghosted. Maybe it’s just me, but I’d rather be a prepared pessimist and an ill-equipped optimist. 

- Stows

HeadHunters_DefendDestructibleEntities_S.description:
Some morons with some seriously inflated notion of their place in 'verse made the damn foolish choice of attacking the <EM>Fuel Tanks</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. We've got some things in play over there so we can’t let ‘em get away with it.

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionC_CFP_Trad.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Sacren's Plot</EM4> to <EM4>Chawla's Beach</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P2M2-Stanton4.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
We were able to pull some very interesting data from what you delivered, but we still don’t have a clear enough picture. What we did concretely learn though is that the Onyx security monitoring system is still operational. The data from there is going to be your next target.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Security data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

CFP_Pyro3_Sml_Trdpst_Local_3boxes_Single.description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_OccuCave_YangsPlace_M.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near The cave can only be accessed on foot. which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Su.description:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack. 

Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the [AmbushTarget] is aggressive and battle hardened.        

You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> in it for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

EckhartSecurity_ShipAmbush_Nyx_VeryHard.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>, who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.  
  
Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimin.description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_ShepherdsRest_FPSSalv.description:
Hi,

A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at Shepherd's Rest, they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Adagio_RG_FPSSalvage_Stanton_S1Component.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and components by stripping abandoned ships and removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. 

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, even with the amount of ships buzzing through a system as populated as Stanton, so don't be surprised if you have to put a bit more effort into hunting down what's needed.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_CFPXSOutposts_BombingR.description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

DeadSaints_Nyx_Medium_RecoverCargo.description:
You got a ship and <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>? Good. I’ve got work for you.

Don’t know how they knew we were coming, but one of my haulers got jumped over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. The pilot’s gone silent so I assume they’ve been ghosted, but the cargo tracker is stationary for now.

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Pyro_unla.description:

LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

DeadSaints_Nyx_Super_RecoverCargo.description:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.

Head there with a crew of your own and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.

Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.

-Twitch

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_To_RegionC_RegionLink_5.description:
Hi,

It’s incredible how many Citizens for Prosperity locations have started to thrive throughout the system. To sustain these locations, we need to be able to move important supplies between them. Got one such important run here, if you’re interested.  

There’s a few boxes of goods waiting at <EM4>Jackson's Swap</EM4> that need to cross the system to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Could you move them for us and help us all build a better future?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

UnafilliatedHH_Pyro_RegionD_E_1AsteroidB.description:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves? 

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

Citizens for Prosperity

If you happen to be in the area, please read this.

Looking for a hauler to pick up some cargo for me. Thing is, there’s a catch.

The cargo’s in the back of an abandoned ship located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. As you may have figured, this ain’t our cargo, but it sure as hell doesn’t deserve to go to anyone else. I’ll be damned if those CFP assholes get their hands on it before we do.

Be lucky as hell if we were the first to know about this, but I’d wager there’s gonna be more ships swarming around there than flies on a kopion carcass. If you got some pals you can trust, bring them along and ghost those assholes. And don’t forget your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> of course.

You manage to get that cargo and bring it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>, I can get you a nice cut of the sale.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
One of our people is currently under attack at [Location|Address]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away. 

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionD_CFPOutpost_StoleGoods.description:
Our crew at [Destination|Address] is running low on [Item]. Want to get them restocked, and know that the CFP outpost at Canard View has some lying around. Wanna go there and grab it for us?

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_3AsteroidBase_XenoThr.description:
Hey, 

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. [TargetName] stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near [Location|Address], which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of [TargetName] but also the cargo, which is really needed at [Destination|Address]. Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [Location|Address].

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available security operatives to retake several former CFP installations near [Location|Address] from Headhunter control. These clusters were violently taken from us by [TargetName] and resulted in the deaths of many volunteers.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_TradepostToOutpost_5boxe.description:

Package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPXSOutpost_StoleGoods.description:
Been looking for [Item], and one of our people inside CFP let me know some was just delivered to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Should only be a few soft CFP guards around for you to deal with. Then grab the shit and bring it to [Destination|Address].

Stows out.

There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [Location|Address] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TargetName] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

----------------------------

A Red Wind hauler has been ambushed by some outlaws and now our clients’ cargo is sitting still whilst they prepare to steal it. We need a pilot with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a combat ready ship to head to the location below and recover the cargo before it’s gone for good.

     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

GillysPilotSchool_Mission03.description:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.   

The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.      

Whenever you’re ready, head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to get started.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.

-Stows out

We've received disturbing news: [TargetName], the scout that was reported missing last week has been seen in Headhunter custody. According to the witness, they were spotted being loaded into a transport headed to [Location|Address] this time yesterday.

Citizens for Prosperity

We’ve noted an increase in traffic along one of the travel lanes we monitor. Chances are that we won’t be the only ones paying attention. I’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and make sure there are no outlaws attempting to take advantage of this sense of security.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>


Lima Endicott

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_VH_3AsteroidBase_XhenoT.description:
A local courier who has been working for Citizen for Prosperity, [TargetName], was reported missing earlier this week. We believe that they may have been captured by members of XenoThreat who were after the encrypted data-drives and important cargo they were transporting for us.  

We would like you to go to [Location|Address] to ascertain what has happened to [TargetName|First], destroy any servers which may be housing the stolen data,  and deliver the recovered cargo to [Destination|Address].

It's a lot to ask, but I believe you're up to the challenge.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [Location|Address] and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_HHOutpost_RetrieveGoods.description:
Hey,

I’ve been hustling to track down what happened to a bunch of important supplies stolen from a CFP outpost. As I suspected, they were taken by the Headhunters who currently have them stashed at [Location|Address]. 

My source also warned me that they might be moving the supplies to a more secure location soon. Feels like our window of getting them back is closing fast. Can you head over to that outpost and reclaim them before they disappear again?

Clearly, it’s a risky op but I wouldn’t be asking if those supplies weren’t important. Secure them and then bring them to [Destination|Address].

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Be safe out there, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. 

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, partly in thanks to how many outlaws are flying around in Pyro and partly because this request isn't for your average everyday component. But lucky for you, the extra effort will be rewarded.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

Foxwell_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Nyx_Hard.description:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the <EM4>Fuel Tanks and ships</EM4> in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage. 

If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully. 

Best of luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_Ashland_Local_3box_Single_Courie.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

DeadSaints_Stanton_VeryHard_RecoverCargo.description:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.

Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Grab a crew you can trust and your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and get your ass over there.

After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.

-Twitch

Refueling_Pyro_Hydrogen_2L_2M_Rank4.description:
Heyo,

Over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen and [QTFuel] SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4>. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run. 

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti_Interstellar_Bul.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

CFP has an urgent request for a pilot with combat experience. A few of their settlements are under immediate threat and may soon be under attack, so they need supplies ASAP. 

If you're confident that you can navigate a potential combat zone, please head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, grab the cargo, and bring it to these locations:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>

You'll need enough room for <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and your own <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to get everything loaded and unloaded.

Keep in mind that it's always best to run if someone tries to ambush you. But if you get cornered, don't hesitate to defend yourself.

RedWind_Pyro_Medium_RecoverCargo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

A Red Wind hauler has been ambushed by some outlaws and now our clients’ cargo is sitting still whilst they prepare to steal it. We need a pilot with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a combat ready ship to head to the location below and recover the cargo before it’s gone for good.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

The pilot reported multiple hostiles so make sure you take this seriously. 

EVERY OPPORTUNITY COUNTS – Make the most of what’s given to you, show us that you can handle more work.

EchhartSecurity_Stanton_Super_RecoverCar.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Putting out an immediate call for a highly skilled contractor to reclaim a client's cargo located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Client hired an expert hauler to transport something discreetly, but it seems some information regarding the shipment was either hacked or leaked. The pilot was attacked and now the shipment is stranded. We need you and any support ships you bring to make it to the site before the cargo is lost for good. 

You will need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship capable of storing <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

After assessing the situation and the importance the client has placed on the recovery of the cargo, we have decided to reward a high payout for the successful delivery of the shipment to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

CFP_Pyro_Easy_RecoverCargo.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Refueling_Nyx_Hydrogen_1L_Rank2.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> is in need of <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4>, so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

ORS_Cr_Large.description:
Alright,

The damage reports are still rolling in from the Nine Tails' attack on Orison and the folks at Crusader are saying they might have to repair a significant proportion of the propulsors on those platforms. That's why this one's a massive order.

Larger quantity, but same as before otherwise. Either manufacturer them yourself using an Item Fabricator or source them some other way.

When you're done, drop the propulsors off at <EM4>Orison</EM4>. Be a big payout with this one.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

FTL_Courier_Stanton_Copper_Rank0.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the <EM4>ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes</EM4>.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

[Contractor|SignOff]

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_TradepostToOutpost_3box.description:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

There’s a few boxes waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that need to get to <EM4>Bullock's Reach</EM4>. Can you get those supplies to the outpost for us? This might be a simple supply run, but doing these consistently only strengthens our position in the system. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_3AsteroidBase_XenoThr.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [Location|Address] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

HaulCargo_AToB_Interstellar_Small_Cryo_I.description:
Call me Twitch. I run the Dead Saints. 

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling. 

I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one. 

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for <EM4>2 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and you'll need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> without getting security involved. 
 
If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line. 

-Twitch

CFP_Pyro_JacksonsSwap_Local_4boxes_Singl.description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionD_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_C.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

CleanAir_Small_VentFilters_System-To-Sys.description:
Hi,

This outbreak of Molina Mold really has folks on edge. Hauling requests for new vent filters is through the roof, even from places that weren’t using those cheap Gyson ones. 

Anyways, I have one such haul here I was hoping you could knock out. It’s a small scale haul of filters waiting at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> that needs to go to <EM4>Levski</EM4>. You free to take care of it? 

According to the haul specifics, the containers will be <EM4>1 SCU</EM4> in size or smaller. Don’t forget to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along to help you move everything. 

Appreciate you taking of this important run for us!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

HeadHunters_DefendDestructibleEntities_S.description: A band of hired guns has been sent to mess with our interests over at [Location|Address]. Seems someone has been tipped off that if the Fuel Tanks there are destroyed that it will severely interrupt Headhunter operations in the area. That's a problem I want you to fix. Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor [ScripAmount] Council Scrip for a job well done. Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_Solar_CFP_Tradep.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (<EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>  

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_CFPOutposts_BombingRun.description:

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at [Location|Address] and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

Adagio_RG_FPSSalvage_Stanton_Canisters_S.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and components by stripping abandoned ships and removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. 

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, even with the amount of ships buzzing through a system as populated as Stanton, so don't be surprised if you have to put a bit more effort into hunting down what's needed.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

FoxwellEnforcement_Patrol_Pyro_VeryEasy.description:
Time to knock out a routine patrol for one of our long-term clients. The route is a series of waypoints that need to be visited and scanned to confirm everything’s as expected. Should be simple enough.  

If interested, please accept and head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD to start. Pull this off and the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>


Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

HH_Pyro_RegionD_E_HHOutpost_FPSSalvage.description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at [Location|Address]. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CrimBase_HRT_RetrieveCa.description:
Hey,

Outlaws in the system have been getting aggressive lately, targeting more of our convoys. They recently ambushed one of our cargo ships and stole supplies desperately needed by our operations. If we don’t get it back, we’re worried that the locals will start losing faith. They need to know that Citizens for Prosperity can’t just be bullied out of operation.

We managed to track the outlaws to [Location|Address]. Now we need someone who isn’t afraid of crossing these criminals to recover the shipment and deliver it to [Destination|Address]. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, do you think you could make the run for us?

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

These ores can be mined on the surface of planets or moons in different solar systems and then delivered to the requested location. 

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_XSOutposts_CarversRidg.description:
I swear all the local scumbags have gotten a lot bolder since Citizens for Prosperity moved into here. Now we got a group attacking Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation], so I need someone to take it back and remind them that Headhunters are still the power in the system.

If you take them out, I don't have to figure out who they are, so get to it.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_ERT_XenoThreat_KillShip.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TargetName] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TargetName|Last] was spotted flying around [Location|Address], so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.

HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnima.description:
We’ve been monitoring a situation at <EM4>[Location]</EM4> regarding an uptick in the <EM4>[Creature]</EM4> population over the past few months. Our models indicate that if this continues many of the native plants and animals will be adversely affected. It’s imperative that the <EM4>[Creature]</EM4> population is reduced before that happens.     

If you can help, please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for more specifics on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPOutpost_Sabotage.description:
Turns out those Citizens for Prosperity bastards have been gathering intel on us. They're going to try to cut us off from several revenue streams and bleed us dry. Can't let that happen. 

Head to [Location|Address] and destroy their data storage. 

That should teach them not to stick their noses where they don't belong.

-Stows out

LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_FaunaCave_MissingPerso.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_StationToOutpost_1box_S.description:
Hey, 

Every once and awhile, Citizens for Prosperity likes to surprise members stationed at our outposts with a little gift to keep morale high. We’ve got the next box ready to go from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>, but need someone to make the delivery for us. Any interest in spreading some good cheer?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Foxwell_DefendDestructibleEntities_Pyro_.description:
Calling all pilots – one of our clients is looking for some protection for their <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4>, based in <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. From what we’ve gathered, the attackers are a group of wannabe outlaw pests who probably haven’t realized the value of the assets they’re trying to destroy, just wreaking havoc for the sake of it. Still, the client’s property is important, so should be kept as intact as possible.

If you take care of them to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

FoxwellEnforcement_EliminateAll.description:
Looking for someone willing to take out the trash at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Guess a gang has settled in without the permission of the owners. So they’ve hired us to get them out whatever way we see fit. 

I’d bring plenty of ammo, if I were you. Doubt they’ll want to leave willingly. 


Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

HH_Pyro_RegionC_M_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [Location|Address] and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

A nearby outpost of ours at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TargetName] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TargetName|Last] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [Location|Address], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_Solar_CFP_RuinT.description:

HH_Pyro_RegionB_To_RegionD_RegionLink_5b.description:
Headhunters got people placed all across the system. Keeping them all stocked and ready to rock if something goes down is essential to our success. Got a cargo run here that’ll help us do just that. 

We got some crates sitting at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> that need to move across the system to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Think you can handle this for us?

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnima.description:
A client has contacted us about resolving a <EM4>[Creature]</EM4> infestation issue before it gets any worse. Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_CFPXSOutposts_Theft.description:
Been looking for [Item], and one of our people inside CFP let me know some was just delivered to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Should only be a few soft CFP guards around for you to deal with. Then grab the shit and bring it to [Destination|Address].

Stows out.

CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearOutHostiles_Pyro.description:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out [Location|Address] only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises. 

Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CrimBase_MRT_RetrieveCa.description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at [Destination]. 

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to [Destination|Address]. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro4_Med_Trdpst_Local_5boxes_Single.description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
Everyone has been talking about a new player named [TargetName] who is operating out of [Location|Address]. They've become a real concern for the Headhunters. 

It's time to shut them down. 

Head over, take out [TargetName|Last] and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave. 

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_CFPOutposts_HH_Elimin.description:
A distress call just came in from [Location|Address] claiming that a large Headhunter force has just attacked our outpost there. There have been multiple deaths and injuries from those who managed to flee the scene. We're looking for any available security personnel to head there and retake the outpost.

Witness accounts identified the attackers as elite Headhunter enforcers, so watch yourself out there and bring help if you can. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_E_1AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [Location|Address] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Foxwell_DefendDestructibleEntities_Nyx_H.description:
One of our high priority clients is under attack from a criminal gang targeting their <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> in <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. The client’s assets are valuable, so we need to keep those safe at all costs, but I won’t kid – it’ll be a challenge and a half with these thugs determined to do some real damage. 

If it were me, I wouldn’t hesitate to <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. They’re no joke, so we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these guys successfully. 

Best of luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

----------------------------

HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_MissingPerson_Eliminat.description:
We had this kid named [TargetName] volunteer to go take out some XenoThreat near Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Everything we knew about the place said it was gonna be too much for [TargetName|Last] to handle, but they were real keen on boosting their standing with the Headhunters and thought this would do it, so they went alone.

Haven't heard anything but XenoThreat comms coming out of that place since. If you want to go and knock it over, we'll pay you instead. If you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last] that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_Intro_Theft.description:
Headhunters are always on the lookout for talented folks that can quickly and discreetly acquire items that we have our eye on. If that’s you, I’ve got a job that should test your skills. Ace it and I have plenty more I can start sending your way.  

There’s a crate of [Item] currently at Asteroid Base. Go liberate it from its current owners and deliver it to [Destination|Address]. Should be quick and easy. 

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionC_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_C.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TargetName] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TargetName|Last] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [Location|Address] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Lagrange_LRT_RetrieveCa.description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a [Ship] carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at [Location|Address]. We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at [Destination|Address]. Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery? 

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.    

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

WildstarRacing_Race6_YadarValley_TimeTri.description:
Ready to set a new personal best with Wildstar Racing Amateur League?

[RaceDetails]

DISCLAIMER
Wildstar Racing requires the contracted racer to be the vehicle pilot, no substitutes or stand-ins are allowed. HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_UnocDerelict_MissingPe.description:
So, I sent one of our people, a new recruit by the name [TargetName], to do a hand-off over at [Location|Address], but now the bastard’s gone missing.

I’m thinking they either ran off with Headhunter credits and they’re good as dead, or they were robbed and now they’re lying there actually good as dead. Either way, I’d like for you to go have a look and see if you can find them.

If you settle the matter, I’ll give you what their cut would have been.

-Stows

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Nyx_.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>Fuel Tanks</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

Lima Endicott
