Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_MRT_DefendShip.description:
One of my pilots wasn't thinking straight and got themselves mixed up in a heap of trouble over at [Location|Address]. 

The real kicker is the fool has a full hold. Can't really afford to lose the stuff they're carrying, so I'd appreciate it if you could go bail them out for me. 

- Stows out

FoxwellEnforcement_BombingRun_Stanton_E.description:
We've just received the location of an outlaw outpost where some up-and-coming criminals have been hanging out. Now, our client says there's no reason to engage these folks directly. Instead you will be targeting their supply lines.

Fly on over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and take out their fuel stores while dealing with any minimal resistance they may put up. It will be your call on how much you engage with the hostile forces, just don't forget that your main objective is ensuring those fuel tanks are out of action.

This is a yellow level contract so pay will be proportionate.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

----------------------------

Putting out a call for a highly skilled pilot who can recover our client’s cargo. Please only accept this contract if you have experience dealing with extremely hostile situations involving multiple combatants. Additional crew members and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> are highly recommended.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION

HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_ShadowFall_EliminateA.description:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over Shadowfall. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Rank1_ShepardsRest_Loca.description:
A nearby outpost of ours at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

We will need <EM4>three fuses replaced</EM4> and if you could bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes</EM4> that should take care of the rest.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_DerelictOutposts_Near.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have approached us with information that multiple groups of kopions have been attacking people at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> without provocation. Currently, no deaths have been reported, but they are concerned their most vulnerable will be at risk if these kopions continue running rampant.

Ensure you are prepared adequately, kopions hunt in packs and it is easy to become overwhelmed by their sheer numbers.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

HH_Pyro_RegionA_StationToOutpost_1box_Si.description:
Got a crate that needs to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. There’s a Clip waiting there for it. They’re a real nasty bastard too, so best not mess this up. 

Just grab the package from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Don’t do anything dumb with it, and you’ll be fine. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_OccuCave_Courier.description:
Hi,

Our intel team intercepted a comm between Headhunters talking about how they stocked The cave can only be accessed on foot. with cargo stolen from us. Asked around about that cave and it’s been a known Headhunters cache for decades. Always seems to be staffed by grunts too. 

Know it’s risky but we really need to take our cargo back. You up for raiding that cave?

Do whatever you need to get our supplies back and then take them to [Destination|Address].

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

GillysPilotSchool_Mission06.description:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.      

Find your way to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>. 

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located. 

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Headhunters_PAF_Theft.description:
We’re getting ready to take our ops in Stanton to the next level. Our scouts tracked an outlaw ship that unloaded some <EM4>[Item]</EM4> at an old Hathor platform facility at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Whole thing feels like a prime target for a raid. 

Need someone to hit the site, grab the <EM4>[Item]</EM4> stashed there, and bring it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. That old Hathor facility is buzzing with activity. Go in unprepared and you’ll regret it. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Danger_Stage1_RegionLin.description:
Citizens for Pyro is concerned about one of our local contractors, [TargetName]. They finished up a trade at [Location|Address] and haven’t been seen since. We’re hearing reports that outlaws have been frequenting the area, so I suspect that the worst might have happened.

Either way, [TargetName|Last] has done good work for us in the past and I’d hate for them to wind up as just another one of the system's missing. If you’re willing to find them for me, I’ll see that you get a reward.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionD_Rank5_LastLanding_Local_.description:
Down at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4>, the place got utterly smashed in a storm and needs some serious patchwork.

If anyone out there has a <EM4>bunch of fuses</EM4> (I hear <EM4>six</EM4> should be plenty), a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC cans to deal with eight or so messed up pipes</EM4>, we'll hook you up with some creds to do the fix.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_To_RegionA_RegionLink_5.description:
Hi,

It’s incredible how many Citizens for Prosperity locations have started to thrive throughout the system. To sustain these locations, we need to be able to move important supplies between them. Got one such important run here, if you’re interested.  

There’s a few boxes of goods waiting at <EM4>Frigid Knot</EM4> that need to cross the system to <EM4>Jackson's Swap</EM4>. Could you move them for us and help us all build a better future?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Shubin_RG_Discovery_FPSMine_Nyx_Rank1_Sa.description:
CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using <EM4>Sadaryx crystals</EM4> and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4>.

Deliver the procured lenses to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> for processing.

Contractors have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws, so caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Adagio_RG_ShipSalvage_Stanton_Rank2_Comp.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>.  

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, even with the amount of ships buzzing through a system as populated as Stanton, so don't be surprised if you have to put a bit more effort into hunting down what's needed.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Kevin Walton

RCD_Exclusive.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*: </EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>exclusive mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HaulCargo_AToB_Interstellar_Small_SunB_G.description:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>[Item]</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>2 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

EckhartSecurity_Stanton1_KillShip_CrimeF.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = [Contractor|ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Ve.description:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy? 

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.   

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,


Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TargetName] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TargetName|Last] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

Long story, short - a Headhunter messed up real bad and now Citizens for Prosperity has gotten their hands on some data that could really do some damage to us. 

The bastard is going to need some time to heal so that leaves it to you to clean up the mess. Can you go to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and destroy the servers they got stored there? I wanna make sure there's no chance of this info getting out there.

-Stows out

InterSec_Nyx_TSG_FullStrikeOnStation.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group
Briefing: 
We've received word that a People's Alliance security ship called Tranquility stumbled across  Shattered Blade hiding out in an old QV Extraction station. Details are sketchy but will connect you with local assets once on site. 

Intersec is looking for a team to intervene and protect the Tranquility and their personnel. <EM4>Recruiting additional ships</EM4> to support you in this mission is absolutely critical. You will <EM4>need a variety of ship types</EM4> to balance multiple combat zones in space and on the ground.

Respectfully,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Stanton_Medium.description:
Our airspace around <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> has been compromised. Enemy ships are threatening the base and any of our ships in the area. Gotta put a stop to this immediately, so get your shit in order and get over there. Just get going and I’ll update you with any relevant info on where you’re needed. 
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionC_LRT_Criminals_KillShip.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TargetName] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [Location|Address] and you should find [TargetName|Last] flying around. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_M_OccuDerelict_MissingP.description:
Two locals we work with were out salvaging at [Location|Address] when they had some issues with faulty equipment. One managed to escape, but their partner, [TargetName] was unfortunately left behind.

With the state they were last reported to be in, I’m guessing they didn’t make it, but I’d like to know for sure. If you’re willing, I could use your help in finding their remains.

If you can track them down, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated for the effort.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Battaglia_DataDownload.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Data Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and make a copy of their server data</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

UnafilliatedHH_Pyro_RegionB_H_3AsteroidB.description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat. 

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting. 

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.  

Interested?

57 65 65 76 69 6c

LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

FTL_Courier_Stanton_MedicalSupplies_Rank.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the <EM4>ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes</EM4>.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

[Contractor|SignOff]

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to [Location|Address] and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_TradepostToOutpost_4box.description:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

There’s a few boxes waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that need to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Can you get those supplies to the outpost for us? This might be a simple supply run, but doing these consistently only strengthens our position in the system. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_VH_LastDitch_Sabotage.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at Last Ditch and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans. 

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro4_Med_Trdpst_Local_5box_MultiToSi.description:
Seems like they can’t tell their ass from their elbow over at [Location] and the place is a mess. I need help collecting supplies spread across the outpost and putting them where they’re supposed to go. Here are the specifics:

Pick up package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item5|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>.
  
All of the above need to end up at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Easy and low-risk work, if you’re interested.

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 
 
Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionC_CFP_Stat.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Gaslight at the L2 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4> to <EM4>Chawla's Beach</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_OccuCave_TheGoldenRivi.description:
Some crew whose name doesn’t even deserve to cross my lips stole a bunch of our supplies, and then hid them in The cave can only be accessed on foot.. As if we wouldn’t be able to track them down. Now that we know where they hid the goods it’s time to make them pay. 

Interested in raiding that cave and getting our shit back? Do your worst to whoever’s inside just don’t damage our goods. Then bring everything to  The Golden Riviera. Sounds kinda fun. Makes me miss my days when I applied my other skills to help the gang.

Stows out.

HWS_Pyro_RegionA_E_DerelictOutposts_Kill.description:
Highpoint Wilderness is seeking a contractor to cull a pack of kopions that are threatening to overrun one of Citizens for Prosperity's outposts. After an initial assessment, it has been decided that relocation is impossible and a culling of them is the only viable option. If you're interested, head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>  and once we've received confirmation that the task is complete we will send payment.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

FoxwellEnforcement_EliminateAll_NonHosti.description:
We’ve been contracted to take care of a delicate situation. A gang has settled into <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that we need to get cleared out. Only issue is that there’s still some civilians there too. 

Looking for someone with the skills and good trigger sense to get rid of those outlaws without harming any innocent people. If that’s you, grab your gear and get over there. 


Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_TradepostToOutpost_5boxe.description:
Our crew at [Destination] needs a restock on some essentials. Looking for someone who can be trusted to move ‘em without any ‘slippage’ or other funny business.  

The boxes are waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need to be dropped at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any interest?   

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

Headhunters have been expanding, but still need help getting a lay of our new territory. I’ve got a run to check spots we want scanned ready to go. 

This one kicks off at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and will look at a few more locations after that, but I’ll update you as we clear them out. Not expecting you to run into any trouble but no guarantees. Trouble seems to follow us.

Get this done and I'll toss the main contractor <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as a thanks.

CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearOutHostiles_Pyro.description:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. Rather than just go around the problem and risk it persisting along the new route, we feel it we be prudent to meet these outlaws head on.

You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to [Location|Address] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HaulCargo_AToB_Interstellar_Large_Car_Wi.description:
If you're looking for creds, the Saints need someone with hauling experience to do a supply run from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>. 

You're gonna need a ship that can hold size <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move the boxes around. 

Don't open the crates but just so you know, most of this stuff is legal but not all of it. Try not to cross paths with anyone who might make that a problem for you. Get me?

-Twitch

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPXSOutpost_EliminateSp.description:
This shit saddens me. Not sure if you've ever crossed paths with [TargetName] in your dealings with us. Thought they were a real good one. Been with the Headhunters for years, but something must have happened because they went running to CFP for protection. Sold out some of our brothers and sisters along the way.

All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation], find [TargetName|Last], and kill them.

Doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just want the result.

Damn shame.

Stows out.

FoxwellEnforcement_BombingRun_Stanton_VE.description:
A bunch of outlaws have been harassing our client and recently things have taken a turn for the worse. They've taken over their property and we've exhausted all other options.

We need a decent pilot to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and take out their fuel tanks. If you can cut off their supplies, you can pave the way for the client to take back their property.

This shouldn't be a tough one. You might run into a ship or two and maybe a few turrets, but you've been authorized to use lethal force. All we need for you to do is get in there, get the fuel tanks, and get out.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_UnocCave_Rustville_Mis.description:
I know better than to send someone like [TargetName] out by themselves, but that didn’t stop me from being a fool and doing it. Now the dumb SOB hasn’t returned my comms and nobody has set eyes on them in a few days.

If you got the time, I could use someone to go over to [Location|Address] and see if they’re still there. You get paid even if they wind up being dead.

-Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank5_Regional_Handyman.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes</EM4>. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_DisableCommsTowers_Easy.description:
Violence is never our first choice, but sometimes it must be used as a preventative measure.

We’re planning a strike on a Headhunter controlled outpost and need your help.

We need to make sure that if something goes wrong they won’t be able to call for backup and escalate the situation. That’s where you come in. We need you to head over to <EM4>Rustville</EM4> and disable the communication towers. There should be a <EM4>control panel located at the top</EM4> of each tower that you can use to deactivate them.

If you’re able to do this, Citizens for Prosperity will be able to gain some vital ground in Pyro.

It’s also worth keeping in mind for future contracts that you can choose to take out the comms towers instead of risking a fight with reinforcement dropships.

Stay alert and stay safe.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_Rank0_Regional_Handyman.description:
One of our spots at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> got kinda wrecked in an attack recently and we need someone to head over there and patch things up.

From what they tell me, you’ll need <EM4>about three fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to sort out at least three pipes.</EM4> Get it done and we’ll get you paid.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>”Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> looking to be topped up with [FuelType] at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit

United Wayfarers Club

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and collect the shipment? You'll need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling

To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

My guess is that someone else was already using the hangar, but I’d sleep better knowing for sure.

If the credits seem right, head over and see if you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. Just be careful. I’d hate to have to hire someone to find your body next.

One of our clients needs support at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> where their security forces are struggling to handle an outlaw incursion. Head there and help the local forces get rid of the problem before it’s too late.

Marcus Clenn

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Ea.description:
An outlaw who’s been on the run finally returned to the system. Seems like they hoped that disappearing for a bit would make us forget about them. They’re not even trying to hide their identity or vary their routine which means we know exactly where they’re going to be.

Latest intel indicates that they’re flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and will be passing by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> soon. I’ve already scoped out an emission cloud that’s a perfect place for you to find cover, power down your ship, and wait. Only real variable is if they’ll be alone or not. We’ve heard they sometimes roll with friends that all fly single-seaters. Landing that first surprise strike will be important as this crew is battle-tested, but we’ll have reinforcements at the ready to provide support if you need them.

Get this done and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Intro.description:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a<EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.

You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that they fly by frequently. 

Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPOutpost_StoleGoods.description:
Our crew at [Destination|Address] is running low on [Item]. Want to get them restocked, and know that the CFP outpost at [Location|Address] has some lying around. Wanna go there and grab it for us?

- Stows

Ling_Nyx_Super_RecoverCargo.description:
Hey,

Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.

Can you fly out to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.

Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll send confirmation to the client.

Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Redwind_ASD_EletronicEquipment.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL 
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS' 
----------------------------    

ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.

You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4>. 

Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness.  And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along. 

BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.

UnafilliatedCFP_Pyro_RegionD_H_3Asteroid.description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat. 

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting. 

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.  

Interested?

HH_Pyro_RegionC_DerelictOutpost_Eliminat.description:
Looking for any hitters available for a quick gig. Over at [Location|Address], they're getting hit by some geniuses led by [TargetName]. We've tussled against [TargetName|Last] in the past so it's no surprise they haven't wised up. 

We want you to head there and take them down. Kill whoever you like, but [TargetName|Last] should be your focus.

Stows out.

HeadHunters_Patrol_Nyx_Super_V.description:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.  

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor that pulls it off. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_UnocCave_JacksonsSwap.description:
[TargetName] is a local who only has done a few jobs for Citizen for Prosperity, but they had promise. That is, until they went missing while exploring [Location|Address] last week. Unfortunately, we didn’t hear about it until today. Chances of survival at this point are pretty slim, but we still think its worth confirming what happened to them.
 
CFP could use help on this if anyone is interested. And besides being a good deed, the payment should make it worth the effort. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipWaveAttack_ClearO.description:
It seems that a couple of different small-time gangs have decided to pool their resources and start doing coordinated attacks. Alone, they weren't much, but all together they're proving to be a serious threat that has to be dealt with.

Recruit some backup you can rely on and the fly over to [Location|Address]. Once you attack the initial gang members you find there, the other groups will arrive to support them. Make sure you wait around to take out all of them.
 
Good luck,

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_ERT_XenoThreat_KillShip.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TargetName] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TargetName|Last] was spotted flying around [Location|Address], so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_LRT_Criminals_KillShip.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TargetName] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [Location|Address] and you should find [TargetName|Last] flying around. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_Rustville_Local_1box_Single_Cour.description:
Got a box sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that needs to make its way over to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_GoldenRiviera_Local_5boxes_Singl.description:
Got all our prospects at [Location] busy preppin’ for an upcoming job so there’s a bunch of boxes sitting there that need to be moved to other parts of the outpost. Feel like making some easy creds doing it for us? 

Everything can be picked up from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Then moved around the outpost to these spots:

Ruto_StantonStar_Illegal_ClearCrimestat_.description:
Hey there. I heard you ended up in Klescher which is a real drag. But it might actually be a lucky day for both of us.

Long story short, I had somebody sneaking a datachip out of the prison, but they never got back to me. I know for a fact they haven’t left the facility, so I think something might have happened to them. While tragic, business must carry on. If you can get the chip and finish the job, I can clear your crimestat for you. What do you say?

Of course, I don't know exactly how far they got, but I can tell you that the prison's got a whole network of hidden tunnels my guy was planning on using to make his escape. My guess is his corpse is rotting away somewhere there.

Once you find the body, I’m hoping the chip will still be on him. When you’ve got it, finish escaping and get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. 

One warning though, you might want to watch out for Hurston Security. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them.

When I've got the data I’ll wipe your crimestat and then, voila, you’ll be free and clear. What you do after that is entirely up to you.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_KillShip.description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near [Location|Address]. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_Rank3_Regional_Handyman.description:

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_TradepostToOutpost_5box.description:
Hi,

Keeping Citizens for Prosperity outposts stocked with supplies is key to our mission in this system. Happy folks make happy homes. Can you help us deliver some much needed provisions to a few of them?

HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_OccuDerelict_MissingPe.description:
Some of my people were involved with a raid over at [Location|Address]. Most of them got out clean, but after the dust settled nobody is sure of what happened to [TargetName].

A lot of other gangs would just leave the poor bastard to rot, but that’s not the way the Headhunters do things. I want to know for sure if [TargetName|Last] is alive or dead and I’m willing to pay you good credits to find out.

Just be careful when you get there because I bet the assholes who live there are still gunning for a fight.

- Stows

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_StantonDC_ScrapWas.description:
Hi,

This isn't a particularly long delivery route, but you will be moving between couple of different locations. To make sure things go smoothly, bring enough fuel and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to speed up moving the boxes.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

Hey if you’re reading this, we need a hand. An outpost of ours down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> got hit by a nasty storm and suffered some damage. HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_MissingPerson_Destroy.description:
You ever get a bad feeling that you just can't shake? I had sent [TargetName] to take out the some XenoThreat servers at [Location|Address] and I'm starting think they ran into some serious trouble.

-Stows out

RR_Pyro_DudleyDaughters_VE_Civilians_Sal.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to Dudley & Daughters at the L4 Lagrange of Pyro VI. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_OutpostToTradepost_4box.description:

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Stan.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>Fuel Tanks</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_VeryHard_RecoverCargo.description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

HeadHunters_Patrol_Nyx_Medium.description:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available? 

All you need to do is head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it. 

Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 


Stows out.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [Location|Address].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_Solar_CFP_Station.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a bunch of comms this morning. Seems one of the local trash collectors' ship is busted and we're gonna be picking up the slack.

I got a bunch of trash (<EM4>32 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_HHXSOutpost_Sabotage.description:
With the recent aggression perpetrated by the Headhunters against our people, Citizens for Prosperity has been arranging a full operation that should hopefully deal them a significant blow. 

However, before that can happen, we need to by some more time to finish our preparations. If you could destroy the power generators at Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] it should stall the Headhunters long enough for us to ready our counter attack. 

Your assistance will be critical to our success,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Vaughn_Rockcracker_Power_EliminateSpecif.description:
A request has made its way to my desk regarding the untimely end of one [TargetName], a member of the Claw Salamander who is currently scuttling around an old QV Breaker Station. 

It is highly likely that you will find them at [Location|Address].  Be mindful though that with a station this large it may take a bit of searching to track them down. 

Hope you enjoy your time in Nyx,
Vaughn

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionC_HH_Trade.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Gaslight at the L2 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
It appears that we've lost contact with a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity ships at [Location|Address] after they reported being attacked in their last comm. 

We believe they will be able to hold off the perpetrators until help arrives, but not indefinitely. We need you to rush to their coordinates and deal with the outlaws before its too late.

Unfortunately, we cannot afford even for a single of these vessels to be lost. As such, this contract will only be considered complete if all ships survive the onslaught. 

Can you help us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CrimBase_HRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Need someone to raid a base at [Location|Address] for us. Not sure exactly who’s dug in there, but they attacked one of our ships and took the drugs they were hauling. Really need that shit back. That batch is full of high potency stuff that’s worth a premium. 

Doubt they’ll want to give it back to you, so plan to take it by force. Then bring the goods to [Destination|Address]. And don’t act like an idiot and get any ideas of what you could do with that stuff. Trust me, you don’t wanna get on my bad side. 

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionD_HHXSOutpost_EliminateAll.description:
It's sad to say but we lost one of our outposts to XenoThreat. Appalling if you ask me, but that's why we're looking for someone who's got the time and ammunition to take it back.

If that's you, head over to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and take it back.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_XTBase_VHRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Hey,

One of our supply ships fell prey to a XenoThreat ambush. I’ll spare you the grisly details, but all that really remains is the cargo our people were carrying to [Destination|Address]. Trackers hidden within the cargo shows that XenoThreat collected the goods and then took them to a few locations spread out across [Location|Address].
 
We can’t let the XenoThreat get away with what they did to our crew and keep all those goods too. That’s why we want to strike back on both fronts. We need someone who can raid that location, retrieve the stolen cargo, and teach the Xenos that there will be consequences for their horrendous actions. Can you help us fight back?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Ling_Pyro_VeryHard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hey,

Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and collect the shipment? You'll need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

HH_OLP_AtoB_WTP_MedicalSupplies.description:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>. 

From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.

Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> load, and try not to get shot in the process. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

HaulCargo_AToB_Interstellar_Bulk_Ag_Med_.description:
Hiya, 

Here’s the deal, I need someone good for a special run. We’ve got an important client that’s threatening to take their business elsewhere, because their deliveries are consistently missing cargo. They’re demanding that 100% of the cargo be delivered on this run, or they won’t pay. Since this was before my time and my supervisor wants to show that it won’t happen again, they agreed with this. Anyway, I think you might be a good fit. 

If you’re willing to take that risk too, here are all the pertinent details. The cargo can be collected from <EM4>Port Tressler</EM4> and delivered to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>. Looks like the largest cargo container you’ll need to handle is <EM4>24 SCU</EM4>, so be sure to bring a ship big enough and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to help you move those containers around.  
 
Covalex Independent Contractors 

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

Adagio_RG_ShipSalvage_Pyro_Rank1_RMC_CMa.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent order,we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Refueling_Nyx_Hydrogen_3XL_Rank6.description:
Heyo,

Over at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4>. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run. 

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimin.description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Refueling_Stanton_Hydrogen_1XL_Rank5.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> looking to be topped up with <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Pyro_VeryHard.description:
Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4>, along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto. 

Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

Shubin_RG_FPSMine_Stanton_Intro.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for Volt weapons. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.

These ores can be mined from the caves on the surface of the planet that we require the ore to be delivered to. For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract."

HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_MissingPerson_Eliminat.description:
We tasked one of our up-and-coming triggers named [TargetName] to go clean out a hideout over at Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] from some assholes who'd been attacking some of the locals in the area. Well, I guess they got the drop on [TargetName|Last] because we haven't heard shit since.

I want you to go and finish the job. While you're out there, if you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last], that'd be great. I'm sure their dad would like to know.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_H_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
One of the local Judges has been trying to get info on some of new gangs in the area. You know, see if anyone's got eyes on what we got. That kinda thing. Anyway, we sent [TargetName] undercover to try and suss out if anyone's getting bright ideas to try and make a move.

Anyway, [TargetName|First] was heading to [Location|Address] to make a deal with some local grunts or whatever but we haven't heard back. Judge is afraid [TargetName|Last] might've been sniffed then snuffed, so we want you to head there and see what's what.

Go find what happened to [TargetName|Last] and get our cargo back. Odds are you'll need to shwack anyone you come across because if [TargetName|Last] is dead, these assholes killed a Headhunter.

Once you get the cargo, drop it off at [Destination|Address] and get a nice little payday.

Stows out.

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Stanton_VeryEasy.description:
Headhunters flying in and out of <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> are being harassed by some aggressive upstarts. Need them dealt with before they become a real pain in the ass.   

Get there and I’ll update you on what these pests are doing so you can hunt ‘em down. 

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows

Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P2M3-Stanton4_Repe.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
One of the biggest issue when it comes to ongoing investigations is intel growing stale. To help alleviate that, I’m going to have you head back into Onyx and grab the latest seismic sensor data. Would be good to see what the latest readings say.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Seismic data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a <EM4>ASD Secure Drive</EM4> that you can collect at your home location.

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_HH_Trade.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>The Golden Riviera</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_Lagrange_VLRT_DefendShip.description:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near [Location|Address]. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out

HH_Pyro_RegionC_M_OccuCave_MissingPerson.description:
We’re on the market for a new stash house, so I sent [TargetName] over to [Location|Address]. They were supposed to just have a quick look and report back to me if any of the hangars would work for us, but I haven’t heard from them since.

My guess is that someone else was already using the hangar, but I’d sleep better knowing for sure.

If the credits seem right, head over and see if you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. Just be careful. I’d hate to have to hire someone to find your body next.

Stows out.

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti_Interstellar_Med.description:
We're looking for someone discreet to move a new batch of altruciatoxin to a number of buyers . Yeah, it's illegal, but only if you get caught. 

The shipment is at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. You'll need to take it to these drop points:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>

Be sure your ship can carry size <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> containers, and don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>. Not sure how you're planning on moving the boxes, otherwise.

-Twitch

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_ChainElimAll_1Cluster.description:
We are currently looking for any qualified and available security operatives to head out to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and reclaim a CFP installation that had been taken by Headhunters. 

The group that's currently occupying the outpost is being led by [TargetName], a Headhunter of some note who's had a history of aggression against locals and CFP volunteers.

We need all Headhunters secured and [TargetName|Last] taken out.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?

Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship with enough space to store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.
 
Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll send you the creds.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. Heahunters are on the lookout for motivated and competent contractors who can be trusted to do a wide range of work supporting our operations. If you think you have what it takes, I’ve got a mission here that’ll test your skills in several ways.

Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP51643
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Looking for an operative to confirm the status of a client. They and their partner missed a scheduled meeting and all attempts to contact them have proven in vain. Last we heard they were undertaking some business in Nyx and fear that they may be the victim of some unfortunate tragedy.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate <EM4>[MissingPersonList]</EM4> at <EM4>Operations Office</EM4> and confirm their status.

Be cautious while conducting your search. If the client did meet harm, it would be unfortunate for you to meet the same fate.

HaulCargo_AToB_Nyx_Small_Medical_Intro.description:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.  

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you. 

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of <EM4>[Item]</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   


Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Vaughn_Stanton1_Assassination_Intro.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

HH_Pyro_RegionD_E_FaunaCave_MissingPerso.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CrimBase_MRT_DefendShip.description:
One of my pilots wasn't thinking straight and got themselves mixed up in a heap of trouble over at [Location|Address].

Headhunters have been expanding, but still need help getting a lay of our new territory. I’ve got a run to check spots we want scanned ready to go. 

This one kicks off at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and will look at a few more locations after that, but I’ll update you as we clear them out. Not expecting you to run into any trouble but no guarantees. Trouble seems to follow us.

A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [Location|Address] and likely rearming for another attack.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_VeryHard.description:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us. 

We got eyes on a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

You know, the usual.

Just don’t forget to bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> as that shit’s heavy.

When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we’ll take care of the rest.
