RoX_DOB.description:
We have intercepted a location beacon that puts <EM>[TargetName]</EM4> and their personal attack wing at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. They have been one of XenoThreat's most brutal enforcers since their founding. 

<EM>[TargetName|Last]</EM4>'s not one to back down from a fight so hit their ships hard enough, do enough damage and they won't be able to resist joining in the action. Once they're out in the open, they'll be your main target.

Ready to go?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Ling_Nyx_VeryHard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hey,

Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and collect the shipment? You'll need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_Derelicts_EliminateAn.description:
Citizens for Prosperity recently reported to us that one of their scouts was injured by kopions during a routine exploration mission. According to them, this isn't the first time this particular pack has posed a problem, so they've requested our services to clear out the area. The report shows they were last seen at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

This behavior is typical of kopions looking to expand their territory, so it is highly likely that you will be dealing with more kopions than initially observed. Caution is advised. 

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

HighpointWildernessSpecialists_Irradiate.description:
As a consequence of the ongoing radiation storm on Pyro I, some of the invasive kopions have become irradiated. This poses a threat to the health of the indigenous wildlife and to those who live and work in <EM4>[Location]</EM4>. 

We are seeking out a skilled contractor who can cull any irradiated kopions in and around <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Do not accept this contract unless you have the proper weapons and equipment that can reliably function in a radioactive environment. 

Your compensation will be adjusted to match the risks associated with this contract.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Shubin_RG_Discovery_FPSMine_Nyx_Rank1_Me.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
Your crew will need to gain access to a <EM4>QV Breaker Station</EM4>, collect the required <EM4>Sadaryx ore</EM4>, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This will require a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4> and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

[TargetName], a member of the Citizens for Prosperity family, vanished two standard days ago while attempting to find a buyer for some old farming equipment. CFP regrets to report that we have just discovered the wreckage of a vehicle registered under the name of the missing person in an area known to be frequented by pirates. 

We found evidence at the crash site that the victim survived and is most likely being held at [Location|Address]. We are offering a reward to anyone who can track down [TargetName|First] on our behalf. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Refueling_Stanton_NearLocation_Space_Har.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> looking to be topped up with [FuelType] at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Pyro_Easy.description:
An outlaw who’s been on the run finally returned to the system. Seems like they hoped that disappearing for a bit would make us forget about them. They’re not even trying to hide their identity or vary their routine which means we know exactly where they’re going to be.

Latest intel indicates that they’re flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and will be passing by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> soon. I’ve already scoped out an emission cloud that’s a perfect place for you to find cover, power down your ship, and wait. Only real variable is if they’ll be alone or not. We’ve heard they sometimes roll with friends that all fly single-seaters. Landing that first surprise strike will be important as this crew is battle-tested, but we’ll have reinforcements at the ready to provide support if you need them.

Get this done and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

The client will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit

United Wayfarers Club

Wildstar Racing is not responsible for any damage your ship may suffer while racing.

HaulCargo_AToB_Interstellar_Bulk_Plas_Sc.description:
Hiya, 

Looking for a hauler willing to make a run to Ruin Station. Know hauls to Pyro can give some people pause, but this is one we do regularly to help supply the station. I’ve also confirmed that everything on the cargo manifest is above board. 

If you’re interested, the cargo is ready for pick up at <EM4>Baijini Point</EM4>.  Make sure you bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> otherwise it might be a little rough.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_GroundMine_Stanton_R.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_E_UnocCave_LastLandings_.description:
I know better than to send someone like [TargetName] out by themselves, but that didn’t stop me from being a fool and doing it. Now the dumb SOB hasn’t returned my comms and nobody has set eyes on them in a few days.

If you got the time, I could use someone to go over to [Location|Address] and see if they’re still there. You get paid even if they wind up being dead.

-Stows

Eckhart_Nyx_HRT_MultiDefendShip.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Recently, we recommended that a client use a specific route to cross Nyx safely. Turns out it wasn’t as secure as we assumed, because a group ambushed our client’s ship. We need to get this cleaned up ASAP. Are you available to help? 

Intel from the client indicates a well-organized attack, so you better be equipped to deal with experienced hostiles on this one. Hurry to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, help them survive this, and we’ll pay you well for your trouble.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HeadHunters_Pyro_Super_RecoverCargo.description:
This’ll be a fun one for you. We just got word that a transport ship has broken down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Only problem is, every skag and their mother seems to know about it. Place is crawling with all kinds of outlaws trying to get their hands on the cargo onboard. That’s where you come in.

If you can get your best pilots together and <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> you can take out the competition and snag the cargo. It ain’t gonna be easy though. One of my scouts said the assholes guarding this ship have got some serious tech on them.  

I’ve already got a buyer waiting, you just need to take the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll send you the creds.

Stows out.

CleanAir_Supply_MoldTreatment.description:
Hey,

Pretty heartbreaking hearing what's happening to the people out in Levski with this Molina mold outbreak? Our family has decided to do all we can to help out with Alliance Aid.  Got a medium scale haul of antifungal waiting to be picked up at <EM4>NB Int. Spaceport</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Think you can handle this for us?

Before you go, please make sure you bring a ship that can hold <EM4>8 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. You'll also need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to deal with the containers. 
 

Safe Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_To_RegionC_RegionLink_5.description:
Hi,

It’s incredible how many Citizens for Prosperity locations have started to thrive throughout the system. To sustain these locations, we need to be able to move important supplies between them. Got one such important run here, if you’re interested.  

There’s a few boxes of goods waiting at <EM4>Frigid Knot</EM4> that need to cross the system to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Could you move them for us and help us all build a better future?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_XTOutposts_Theft.description:
Hi,

XenoThreat really has us in their crosshairs. Beefing up our defenses will help, but we can’t sit back and let them keep stealing our stuff. There’s too many CFP outposts that are already desperately low on goods.  

That’s why we need to be proactive in getting some goods back. One of our ops recently identified Shadowfall as a spot where the Xenos store a lot of supplies. Considering the outpost’s location relative to attacks on our convoy and outposts, there’s got to be a fair share of our goods in there. 

This isn’t an easy ask for many reasons, but we really need someone who can handle any Xenos at that spot and grab whatever cargo they can. Anything you acquire can be brought to [Destination|Address] where we’ll sort it and then send to our outposts that need it the most. 

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

FoxwellEnforcement_EscortShips_Stanton_H.description:
The folks at <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> are under attack and need our support. Their ships in the wider area are being targeted and there’s a growing concern that this is only a precursor to something bigger.  

The situation is evolving, but I’m being fed constant updates on what’s going on and will keep you informed as the contract progresses. 

Are you available to come to their aid? Would be smart to recruit some friends to help. These are important clients and we can’t afford to fail them. The main contractor will earn a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> if you get the job done.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Covalex_Nyx_Medium_RecoverCargo.description:
Hey El here,

Got a weird one for you. I was checking the delivery stats for the past week and noticed some discrepancies. Seems we have a couple of deliveries marked as fulfilled but the cargo trackers are still showing as active.

One of these is located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> so I was hoping you could fly over and get to the bottom of this. The order says the hauler was using a ship that could carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> so make sure you have the same. A <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> is a must for this one too.

That cargo needs to be delivered yesterday, so as soon as you've got it take it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I'll get your payment sorted for you.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton_L.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_OccuCave_MissingPerson.description:
We’re on the market for a new stash house, so I sent [TargetName] over to [Location|Address]. They were supposed to just have a quick look and report back to me if any of the hangars would work for us, but I haven’t heard from them since.

My guess is that someone else was already using the hangar, but I’d sleep better knowing for sure.

If the credits seem right, head over and see if you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. Just be careful. I’d hate to have to hire someone to find your body next.

Stows out.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_VeryEasy_V.description:
Some numskull flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_HH_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

One of the folks over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> just hit me up about a pile of cargo, <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>  

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_OccuDerelict_MissingP.description:
Unfortunately, one of our community partners, [TargetName], has been missing for a few days. Their family contacted Citizens for Prosperity for help and I told them we would do what we could. That said, with so much time passed, I’m not too hopeful.

Whatever their current state is, we're looking for someone to be our eyes on the ground for this one. There’s a strong chance that they were headed to Pyro III Abandoned Outpost, an area known to be very dangerous.

If you can track them down and confirm their status, one way or another, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_RegionD_CFP_RuinT.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

They're doing a clean out at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> and have a bunch of <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> or smaller waste containers that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots. (Don't ask me why. They're paying us is all I know.)

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>

And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro4_Med_Trdpst_Local_3boxes_Single.description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_TradepostToOutpost_5box.description:
Hi,

Keeping Citizens for Prosperity outposts stocked with supplies is key to our mission in this system. Happy folks make happy homes. Can you help us deliver some much needed provisions to a few of them? 

Everything can be collected at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Then here’s the breakdown of where everything goes: 

Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>Bullock's Reach</EM4>.
Package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>Bullock's Reach</EM4>.
Package <EM4>#[Item5|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>Bullock's Reach</EM4>.
Package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>Bullock's Reach</EM4>.
Package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>Bullock's Reach</EM4>.

Great way to make some creds and see a few of the CFP’s thriving outposts.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti_Interstellar_Sma.description:
We've got a shipment of contraband that needs to be hauled to a couple of different places. If you like creds, head to <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>, load everything up, and bring it to these drop points:  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>

You're gonna need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move the boxes and enough room in your cargo hold for size <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> containers. 

Avoid other ships if you can. Security will bust you if they figure out what you're hauling, and raiders will just take it for themselves. 

-Twitch

CleanAir_Supply_MedicalSupplies_System-T.description:
I hope this message finds you well,

Things are a bit crazy than normal around here because of how many of our pilots ended up getting sick while doing runs to Levski. Thankfully, Covalex is contributing to 'Alliance Aid' so hopefully we can put this whole affair behind us soon. 

Currently, I've got a medium scale haul of medical supplies waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Really need someone to take it to <EM4>Levski</EM4>, so the team there can operate at full capacity. 

The biggest container on this run will be <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size, so have a ship that can handle those. Oh, and don't forget your <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.  

Thanks for joining us and Alliance Aid to help bring this crisis to an end!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

HH_Pyro4_Med_Trdpst_Local_5box_SingleToM.description:
Got all our prospects at [Location] busy preppin’ for an upcoming job so there’s a bunch of boxes sitting there that need to be moved to other parts of the outpost. Feel like making some easy creds doing it for us? 

Everything can be picked up from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Then moved around the outpost to these spots:   

Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.
Package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.
Package <EM4>#[Item5|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>.
Package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>.
Package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>.

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

RoX_SD.description:
A distress beacon came in from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> about a ship under attack from XenoThreat. The pilot reports that their shields are failing and they can't outrun the attackers.

The ship's a <EM4>[Ship]</EM4>, but the pilot's Human, which  according to XenoThreat's twisted way of thinking, makes them a traitor to Humanity and a target for their hate.

We're looking for operators to head out there and do some good.

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_CrimBase_MRT_MultiDefen.description:
It appears that we've lost contact with a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity ships at [Location|Address] after they reported being attacked in their last comm. 

We believe they will be able to hold off the perpetrators until help arrives, but not indefinitely. We need you to rush to their coordinates and deal with the outlaws before its too late.

Unfortunately, we cannot afford even for a single of these vessels to be lost. As such, this contract will only be considered complete if all ships survive the onslaught. 

Can you help us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_Solar_CFP_RuinT.description:

CleanAir_EscortShip_Medium.description:
I was just contacted by an Alliance Aid rep who is deeply concerned for one of their contractors heading out from  <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. The ships helping the relief effort have been drawing a lot of outlaw attention and they're worried that without extra protection they won't be able to finish their vital work.  

Owing with the increased risk level and the value of the ship, it might behoove you to <EM4>bring some combat support</EM4> of your own along.

If you’re interested, head to the rendezvous and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_RegionA_HH_Statio.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

Refueling_Pyro_Moderate.description:
Hey, you!

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use [FuelType]. If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

They're stuck out in an area with a bad reputation, though things have been a bit more quiet recently. Still worth staying alert I'd say, just in case there's still trouble lurking out there. 

Either way, the sooner everyone's able to get flying again - and that includes you - the better.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

EckhartSecurity_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Hard_V.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. The target is a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> which has been involved in several operations against one of our most important clients. By neutralizing it once and for all, it’ll make our client’s life a hell of a lot easier. While the [AmbushTarget] is our focus, they usually don’t fly anywhere without a sizable escort, including large craft. 

We’ve gotten word that this group will be passing by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> soon. Any chance you could hurry and beat them there? That spot has an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that you can power down your ship and hide in. Then when they pass, you should have the upper hand.  

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client knows this one will be tough, so they threw in a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HeadHunters_Patrol_Nyx_Hard.description:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there? 

The route starts at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to <EM4>bring a friend</EM4> to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_ProphetsPeak_Local_1box_Single_.description:
Hey,

We’ve got an opportunity for any haulers interested in lending a hand or two to Citizens for Prosperity.

There’s a box that needs to be moved from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Shouldn’t take long, if you’re around the outpost and available. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HaulCargo_AToB_Interstellar_Small_Cryo.description:
Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride. 

If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find [total] cryopods at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> that need to go to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> containers. If you use a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on. 

HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill. 

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

-Twitch

EckhartSecurity_DataFacility_RegionC_Eli.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Clear Location
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Urgent request came in from Associated Science & Development to provide combat support at [Location]. Apparently they have been attacked by outlaws and their security forces have been unable to handle it on their own. 

You've been cleared to go on site and aide local security elements in taking out the outlaws, but ASD reserves the right to restrict you from certain areas.

This is a confirmed combat op, so prepare accordingly.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_Lagrange_VLRT_DefendShip.description:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near [Location|Address]. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out

HH_Pyro_LastLandings_Local_1box_Single_C.description:
Got a box sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that needs to make its way over to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Super.description:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.

Stows out.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Pyro_Rank.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Citizens for Prosperity

Adagio_RG_FPSSalvage_Stanton_Intro.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation], find [TargetName|Last], and kill them.

Damn shame.

Stows out.

GillysPilotSchool_Mission05.description:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.   

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.   

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire. 
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Got a client at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>, who needs their cargo picked up from Ruin Station. They’ve been waiting there a while and are starting to get a bit impatient. Any chance you could handle this for us? 

You’ll need a ship that can fit <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to be able to move them. 

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

TarPits_Stanton1_Dupree_Lobby_EliminateB.description:
We’ve had our sights set on taking out [TargetName] for a while now, but we’ve never been able to find the right moment. Enough waiting. You’re going to create the right moment for us.

Head to Lobby and take out a bunch of lowlifes running around the Lobby. Kill enough of those losers, and [TargetName|Last] will have no choice but to come face you themselves. That’s when you take ‘em out and earn yourself a nice fat payday.

ByGroup.GroupName: Squad A - Tech or Soldier x 2
Squad B - Tech or Soldier x 1
Squad H - CQC or Tech or Soldier x 2
Squad I - CQC or Tech or Soldier x 1
Squad D - CQC or Tech x 1
Squad E - CQC or Tech x 3

FoxwellEnforcement_EscortShips_Stanton_S.description:
Looking for a consummate professional to handle a high-stakes job. We’ve got VIP clients at <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> who are facing extremely aggressive and motivated outlaws targeting ships around their location. Exact details on the attack are still rolling in, but it appears to be a wide ranging, multi-pronged operation. 

If you’re available, I highly recommend that you bring additional combat support ships, plenty of supplies, and your A-game. Get this right, and we’ll reward the main contractor with a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearOutHostiles_Pyro.description:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to [Location|Address] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

IDS_ResourceGathering_Tech.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: 
To prevent the Shattered Blade from flooding the black market with xeno-contraband, the UEE has charged InterSec with <EM4>recovering a stash of Vanduul Plating and Metal.</EM4> from the old <EM4>QV Logistics station</EM4> the gang has been occupying. Once you have the materials in your posession, deliver them to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Following from your previous experience, it would not be surprising if the Shattered Blade offer resistance, but ensure that your focus is on recovering the materials.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Hard.description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.  

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right. 

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Pyro_unla.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

ORS_SA.description:
Looking for a tough and competent pilot in the area willing to take on some of the outlaws responsible for the attack on Crusader. We’ve received word that a group of Nine Tails stragglers are hunkering down near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> after they got pushed out of Orison, and Crusader Security wants our help dealing with them while they’re down. 

We’ve mapped out a good spot in the area to get the drop on them, so you’ll go there, wait quietly until they show up, and hit them before they know what’s happening. Hopefully this’ll send a message to the rest of them out there that their actions have consequences.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_CFPXSOutpost_EliminateAl.description:
Here's the deal. Some of those mercs that CFP hired as security went and shot up some Headhunters that were just moving through the system. They weren't even doing anything, just flying.

Anyway, we tracked them back to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and want to dish out some payback. Grab your gear and be our weapon, we'll make it worth your while.

- Stows

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_RegionA_HH_Stat.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>The Golden Riviera</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HeadHunters_DefendDestructibleEntities_N.description: Our partners at Asteroid Mining Base need help. A rival outlaw crew are swarming the area and attacking the Fuel Tanks there. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site is absolutely critical to our future plans in the area and its damn important that it remains in working order. With the scale of this attack and the skill of these pilots, there's no doubt that some reliable backup would serve you well. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and stop these bootlicks before they can do any lasting damage. To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn [ScripAmount] Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong. - Stow

Battaglia_ScanRocks_Super.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Priority Ore Scan

WORK BRIEF: 
I'm looking for people to go out and find deposits of <EM4>[AmountToScan] of Savrillium and [AmountToScan2] of Lindinium</EM4> to contribute to a system-wide experiment that will help plan future mining operations. These are pretty rare resources, so they might be tricky to find.

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Hope I can rely on you.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

FTL_Courier_Stanton_PrescriptionMedicati.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
Junior-level courier needed for deliveries across the Stanton System.
Transportation must be provided by courier.
You will be <EM4>required to lift up to .25 SCU</EM4> in weight.
Couriers are responsible for the correct handling and safety of all packages charged to their care.

[Contractor|SignOff]

CleanAir_Bulk_MoldSample_System-To-Syste.description:
Hey,

A special containment team at <EM4>Levski</EM4> has collected and securely packaged enough Molina mold samples for a large scale haul. Researchers at <EM4>Port Tressler</EM4> are eagerly awaiting its arrival so they can continue their tests. Any chance you can do this run for us?

I've confirmed with the containment team that they used biohazard-grade containers, so there's no risk of you catching the People's Aliment. Just bring a ship that can haul <EM4>16 SCU</EM4> cargo containers and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.

Hope its a safe and smooth haul for you,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Adagio_RG_ShipSalvage_Pyro_Rank1_RMCMedi.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent average-sized order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) by stripping abandoned ships. We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Stanton_VeryEasy.description:
Some numskull flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank3_Regional_Handyman.description:
Hello,

We've received word that a devastating storm hit <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> which caused some damage to the structures. Our technician on site is still trying to figure out what they can fix but they can’t get everything. If you bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to repair around five pipes</EM4>, we should be able to handle any remaining repairs.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Pyro.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

Refueling_Pyro_Quantum_1L_Rank2.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> is in need of <EM4>[QTFuel] SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4>, so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum </EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

HWS_Pyro_RegionA_E_DerelictOutposts_Near.description:
Highpoint Wilderness needs someone to exterminate an overpopulated pack of kopions that's threatening one of CFP's settlements. This pack can be found at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Remember to exhibit caution when approaching them and arm yourself accordingly.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Vaughn_Stanton1_Assassination_Rehire.description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more. 

Kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address] and I will consider the slate wiped clean. 

Sincerely,
Vaughn

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Caves_ChainMissingPerso.description:
Two of our volunteers vanished while on a recent foraging expedition. It has been over two standard days since their disappearance, and their families have begun to fear the worst and are willing to offer a reward if someone can help trace their whereabouts.

They were last seen in the vicinity of [Location|Address]. It is possible that they may have been injured and sought shelter in an abandoned building or a cave. The area is full of potential hiding spots, so your search will need to be thorough. 

Thank you for taking this on. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_MRT_CitizensForProsperit.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named [TargetName|Last] who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around [Location|Address]. Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.

Refueling_Pyro_Both_2M_1L_Rank3.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen and [QTFuel] SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4>. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

HH_Pyro6_Sml_Trdpst_Local_3box_Single_Co.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

CFP recently got a delivery of [Item] that we want. Think they know that too, because they hid it in a cave near The cave can only be accessed on foot. and have a handful of mercs watching over it. Let’s show ‘em that nothing gets by the Headhunters around here.

One of the ships used by this squad, a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>, was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton

Refueling_Nyx_Both_Captial_Rank5.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> looking to be topped up with <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen and [QTFuel] SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4> at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Ella Tieno

Lima Endicott

HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_1AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near [Location|Address] got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CFPOutpost_EliminateAll.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available combat operators to [Location|Address]. A group of outlaws have launched an unprovoked attack and our security personnel are desperately in need of support.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

RR_Pyro_RatsNest_VE_Civilians_Salvage.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to Rat's Nest at the L5 Lagrange of Pyro V. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [Location|Address].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionD_CrimBase_MRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Just got a frantic comm from a [Ship] that cut out quite dramatically. Seems like they were dumb enough to get lured into a trap, even though I made it damn clear that getting those goods to Last Landings was all they should worry about.   
 
Well, it looks like they failed. Trackers hidden in the cargo now show it at [Location|Address]. Time to send in backup to reclaim our goods and teach a lesson to those who took it. You interested in delivering that message then delivering the goods?

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionD_CFPXSOutpost_StoleGoods.description:
Been looking for [Item], and one of our people inside CFP let me know some was just delivered to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Should only be a few soft CFP guards around for you to deal with. Then grab the shit and bring it to [Destination|Address].

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

CleanAir_DefendShip_Hard.description:
Everyone has been joining with Alliance Aid to help with the ongoing crisis in Levski, but it seems you can't do good in this 'verse without attracting the bad. One of the critical relief convoys was just attacked by a powerful outlaw fleet. We need you to <EM4>put together a fleet of your own</EM4> and deploy to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> as soon as possible. With any luck, you may be able to right this wrong before it's too late.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Patrol_Nyx_VeryEasy.description:
We need someone with combat experience to patrol a travel lane for us. Over the years, we’ve found that it's good to get out there and make ourselves visible. Sometimes a pilot like yourself traveling through an area is enough to deter any potential outlaws. But in case you run into any that are feeling a bit more ambitious, a ship ready for combat is recommended.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. After you’ve scanned all the waypoints and ensured that the route is secure, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

UnafilliatedHH_Pyro_RegionA_H_3AsteroidB.description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat. 

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting. 

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.  

Interested?

57 65 65 76 69 6c

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use [FuelType]. If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

Dina Deloit

HH_Pyro_RegionD_M_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows

WildstarRacing_Race6_YadarValley_OpenTra.description:
Looking to get some practice track time to improve your piloting skills? Then strap in and throttle up with Wildstar Racing Amateur League.

[RaceDetails]

DISCLAIMER
Wildstar Racing requires the contracted racer to be the vehicle pilot, no substitutes or stand-ins are allowed. Please be mindful that Wildstar Racing utilizes publicly accessible tracks and that other individuals may be present. SOO2_Intro.description:
Greetings,

Crusader Security Forces have contacted us seeking our expertise in dealing with an urgent situation. Several platforms near Orison have been overtaken by members of the Nine Tails gang and Northrock is eager to staff an operation to remove them and return the platforms to Crusader.

The Nine Tails have put measures in place to block all air traffic in the area, so we've been granted access to a secure shuttle that will take you, and any other members of your assault team, to the first platform.

For full disclosure, I must warn that this is not a contract for the faint of heart. I am confident though that your combat skills, you and your selected team will be fully up to the challenge. 

Once you've arrived at the shuttle I'll be in touch directly with more information.

Speak more soon,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

Head over as soon as you can. Lives are on the line.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

DeadSaints_Stanton_Super_RecoverCargo.description:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.

Head there with a crew of your own and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.

Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.

-Twitch

Hello,

Looking for a quick job? Got a client who's waiting on a shipment but our hauler ran into some engine trouble. Can't seem to get them up and running so we need someone to take over.

Fly out to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and you'll spot their ship. You can't miss it - it's the one that's sitting still in the middle of space. Make sure you bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> along with a decent ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Once you've picked up the goods take them to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TECH PREVIEW TESTING:

These ores can be mined from the caves on the surface of the planet that we require the ore to be delivered to. For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract."

EckhartSecurity_Stanton1_KillShip_CrimeF.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = [Contractor|ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Two bank guards were reported missing last week. A few hours ago, their bodies turned up in a trash heap in Magnus with their biometrics stolen. Thankfully, a nearby dumpling cart had a security camera that captured the corpses being dropped. Facial recognition was able to ID one Kass Dent, romantic partner to Maltrox Arlington and parent of Les Arlington. Using the vid to construct a timeline, we have provided the coordinates of where Kass is currently believed to be hiding. 

Kass is suspected of a long list of murders, with these two only being the most recent. We recommend only bringing highly skilled wingman to try and keep the casualty count at a minimum.  

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

GillysPilotSchool_Mission01.description:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing. 

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. <EM4>The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.</EM4>

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly    


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL 
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this?

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling. 

I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one. 

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and you'll need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4> without getting security involved. 
 
If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line. 

-Twitch

Unafilliated_Pyro_E_1AsteroidBase_Crimin.description:
Hey, 

We got the details on the location of a ship fit to burst with cargo. Sure, there may already be other people on the way to steal it, but there's probably more than enough loot to share, right?

It’s sealed up in an asteroid base hangar that you’ll need to access via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. 

If you want in on this free-for-all, just pay our administration fee and we'll send you the coordinates.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

Refueling_Pyro_Both_4M_Rank4.description:
Heyo,

Over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen and [QTFuel] SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4>. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run. 

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Adagio_RG_ShipSalvage_Pyro_Rank2_RMC_CMa.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. 

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, partly in thanks to how many outlaws are flying around in Pyro and partly because this request isn't for your average everyday component. But lucky for you, the extra effort will be rewarded.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Marcus Clenn

UEEVisitTheHalls_SimpleObjective.description:
Hello Citizens and Civilians,

The United Empire of Earth is proud to acknowledge the start of this year's Invictus ceremony. Originally started in 2542, the United Planets of Earth dispatched Naval ships to each of the settled planets to pick up the latest group of volunteers entering military service.

Now, over four hundred years later, Invictus continues this proud tradition of celebrating those among us who are standing up for others and protecting the Empire as well as showcasing the latest additions to the Naval fleet.

This year's festivities can be found on <EM4>ArcCorp in Stanton</EM4> and feature a great hall with some of the newest ships on display as well as the new <EM4>Idris Experience Tour</EM4> where you can tour an active-duty Idris, accessible at the top of the IO-North tower.

Accept this contract if you would like guidance to the festivities. As a special thank you, in partnership with the Mercenary Guild, attendees will be awarded [ScripAmount] scrip.

Thank you and enjoy your Invictus.
