Refueling_PyroNyx_Both_CapitalBattle_Ran.description:
Heyo,

Over at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen and [QTFuel] SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4>. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run. 

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Pyro_Intro.description:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a<EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.

You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that they fly by frequently. 

Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CFPOutpost_XTEliminateA.description:
XenoThreat forces launched an unprovoked attack near [Location|Address]. We're looking for any available combat operators to go and provide support. 

If you haven't dealt with them before, it's important to know that XenoThreat are trained fighters so this will not be an easy fight, but it's a necessary one.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Nyx_Tin_T.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Nyx System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location]

Reminder, all the <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton_R.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Covalex_Stanton_VeryEasy_RecoverCargo.description:
Hi,

So I had a contractor who was supposed to deliver some stuff for us but has completely gone off the radar. I've pinged their ship and I've got no idea what's happened but they're floating around somewhere over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. If you could head over there recover the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> you'd be doing me a huge favor.

Don't forget to bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move all the cargo. Oh and a ship that can transport <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_Solar_HH_StationT.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (<EM4>32 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>  

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

WildstarRacing_Race3_TheSkyScraper_TimeT.description:
Ready to set a new personal best with Wildstar Racing Amateur League?

[RaceDetails]

DISCLAIMER
Wildstar Racing requires the contracted racer to be the vehicle pilot, no substitutes or stand-ins are allowed. Please be mindful that Wildstar Racing utilizes publicly accessible tracks and that other individuals may be present. Wildstar Racing is not responsible for any damage your ship may suffer while racing.

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Nyx_Super.description:
Our crew at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised. 

Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionD_HH_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> to <EM4>Last Landings</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_FaunaCave_YangsPlace_.description:
Junior surveyor [TargetName] fell out of contact with their team while identifying potentially viable mineral seams in a cave near The cave can only be accessed on foot.. Wild animals have been known to frequent this location, which has led Citizens for Prosperity to believe that the surveyor may have been attacked while on the job and is currently stranded. 

We need someone to find them and render aid if at all possible. If it's too late and they're beyond help, it will at least comfort the rest of the team to know what happened to their friend. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionD_Rank0_LastLanding_Local_.description:
Hey if you’re reading this, we need a hand. An outpost of ours down at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> got hit by a nasty storm and suffered some damage. None of our usual techs are available (or alive) to swing by so we wanna hire someone to go fix some fuses (no idea how many but <EM4>no more than three</EM4> I think). If you can bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough RMC canisters to sort out around three pipes</EM4>, we should be good.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

RR_Pyro_Checkmate_Rank0_MissingPerson.description:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to [TargetName]. Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to [Location|Address] and find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_CrimBase_Rank2_MissingP.description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of [TargetName]. 

Last we saw, they were headed in the direction [Location|Address]. We need someone to head there and track down our missing Prospect. 

If you take any of them down while you're at it, all the better.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Redwind_Stanton_SmallGrade_Planetary_Con.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

Unafilliated_Pyro_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimin.description:
In some of the darker corners of spectrum, rumors are flying about a ship that’s overflowing with cargo and would make for the perfect score. But here’s the thing, we’ve accessed the location’s network and dug up some info these amateurs don’t have. The ship is locked down in an asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. Once inside, a console can override the lockdown of the hangar to get everything out of there.

We figure everyone in the system deserves a shot if they pay the price. Just send us a few credits and we'll share the coordinates with you.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

RR_Pyro_Orbituary_VE_Civilians_Salvage.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to Orbituary above Pyro III. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_1AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [Location|Address] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_Rank2_MissingP.description:
[TargetName], a mechanic who has performed countless services for our community, was abducted by a group of outlaws three standard days ago. CFP has received a ransom comm, but we refuse to negotiate with the types of people who actively work to destroy the peace in this system. If we open that door even once, we will never be safe. 

The outlaws known to have abducted [TargetName|Last]  were last seen entering [Location|Address]. CFP needs someone to infiltrate the base and confirm our missing person's whereabouts.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_OccuCave_ShepherdsRes.description:
Hey,

Some desperate crew raided one of our outposts and ran off with a bunch of essential supplies. A CFP member tracked them to The cave can only be accessed on foot. but didn’t have the right gear or training to raid the cave themselves. Better that we hire a skilled and well-prepared professional to take care of it for us. 

Here’s some other important intel you should know before taking the job. This crew seems to be based out of that cave and not just using it as a dead drop, so I’d expect that you’ll have to deal with them to get to the cargo. Next, you can bring everything you recover to Shepherd's Rest.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Be Safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_Solar_HH_StationT.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (<EM4>32 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>  

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_CFPOutposts_EliminateS.description:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named [TargetName]. Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty. 

Heard they're posted over at [Location|Address]. Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_YangsPlace_FPSSalvage.description:
Hi,

A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at Yang's Place, they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

EckhartSecurity_Mercenary_Intro.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Trial - Defend Location
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Eckhart Security is seeking skilled security professionals to join its ranks. If you believe that you have the disposition and experience to handle a wide variety of security contracts, then we encourage you to prove your proficiency by executing the contract below. 

Outlaws have been aggravating one of our clients by targeting their staff and operations. Based on the pattern established by previous attacks, we believe that these hostile forces will target <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> next. Successfully complete this contract to receive payment and more work opportunities from Eckhart Security. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_Rank3_LastLanding_Local_.description:
Sending a call out to anyone nearby. Got a pretty heavy work order for one of our outposts at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4>. Sounds like we need <EM4>six fuses</EM4> fixed. You'll also need a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough RMC to patch up about five pipes</EM4> to stop the place from falling apart.

If you bring all the shit needed to patch them up, we'll pay you out.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_Intro_EliminateAll.description:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we are looking for anyone with combat experience to help secure <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> that has been taken over by a group of outlaws.

We've tried to work with them but have only been met with violence and threats.

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_C.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_HHXSOutpost_RetrieveGoo.description:
Hi,

We’ve got a CFP team monitoring Headhunter activity at [Location|Address]. They let me know a batch of recently stolen CFP supplies were moved into it. Since there’s fewer defenses and personnel there, it feels like a good spot to strike and get our goods back. Interested?    

Do this right and the bigger outpost won’t know until it’s too late. Get in, get the goods, and then bring them to [Destination|Address]. Sound like a plan?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionD_HRT_CitizensForProsperit.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to [TargetName], who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around [Location|Address], so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_ShepherdsRest_XSOutpost_Local_1.description:
Hey, 

Some CFP members have put together a little care package for some folks living at <EM4>Shepherd's Rest</EM4>. Unfortunately, they got called away before they could drop it off. Feel like handling this one for us?    

The remote outpost isn’t too far away from the main outpost. Guess you could walk it, if you really want, but driving or flying it there would be a lot faster. Your choice.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_OccuCave_Courier.description:
Hi,

Our intel team intercepted a comm between Headhunters talking about how they stocked The cave can only be accessed on foot. with cargo stolen from us. Asked around about that cave and it’s been a known Headhunters cache for decades. Always seems to be staffed by grunts too. 

Know it’s risky but we really need to take our cargo back. You up for raiding that cave?

Do whatever you need to get our supplies back and then take them to [Destination|Address].

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P2M4-Stanton4_Repe.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
It would be helpful to have the most recent energy anomaly data so that we can compare it to what you delivered last time. Any difference between the two data sets could prove useful.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Engineering</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Energy Anomaly data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a <EM4>ASD Secure Drive</EM4> that you can collect at your home location.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_StationToOutpost_1box_Si.description:
Got a crate that needs to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. There’s a Clip waiting there for it. They’re a real nasty bastard too, so best not mess this up. 

Just grab the package from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Don’t do anything dumb with it, and you’ll be fine. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_OutpostToTradepost_3boxe.description:
Got some goods that need to be moved up the chain for us. There are a few boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to make their way to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.   

Never thought when I joined the Headhunters that supply chain management would be part of my job, but someone’s gotta keep the goods flowing, I guess. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

CleanAir_Killship_Hard.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Neutralize Ship 
APPROVAL CODE = RT-06

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

One of Nyx's local gangs, the Moraine, have been taking advantage of the current emergency happening in Levski and have one of their best pilots, <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, leading attacks against any Alliance Aid haulers they can get their hands on. At the rate they've been stealing supplies from the effort, unless they're stopped soon, its going to lead to whole bunch of sick people on Levski not getting the help they need.

We've been able to track the group to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, but before you head out, you're going to need to some recruiting of your own. Unless you <EM4>take a few wingmen with you</EM4>, not sure you'll be able to neutralize this particular outlaw pack. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Stan.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

HeadHunters_Nyx_Medium_RecoverCargo.description:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

Battaglia_MissingPersons_Medium.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Missing Persons

WORK BRIEF: 
A group of prospectors set out to look for some mining opportunities and haven’t been heard from since. We’re looking for someone to check in and see if they’re okay.

I'll send you <EM4>their last known location</EM4>. Just head out there and see what happened.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_CFPXSOutposts_XT_Elim.description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is targeting Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] to send a message to other settlers about what happens if they accept our support. 

If you’re able to fend off the attackers, I’m sure they’ll send additional forces, so you’ll need to dig in for multiple assaults. Since XenoThreat has a lot of resources at their disposal, you should think about recruiting others to help you keep everyone safe.

We’re all counting on you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_Lagrange_LRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Someone with a death wish attacked one of our ships hauling some primo product. Our crew on the scene is outta commission, so we need someone to get there fast and recover the stash before those bozos make off with it. Any chance you can handle this for us?  
  
Looks like the attack went down at [Location|Address]. Head over there and deal with the attackers before they get away. Then grab the goods from the [Ship] and take ‘em to [Destination|Address]. Oh, and don’t be an idiot and get high on that supply, unless you want me to send someone after you next. 

- Stows

Shubin_RG_Discovery_GroundMine_Pyro_Rank.description:

LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] 

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_OutpostToTradepost_5box.description:
Hey,

Just got word that <EM4>Bullock's Reach</EM4> has finished sorting and packing a few boxes of goods. Next step is for us to get them over to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Getting these goods sold will support CFP operations and show folks that good, honest work is possible in this system. You available for the run? 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_PAF_AtoB_Small_Slam_unproccessed.description:
I won’t bore you with the details, all you need to know is: one of our haulers got attacked and now our goods are sitting in a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. 

Up to you how you get the goods out, but if you happen to ghost a few of our rivals in the process, I ain’t complaining. Once you’ve got the stuff take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>, then we can sort your payment. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

Refueling_Stanton_NearLocation_Space_Mod.description:
Hey, you!

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use [FuelType]. If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

They're stuck out in an area with a bad reputation, though things have been a bit more quiet recently. Still worth staying alert I'd say, just in case there's still trouble lurking out there. 

Either way, the sooner everyone's able to get flying again - and that includes you - the better.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_ChainElimAll_1Cluster.description:
We learned that [Location|Address] is under threat of attack by outlaws and has asked for assistance. We need someone to protect them and drive away the outlaws. 

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_Stanton_GoldTungst.description:
Got a special assignment - Loads of packages ready to delivered across the system. Its a bit more than the usual so I'm only reaching out to my best contractors for this one.

Obviously, a part of that payment will be to cover your fuel because you'll be going super far with this one. You'll need all the usual as well like a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship with space to store <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Good luck. I'm counting on you.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_MissingPerson_Destroy.description:
I just have received confirmation that [TargetName], a Citizens for Prosperity courier, was captured by the Headhunters while transporting some critical data. 

We need you to investigate The Golden Riviera to discover what happened to [TargetName|First] and then destroy any Headhunter servers that may contain stolen data.

We're counting on you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Adaigo_Nyx_Lawful_Salvage_Hard.description: Be aware that due to the size of the Claim, a <EM4>Large Salvage Ship is recommended</EM4>.

CitizensForProsperity_DefendShip_Nyx_Ver.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy on a resupply run dropped a distress beacon near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. They’re not answering any comms, so I assume the situation is serious. That convoy has some skilled pilots, so if they’re not responding then they definitely need the help.

We’ll compensate you to support that convoy.  

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_FaunaCave_MissingPers.description:
Junior surveyor [TargetName] fell out of contact with their team while identifying potentially viable mineral seams in a cave near The cave can only be accessed on foot.. Wild animals have been known to frequent this location, which has led Citizens for Prosperity to believe that the surveyor may have been attacked while on the job and is currently stranded. 

We need someone to find them and render aid if at all possible. If it's too late and they're beyond help, it will at least comfort the rest of the team to know what happened to their friend. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
It appears that we've lost contact with a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity ships at [Location|Address] after they reported being attacked in their last comm. 

We believe they will be able to hold off the perpetrators until help arrives, but not indefinitely. We need you to rush to their coordinates and deal with the outlaws before its too late.

Unfortunately, we cannot afford even for a single of these vessels to be lost. As such, this contract will only be considered complete if all ships survive the onslaught. 

Can you help us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_TradepostToOutpost_5boxe.description:
Our crew at [Destination] needs a restock on some essentials. Looking for someone who can be trusted to move ‘em without any ‘slippage’ or other funny business.  

The boxes are waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need to be dropped at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any interest?   

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

Refueling_Pyro_Hard.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> looking to be topped up with [FuelType] at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_TradepostToOutpost_5box.description:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

There’s a few boxes waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that need to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Can you get those supplies to the outpost for us? This might be a simple supply run, but doing these consistently only strengthens our position in the system. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_CFPOutposts_EliminateA.description:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit [Location|Address]. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_UnocDerelict_MissingP.description:
One of our people, [TargetName], was supposed to be doing some preliminary scouting work over at Pyro III Abandoned Outpost, but they never reported in. We’re hoping that they just ran into some bad luck, but too often out here even the smallest misstep can prove fatal.

I’d appreciate someone heading that way and seeing if they can be located. It’d be great if you find them alive, but if not, some closure is the least we can do for their family.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Shubin_RG_Local_FPSMine_Pyro_LowQuantity.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for Volt weapons. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.

These ores can be mined from the caves on the surface of the planet that we require the ore to be delivered to. For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.



Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_OutpostToStation_1box_Si.description:
Looking for someone to hand deliver a cargo crate. The package has got to go from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Be fast and discreet about it, ok?  A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_CFPOutpost_Stage1_Regio.description:
We've received a distress call from [Location|Address]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Foxwell_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Pyro_Har.description:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the <EM4>Fuel Tanks and ships</EM4> in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage. 

If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully. 

Best of luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Tutorial_Part3_Area18.description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in Area18 finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the Cityflight transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around Area18 – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
There is a group of outlaws at [Location|Address] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_E_1AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near [Location|Address] got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?

-Stows

FTL_Courier_Stanton_Iron_Rank1.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
Junior-level courier needed for deliveries across the Stanton System.
Transportation must be provided by courier.
You will be <EM4>required to lift up to .25 SCU</EM4> in weight.
Couriers are responsible for the correct handling and safety of all packages charged to their care.

[Contractor|SignOff]

RedWind_Stanton_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
One of our people is currently under attack at [Location|Address]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away. 

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

TarPits_Stanton1_HDPC-Cassillo_Shipping_.description: I ain’t got time to waste so I’ll get straight to the point - [TargetName] needs to be dead and I want you to do it. You can find them over near the Shipping Area at Shipping Area. They won’t be alone, but don’t get distracted by those other useless piles. You only get paid for taking out [TargetName|Last].

ByGroup.GroupName: Squad B - Soldier or Tech x 2
Squad C - Soldier or Tech x 2
Squad D - Soldier or Tech x 2
Squad K - Soldier or Tech x1
Squad N - Soldier or Tech x 2 - Roaming
Squad O - Soldier or Tech x 2 - Roaming
Squad P - Soldier or Tech x 2 - Roaming

HeadHunters_Patrol_Pyro_Medium.description:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available? 

All you need to do is head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it. 

Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 


Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_TradepostToOutpost_5box.description:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

There’s a few boxes waiting at <EM4>Frigid Knot</EM4> that need to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Can you get those supplies to the outpost for us? This might be a simple supply run, but doing these consistently only strengthens our position in the system. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Stage1_RegionLink_ToReg.description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to <EM4>Sacren's Plot</EM4>, there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. To make your life easier, be sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_DerelictOutpost_Retriev.description:
Hi,

Bunch of basic goods needed at [Destination|Address] were stolen while in transit. Got a tip that the supplies were taken to Pyro VI Abandoned Outpost. Can you head there and reclaim them for us? 

The place is allegedly abandoned, but looks can be deceiving. My advice, prepare for the worst but hope for the best. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_CFP_Stat.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_OutpostToStation_1box_Si.description:
Looking for someone to hand deliver a cargo crate. The package has got to go from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>the entrance inside Gaslight at the L2 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4>. 

Be fast and discreet about it, ok?  A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionC_HHXSOutpost_EliminateAll.description:
It's sad to say but we lost one of our outposts to XenoThreat. Appalling if you ask me, but that's why we're looking for someone who's got the time and ammunition to take it back.

If that's you, head over to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and take it back.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Vaughn_Rockcracker_Warehouse_EliminateBo.description:
One of the leaders of the mysterious Claw Salamanders gang, a [TargetName], has worn out their welcome and has now become our problem to deal with. It's hardly a surprise figuring no one except their friends could understand what they're saying. 

Unfortunately, it won't be as easy as heading to [Location|Address] and dealing with them directly. Not only will you have to ensure the station is operational to reach them, it seems that you will have to draw them out of hiding too by taking out a fair number of their compatriots first.

Not the simplest of jobs, but I'm sure you'll rise to the occasion.

All the best,
Vaughn

RR_Pyro_Starlight_Local_1box_Single_Cour.description:
Any chance you’re at [Destination]?

Need a box hustled from <EM4>Starlight Service Station Entrance</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.   

-Smokey

HeadHunters_Patrol_Nyx_Super.description:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.  

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor that pulls it off. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank5_YangsPlace_Local_.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes</EM4>. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CleanAir_Courier_SpaceshipDerelict_ShipC.description:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid went down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to <EM4>Levski</EM4>. 

THREAT LEVEL – There is a strong chance that the courier was attacked by outlaws eager to acquire the vital supplies needed to stop the Molina mold out break in Levski. <EM4>Medium level engagements</EM4> expected.

TRAVEL –  All transportation needs should be arranged by courier. 

FTL Courier Services thanks you for helping us do our part for Alliance Aid.

UnafilliatedCFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_1Asteroid.description:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves? 

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Stanton_Hard.description:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops. 

There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.  

The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.  

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

HH_Pyro4_Med_Trdpst_Local_3box_Single_Co.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

WildstarRacing_Race1_LorvilleOutskirts_T.description:
Ready to set a new personal best with Wildstar Racing Amateur League?

[RaceDetails]

DISCLAIMER
Wildstar Racing requires the contracted racer to be the vehicle pilot, no substitutes or stand-ins are allowed. Please be mindful that Wildstar Racing utilizes publicly accessible tracks and that other individuals may be present. Wildstar Racing is not responsible for any damage your ship may suffer while racing.

Ling_Nyx_VeryEasy_RecoverCargo.description:
Hey,

Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?

Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship with enough space to store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.
 
Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll send you the creds.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton_A.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] 

Reminder, all the <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Refueling_Multi_Stanton_NearLocation_Mod.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FuelType]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Patrol_Nyx_Hard.description:
We’ve identified a sector that’s been plagued by outlaw attacks recently and hopefully, with your help, we can change that. We’d suggest <EM4>bringing some backup</EM4> in combat-ready ships to confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_Rank3_Regional_Handyman.description:
Need somebody handy with tools to pop over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and help out with some repairs. Our last repair guy knocked out most of the fixes but there's still some stuff that could use looking at.

I think if you've got <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to patch up around five pipes</EM4>, you should be covered.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

Battaglia_Salvage_Easy.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a call about <EM4>a derelict ship out near [Location]</EM4>. Ran the regtag through the system to make sure we weren't taking someone's ride but it looks unclaimed, so I need someone with a salvage ship to head out and break it down. 

Once you're done, <EM4>take the resources to Levski</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_RegionB_CFP_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_Rustville_XSOutposts_E.description:
Looking for any hitters available for a quick gig. Over at Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation], they're getting hit by some geniuses led by [TargetName]. We've tussled against [TargetName|Last] in the past so it's no surprise they haven't wised up. 

We want you to head there and take them down. Kill whoever you like, but [TargetName|Last] should be your focus.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_OutpostToTradepost_5boxe.description:
Got some goods that need to be moved up the chain for us. There are a few boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to make their way to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.   

Never thought when I joined the Headhunters that supply chain management would be part of my job, but someone’s gotta keep the goods flowing, I guess. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

EckhartSecurity_EscortShips_Nyx_VeryEasy.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client has requested a contractor with immediate availability to provide extra support to a number of ships leaving an asteroid base located at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>). Once you’ve accepted, rendezvous there and await further instructions. In this instance, your job is to provide support for their safe passage. Hostiles may be present, but they shouldn’t be too challenging to deal with.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_Rank0_VLRT_Criminals_Kil.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

[TargetName] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around [Location|Address], so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_FPSMine_Stanton_Rank.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

These ores can be mined on the surface of the planet or moon that we require the ore to be delivered to. For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Foxwell_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Stanton_.description:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the <EM4>Fuel Tanks and ships</EM4> in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage. 

If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully. 

Best of luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_XTBase_VHRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Hey,

One of our supply ships fell prey to a XenoThreat ambush. I’ll spare you the grisly details, but all that really remains is the cargo our people were carrying to [Destination|Address]. Trackers hidden within the cargo shows that XenoThreat collected the goods and then took them to a few locations spread out across [Location|Address].
 
We can’t let the XenoThreat get away with what they did to our crew and keep all those goods too. That’s why we want to strike back on both fronts. We need someone who can raid that location, retrieve the stolen cargo, and teach the Xenos that there will be consequences for their horrendous actions. Can you help us fight back?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Pyro_VeryE.description:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy? 

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.   

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,


Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
Junior-level courier needed for deliveries across the Stanton System.
Transportation must be provided by courier.

UEETrainingExercise2_KillShip.description:
Congrats on completing part one of this three-part course.

For your next patrol scenario, things are going to become even more intense.

Be prepared to encounter some hostiles and dogfight them in a realistic combat scenario just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol.

The hostile ships are all specially equipped rigs made specifically for training purposes and will be piloted by graduates of the flight school to provide an engaging and educational experience.

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #2 – Neutralizing a Hostile Threat</EM4>

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded [ScripAmount] MG Scrip.

Make sure you pick a ship ready for combat and I’ll see you out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Refueling_Pyro_Hydrogen_1XL_Rank5.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> looking to be topped up with <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

ORS_CA_Small.description:
Now then,

You might have heard about the recent attacks on the Orison platforms. Terrible stuff. The folks at Crusader are scrambling around trying to put it all back together and have contracted us to help.

To get them back on their feet what we need is construction materials. Can give you a decent pay packet for them too.

If you don't know already how to get construction materials, your best bet is to read United Resource Workers' <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4>. That'll set you on the right path.

Once you've got the order ready, you'll need to drop it all off at <EM4>Orison</EM4>.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

FoxwellEnforcement_Patrol_Pyro_Super.description:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.

Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.   

Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> at the end of the patrol.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimin.description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPXSOutpost_BombingRun.description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

RoX_SWA.description:
Multiple reports are coming in of XenoThreat ships massing at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
We're looking for contractors ready to take the fight to them. 

They want us to believe that they have right on their side. They want us to believe that they have overwhelming force. This is a chance to show them we know better.

I won't lie, this is more than just a simple security contract to me. I really hate those intolerant assholes and everything they stand for.

You with me?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

TarPits_Stanton1_S1ComplexB_Storage_Sabo.description:
I’m looking to send a strong message to the crew over at Storehouse and know the perfect way to do it - property damage.

All you need to do is head on over, destroy a few things here and there, and really drive home an important lesson about respecting your betters. 

Do that for me and I’ll be feeling very happy. And generous.

Interested?

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_TradepostToOutpost_5box.description:
Hi,

All the hard work the volunteers at Citizens for Prosperity have been doing is starting to pay off. Not only have we established outposts to house and protect people looking for a peaceful life, but our goal of making each outpost prosperous in their own right is coming to fruition.

There’s a handful of outposts that have produced some valuable commodities that are ready for pick up and delivery to <EM4>Frigid Knot</EM4>. Any chance you could swing by the outposts to grab the goods?

Here’s where everything needs to be picked up from: 

Pick up package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item5|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

As always, thanks for your help making this system a little brighter.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
