HH_Pyro_RegionD_H_MissingPerson_Eliminat.description:
We had this kid named [TargetName] volunteer to go take out some XenoThreat near Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Everything we knew about the place said it was gonna be too much for [TargetName|Last] to handle, but they were real keen on boosting their standing with the Headhunters and thought this would do it, so they went alone.

Haven't heard anything but XenoThreat comms coming out of that place since. If you want to go and knock it over, we'll pay you instead. If you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last] that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

Tutorial_Part1_Lorville.description:
Congratulations on taking your first steps into the universe!

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space. 

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionA_HH_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Rustville</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_DefendShip_Stanton_VeryHard.description:
One of our Clips is in a tight spot. Just got a comm from ‘em saying their convoy is being swarmed by the People’s Alliance and they need help on the double. Well, they said it in a more colorful way than that. All I’ll say is that I don’t want to hear what they’ll say to me if they don’t survive and are forced to regen. 

Situation must be serious if this Clip is freaking out. Really need you to get to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> immediately, and ensure that they make it out alive.

Stows out.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_GroundMine_Pyro_Rank.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

~[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_E_UnocCave_MissingPerson.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_TheGoldenRiviera_Elim.description:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm The Golden Riviera next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it. 

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely. 

Think you can rise to the occasion?  

-Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_OccuCave_Rustville_Mis.description:
We’re on the market for a new stash house, so I sent [TargetName] over to The cave can only be accessed on foot.. They were supposed to just have a quick look and report back to me if any of the hangars would work for us, but I haven’t heard from them since.

My guess is that someone else was already using the hangar, but I’d sleep better knowing for sure.

If the credits seem right, head over and see if you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. Just be careful. I’d hate to have to hire someone to find your body next.

Stows out.

Hockrow_Nyx_Medium_MissingPersons.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP74384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
We had sent in a two-person team to Nyx to investigate a case, but have received no reports from them for several days. At this juncture we are forced to assume that they had run into an unforeseen obstacle and may be in need of rescue, or worse, have been killed.


Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate <EM4>[MissingPersonList]</EM4> at <EM4>Central Core & Power</EM4> and confirm their status. 

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
Consider the dangerous nature of their investigation, there is a very strong chance there will be hostiles on site.

RedWind_Stanton_Super_RecoverCargo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

I’m not going dance around the issue, this is an extremely challenging job. You’ll need to bring a strong team of skilled pilots with you to deal with the outlaws that killed the previous contractor and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s cargo. That said, if you take on this contract, we will make it worth your time.

HOW DID WE DO – Complete our short feedback survey on our Spectrum page for a chance to enter our monthly prize draw.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutpost_MissingPe.description:
Unfortunately, one of our community partners, [TargetName], has been missing for a few days. Their family contacted Citizens for Prosperity for help and I told them we would do what we could. That said, with so much time passed, I’m not too hopeful.

Whatever their current state is, we're looking for someone to be our eyes on the ground for this one. There’s a strong chance that they were headed to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation], an area known to be very dangerous.

If you can track them down and confirm their status, one way or another, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_FaunaCave_Rustville_Mi.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Nyx_Hard.description:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops. 

There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.  

The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.  

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_Solar_HH_Tradepo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (<EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>  

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

EckhartSecurity_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Easy_V.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client of ours has been receiving anonymous threats in an attempt to blackmail them, and after a bit of leg work on our part, we’ve managed to trace it back to an individual who pilots a particular <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. The client wants us to take care of this blackmailer before they have a chance to make good. 

Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. They fly by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> on the regular, which has an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that’s an ideal spot to power down your ship and lie in wait. Sometimes the target is alone but they often travel with other single-seat ships as protection. Best be strategic when you launch your ambush or the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> could have a chance to get away. We don’t want to lose this one. We’ll alert other contractors in the area of the ambush so they can come help once it pops off.     

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client has also added a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Ruto_Stanton1_Illegal_DestroyItems_Narco.description:
A client of mine‘s trying to negotiate a deal, but isn’t having much luck. The other party feels like they got all the leverage because they’re sitting comfortably on a pile of inventory. To help move the negotiations along, I’m gonna need you to head down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Now, I should probably tell you that the site’s being protected by some very serious people, so getting to the stash is going to be a bit tricky, but I trust you’ll find a way.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_M_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
Need someone taken care of. They're holed up near [Location|Address]. Not sure if you care who they are, but their name's [TargetName]. Not much to tell, local thug who killed someone who was connected.

They've been on the run, so they're gonna be skittish. I'd approach with caution.

Stows out.

Adagio_Salvage_Nyx_Intro.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Nyx_.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

Foxwell_DefendDestructibleEntities_Stant.description:
One of our high priority clients is under attack from a criminal gang targeting their <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> in <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. The client’s assets are valuable, so we need to keep those safe at all costs, but I won’t kid – it’ll be a challenge and a half with these thugs determined to do some real damage. 

If it were me, I wouldn’t hesitate to <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. They’re no joke, so we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these guys successfully. 

Best of luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Headhunters_OLP_Theft.description:
With the Frontier Fighters stirring up shit in Pyro, Headhunters figured that it’d be good to take a look at our operations in Stanton. We want to be smart about it though. Don’t want to raise red flags by bringing too much gear through the jump, or hit civilian targets and get security forces on our ass. Instead, the plan is to work over the local outlaws first.  

Been picking up a lot of activity around <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Guess it just got a delivery of <EM4>[Item]</EM4> that has our name all over it. You wanna grab it for us?

Once you’ve got the stuff, bring it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. I’d get geared up before going. Sounds like the locals are pretty entrenched there.  

Stows out.

Battaglia_BoardShip_Intro.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Ship In Distress

WORK BRIEF: 
Got an urgent distress call from one of the Miners Amalgamated crews I sent out, saying they’re under attack by a gang that ambushed their ship. 

I need you to rush down there, board the <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> and help protect my people out there.

Please let me know ASAP if you can help.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon elimination of all targets.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

HH_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_HRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Need someone to raid a base at [Location|Address] for us. Not sure exactly who’s dug in there, but they attacked one of our ships and took the drugs they were hauling. Really need that shit back. That batch is full of high potency stuff that’s worth a premium. 

Doubt they’ll want to give it back to you, so plan to take it by force. Then bring the goods to Rustville. And don’t act like an idiot and get any ideas of what you could do with that stuff. Trust me, you don’t wanna get on my bad side. 

- Stows

Headhunters_OLP_EliminateBoss.description:
Not everyone is cut out to be a Headhunter. Some folks have too many screws loose even for us.  

<EM4>[TargetName]</EM4> ran with us in Pyro until they beat another member to death over a stupid game of Trigger. They fled to Stanton to hide out, but now that we’re expanding our footprint here, figure it’s the perfect time for payback.    

<EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> has been busy though. They’re running a crew that’s currently hunkered down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Head there and settle this grudge once and for all. I can’t imagine any of ‘em will go quiet, so best come prepared.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_Stage1_RegionLink_ToReg.description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to <EM4>Canard View</EM4>, there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. To make your life easier, be sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_OutpostToTradepost_5box.description:
Hey,

Just got word that <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> has finished sorting and packing a few boxes of goods. Next step is for us to get them over to <EM4>Jackson's Swap</EM4>. 

Getting these goods sold will support CFP operations and show folks that good, honest work is possible in this system. You available for the run? 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Battaglia_RecoverItem_VeryEasy.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
Received a tip about <EM4>a ship that had been attacked at [Location]</EM4>.  Apparently it's been there for a little while, but the Governing Committee would like to know how it got there. 

We're looking for someone to go out, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and bring it to Levski</EM4> so we can figure out what happened. 

Just a reminder, the blackbox isn't small, so <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P2M4-Stanton4.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
The seismic data you extracted had some interesting revelations. My expert says she thinks that Jorrit might have been excavating down there. Hate to think what he’s doing, but it's our job to find out. I think we’re close to cracking this, so I want you to go back to Onyx and gather the Power Usage data. If we can track energy flow from the last couple months, a pattern should reveal itself. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Engineering</EM4> wing and <EM4>upload the Power Usage data</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll be sending you <EM4>10 Secure Drives</EM4> with copies of the information we've gathered so far. You can collect them at your home location.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_StationToOutpost_1box_S.description:
Hey, 

Every once and awhile, Citizens for Prosperity likes to surprise members stationed at our outposts with a little gift to keep morale high. We’ve got the next box ready to go from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>, but need someone to make the delivery for us. Any interest in spreading some good cheer?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_H_XTXSOutpost_MissingPe.description:
Unfortunately, one of our community partners, [TargetName], has been missing for a few days. Their family contacted Citizens for Prosperity for help and I told them we would do what we could. That said, with so much time passed, I’m not too hopeful.

Whatever their current state is, we're looking for someone to be our eyes on the ground for this one. There’s a strong chance that they were headed to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation], an area known to be very dangerous.

If you can track them down and confirm their status, one way or another, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_H_3AsteroidBase_XenoThr.description:
Hey, 

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. [TargetName] stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near [Location|Address], which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of [TargetName] but also the cargo, which is really needed at [Destination|Address]. If you find it and complete the delivery, it would be a huge help to the CFP members there.   

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to [Location|Address] and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_1AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [Location|Address] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_ChainElimAll_1Cluster_.description:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [Location|Address] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.

Vaughn_Rockcracker_Opsroom_EliminateSpec.description:
There is a member of the Nyx gang the Claw Salamanders, [TargetName], who has made it on to my naughty list. They had been on the run for quite awhile, but just recently popped back up at an old mining station in the Keeger Belt. Our lucky day shall be their last.  

Word is that you can find them at [Location|Address].  Unfortunately, there is a strong chance you may have to do some repairs to the station itself before you can gain access to that particular area.

But I'm sure you're more than up to the challenge.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Ling_Stanton_VeryEasy_RecoverCargo.description:
Hey,

Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?

Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship with enough space to store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.
 
Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll send you the creds.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_To_RegionB_RegionLink_5.description:
Hi,

It’s incredible how many Citizens for Prosperity locations have started to thrive throughout the system. To sustain these locations, we need to be able to move important supplies between them. Got one such important run here, if you’re interested.  

There’s a few boxes of goods waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that need to cross the system to <EM4>Frigid Knot</EM4>. Could you move them for us and help us all build a better future?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPXSOutpost_EliminateAl.description:
Here's the deal. Some of those mercs that CFP hired as security went and shot up some Headhunters that were just moving through the system. They weren't even doing anything, just flying.

Anyway, we tracked them back to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and want to dish out some payback. Grab your gear and be our weapon, we'll make it worth your while.

- Stows

EckhartSecurity_Stanton1_KillShip_CrimeF.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = [Contractor|ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Maltrox Arlington has been keeping a low profile recently, but we think he's come out of hiding. A patrol was refueling at a station when one of their ships was boosted. Maltrox is the most likely suspect. While the regtag was temporarily deactivated, we have been able to trace the ship’s quantum signature and have provided you those coordinates.

A third generation criminal, the Arlington gang has been under Maltrox’s leadership for the past six years. Be aware, this is a smart, aggressive, and very dangerous target. The more resources you can bring to bear, the more likely it is that we can bring Maltrox in one and for all. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Covalex_Pyro_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hi, it's El.

Need a hauler for a job ASAP. One of our contractors had a "personal emergency" and had to ditch their ship and it seems like they're not coming back. Not ideal, really.

Good news is the cargo is still intact, at least according to the tracker. It'd be a huge win for me if you could finish the job by grabbing the cargo at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and bringing it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Seems like this was a pretty big one, you'll need a ship that can transport <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move it all. Really appreciate your help.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. Adagio_RG_ShipSalvage_Pyro_Rank2_RMC_CMa.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>.  We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Ve.description:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens. 

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>, was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.  

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support. 

You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_Rank0_VLRT_Criminals_Kil.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

[TargetName] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around [Location|Address], so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionA_CFP_Stat.description:

----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Sunset Mesa</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_C.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TargetName] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TargetName|Last] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [Location|Address] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

EckhartSecurity_Stanton1_KillShip_CrimeF.description:

CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = [Contractor|ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington was flagged by automated security systems at an R&R after being involved in a drunken brawl. Weepy was able to clear the station before response teams arrived, but we have been able to track him down to where we currently think he’s holed up.

Weepy is gang leader Maltrox Arlington’s uncle and main enforcer. His anger issues combined with a long history of substance abuse make him a true wildcard. Expect him to put up significant resistance when cornered by you and your mustered forces.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPOutposts_ChainElimina.description:
Headhunters are launching an attack near Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. This ex-Marine asshole named [TargetName] has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, [TargetName|Last] has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, [TargetName|Last] may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows

Deacon Tobin

-Stows out

HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnima.description:

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out

HH_Pyro_RegionD_DerelictOutpost_Eliminat.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

- Stows out.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Easy_V.description:
Any interest in taking out a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> for us?

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Rank5_ShepardsRest_Loca.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes</EM4>. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Stage1_RegionLink_ToReg.description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to <EM4>Jackson's Swap</EM4>, there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. To make your life easier, be sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Unafilliated_Pyro_H_3AsteroidBase_XenoTh.description:
So, in a bit of good luck we got the details on a XenoThreat ship that's overflowing with cargo. Now, as it turns out, we're not the only ones who are thinking this sounds ripe for the taking and it seems there may be a few others looking to take advantage of the situation already, but a little competition never hurt anyone, right?

Thing is that the ship is locked down in an asteroid base hangar that you’ll need to access via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. If you're interested in getting one over on these xenophobic thugs, or are just looking for a top-notch score, then pay our admin fee and we'll send you the coordinates.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_XTBase_VHRT_1_MultiDefe.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy transporting urgently needed supplies took a riskier route in order to save time and are savagely being attacked by the XenoThreat. Your combat skills are urgently needed to aid in their defense.

Head to [Location|Address] as soon as you can. We'll see you well compensated for your assistance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Shubin_RG_Discovery_FPSMine_Pyro/Nyx_Ran.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Nyx System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on <EM4>Daymar and Aberdeen</EM4>. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_Lagrange_VLRT_DefendShip.description:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near [Location|Address]. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Pyro_Super.description:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack. 

Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the [AmbushTarget] is aggressive and battle hardened.        

You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> in it for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_C.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

Battaglia_ScanMineRocks_Golem.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Extra Special Job

WORK BRIEF: 
You've been doing some excellent work for us lately and wanted to offer a special job with a special reward. I'm looking for some more data, so I need someone <EM4>to scan [AmountToScan] of Savrillium and [AmountToScan2] of Lindinium</EM4> and send me what you find. These are pretty rare resources, so they might be tricky to find.

By this point you know what you're doing but just going to remind you that <EM4>the United Resource Workers' mining journal on your mobi is great if you're stuck.</EM4>

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
Polished up a special Drake Golem from Teach's for this one.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

HH_Pyro_RegionD_CFPOutpost_BombingRun.description:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at Canard View and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out

UnafilliatedCFP_Pyro_RegionC_M_2steroidB.description:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them? 

But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you. 

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

Unaffiliated_Pyro_RegionC_VH_Salvage.description:
Been given some primo info that could be a boon for both of us. Someone took out a XenoThreat hauler near [Location|Address]. It must have some sweet, sweet salvage because a Xeno recovery team was there and working that site almost immediately. Would be a real shame if someone else showed up, knocked out the other Xeno ships, and then claimed all that salvage for their own. 

I’ve got a few colleagues interested in the action themselves, but Rough & Ready members getting caught there would only look like we’re taking sides. Would be much better if an unaffiliated force stepped in to deliver the surprise strike. 

Figure we can all win here. I’ll sell you the coordinates to the wreck, and you can clear out the XenoThreat forces and then pick it all apart. Pretty sure they’ll put up a fight for it, but just come in prepared and consider all that collateral damage as more profit off salvage. 

- Smokey

Adagio_RG_ShipSalvage_Stanton_Rank1_RMC_.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. 

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, even with the amount of ships buzzing through a system as populated as Stanton, so don't be surprised if you have to put a bit more effort into hunting down what's needed.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

ORS_MA_HaulingSmall.description:
Hey, it’s El.

Need a reliable contractor for a pretty important delivery today. I’m sure you’re aware of what went down in Orison, big commotion. Made my job about ten times harder.

Anyway, we’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver some medical stuff to <EM4>Orison</EM4>. Pick up’s at <EM4>[Location|Target|Address]</EM4>. Shouldn’t be too heavy an order for this one, just make sure you’ve got a ship that can hold <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, or you’ll really embarrass yourself when you get there.

Look, I’ll level with you. This job isn’t just hauling for hauling’s sake. Orison got pretty messed up by those Nine Tails, so anything we can do to help them out is probably the right thing to do.

Let’s get it done,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

HuntThePolaris_FleetWeek2025.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

This is a call to arms for all available Civilian Defense Force volunteers. An RSI Polaris corvette on its way to Invictus Launch Week festivities has been hijacked by the terrorist organization the Frontier Fighters. Initial intelligence reports indicate they’re attempting to escape into the Pyro system.

The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support immediately to neutralize this threat and prevent the Frontier Fighters from escaping with the stolen capital ship.  Additionally, as a further incentive, those who assist us in this endeavor will be awarded <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> along with a small token of our appreciation.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott

InterSec_Nyx_TSG_Solo_WeakenDefences.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ships w/Ordnance
Briefing: 
Regional analysis indicates that there is a suspected Shattered Blade hideout in an old QV Extraction station and Intersec is looking for a pilot to launch an attack against the station's power infrastructure.

This will be a multi-tiered assault, requiring you to target and destroy station components on the exterior and interior. From previous operations, we've learned that <EM4>certain components cannot be destroyed by energy weapons, so ballistic or ordnance will be needed</EM4>. Parts of the station have historically been flooded with <EM4>heavy distortion energy, so you will need to act efficiently while inside</EM4>.

These attacks are all an effort to allow you to<EM4>destroy the now-exposed power core at the center</EM4>.

The loss of this station will greatly impact the gang's ability to operate in the system and so has been deemed a high priority.

Good luck,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

Ling_Stanton_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hello,

Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.

We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll take care of the rest.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_Stanton_Agricultur.description:
Hi,

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_Solar_CFP_Station.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (<EM4>32 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>  

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_E_FaunaCave_LastLandings.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

WildstarRacing_Race1_LorvilleOutskirts_O.description:
Looking to get some practice track time to improve your piloting skills? Then strap in and throttle up with Wildstar Racing Amateur League.

[RaceDetails]

DISCLAIMER
Wildstar Racing requires the contracted racer to be the vehicle pilot, no substitutes or stand-ins are allowed. Please be mindful that Wildstar Racing utilizes publicly accessible tracks and that other individuals may be present. Wildstar Racing is not responsible for any damage your ship may suffer while racing.

EckhartSecurity_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Medium.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Need someone to take out a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and deal with the escort ships protecting it. They’ve already interfered with several of our ongoing operations and have become a real problem across several of Eckhart Security cases. Not sure what their endgame is, but it won’t matter once you deal with them.

We’ve let slip that we will be working a job over at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> which should serve as bait to draw them out. The spot is ideal for an ambush because of the <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that’s a perfect place to power down and hide until you’re ready to strike. If you’re available, the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and its escorts should be passing through soon.   

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The main contractor will also receive a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton4_.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for a heavy Antium armor set. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.


[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract."

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.

As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

ORS_Cr_Small.description:
Now then,

After the Nine Tails attack, the folks at Crusader could do with more than just a helping hand. What they need are proper propulsors to help replace the ones damaged in the attacks.

We've attached a blueprint outlining what materials you'll need to create them. Up to you whether you go out and find those materials yourself or buy them from a trader. Either way you will need access to an Item Fabricator to make the propulsors yourself.

Once you're done bring them to <EM4>Orison</EM4> and one of the team will sort out the rest.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

HH_Pyro_RegionD_Rank3_Regional_Handyman.description:
Need somebody handy with tools to pop over to <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> and help out with some repairs. Our last repair guy knocked out most of the fixes but there's still some stuff that could use looking at.

I think if you've got <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to patch up around five pipes</EM4>, you should be covered.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

Adagio_RG_FPSSalvage_Pyro_Canisters_S0Co.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and components by stripping abandoned ships and removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

InterSec_Bounty_Nyx_Intro.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has been hired to combat the rising number of outlaws using Nyx as a staging ground for their operations, with the intention of attacking neighboring UEE systems.

As a preventative measure, we require you to travel to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and eliminate the ringleader <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4> to deter their planned attack on Stanton. They and their crew are highly dangerous and you are <EM4>advised  to bring a wingman</EM4> for support.

Contractors who can prove themselves reliable and competent in executing operations will be eligible for future missions with InterSec.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

Refueling_Pyro_Hydrogen_3XL_Rank6.description:
Heyo,

Over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4>. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run. 

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Eckhart_Nyx_VLRT_DefendShip.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

RR_Pyro_DudleyAndDaughters_Local_1box_Si.description:

Need a box hustled from <EM4>the entrance inside Dudley & Daughters at the L4 Lagrange of Pyro VI</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.   

-Smokey

CFP_Pyro_BlackrockExchange_Local_4boxes_.description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearOutHostiles_Nyx_.description:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to [Location|Address] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_MRT_RetrieveCa.description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at [Destination]. 

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to [Destination|Address]. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_TradepostToOutpost_3boxe.description:
Our crew at [Destination] needs a restock on some essentials. Looking for someone who can be trusted to move ‘em without any ‘slippage’ or other funny business.  

The boxes are waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need to be dropped at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any interest?   

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_RegionD_HH_RuinTo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

They're doing a clean out at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> and have a bunch of <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> or smaller waste containers that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots. (Don't ask me why. They're paying us is all I know.)

**CONTRACT DETAILS**

[Contractor|SignOff]

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_RegionC_HH_Statio.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Gaslight at the L2 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4> to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_CFP_Trad.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_RegionA_CFP_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Nyx_.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>Fuel Tanks</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutposts_Sabotage.description:
Something just fell into my lap that is way too good to pass up. XenoThreat's intelligence gathering is a bit of legend in the circles I run in and it turns out that they're storing a whole heap of their best intel at Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation].

Would be a shame if someone, say like you, were to go there and blow it all up, huh? 

-Stows out

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Nyx_.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_HH_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL

HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_MissingPerson_DestroyI.description:
I'm not having the best day so far. I sent [TargetName] out to do a bit of destruction at [Location|Address]  and I haven't heard from them. 

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to [TargetName|NickOrFirst]. And whatever the case, I want you to make sure their job is finished.

-Stows out

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_VeryEasy.description:
Some numskull flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimin.description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to [Location|Address] and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CleanAir_Bulk_VentFilters_System-To-Syst.description:
Hey,

Help us put an end to the People's Affliction by hauling new vent filters to places that need replacements. 

Here's a run of them from <EM4>Everus Harbor</EM4> to <EM4>Levski</EM4>. This is a large scale haul, so bring a ship that can fit everything. The manifest also specifies that that largest container you'll be dealing with is <EM4>16 SCU</EM4>. Would strongly recommending bringing a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to deal with those. 

Thanks for joining us and Alliance Aid to help bring this crisis to an end!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Stan.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>Fuel Tanks</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

HWS_PAF_KillKopions.description:
We’ve recently received reports from our team in <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, that a particularly virile pack of kopions are causing a surge in numbers. As a result, their prey is being over hunted, and if left unattended, will ultimately lead to the starvation of the kopion population there.

We are looking for a skilled contractor to cull this pack of kopions in a swift and efficient manner, assisting with bringing a natural equilibrium back to <EM4>[Location]</EM4>. Access to combat equipment, transport, and a familiarity with wild and unpredictable animals are all required for this job.

For further details on the targeted creatures, please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_StantonDC_MedgelMe.description:
Hi,

Looking for a contractor with a ship that can carry <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4> to run a delivery for us across Stanton.

This isn't a particularly long delivery route, but you will be moving between couple of different locations. To make sure things go smoothly, bring enough fuel and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to speed up moving the boxes.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_TradepostToOutpost_3box.description:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

There’s a few boxes waiting at <EM4>Jackson's Swap</EM4> that need to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Can you get those supplies to the outpost for us? This might be a simple supply run, but doing these consistently only strengthens our position in the system. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Based on evidence extracted from the ASD facilities, we’ve potentially managed to track down the location of one of their storage sites.

Once accepted, head over to the old <EM4>QV Planet Services Logistics station</EM4> and we’ll be in touch.


Respectfully, 

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

EckhartSecurity_DC_Stanton1_SakuraSun-Ma.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4> and their crew were identified executing a raid on <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. If their MO holds true, <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again. 

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.    

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_MRT_DefendShip.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
