CleanAir_Killship_Medium.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Neutralize Ship 
APPROVAL CODE = RT-05

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

It seems that the People's Alliance aren't the only ones eager to get their hands on the resources needed to fight their Molina Mold outbreak. The Moraine gang has been hitting the shipping lanes hard trying to get their hands on as many haulers as they can. One particular member, <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, and their crew have been especially successful, knocking over over a dozen ships. The folks organizing Alliance Aid are pretty eager to see this growing problem dealt with.

Recent reports have their hunting grounds over near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Head there with any support ships you want to take and neutralize them before any more vital supplies are lost. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_HHXSOutpost_Sabotage.description:
With the recent aggression perpetrated by the Headhunters against our people, Citizens for Prosperity has been arranging a full operation that should hopefully deal them a significant blow. 

However, before that can happen, we need to by some more time to finish our preparations. If you could destroy the power generators at Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] it should stall the Headhunters long enough for us to ready our counter attack. 

Your assistance will be critical to our success,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Refueling_Pyro_Both_1XL_2L_Rank5.description:
Heyo,

Over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen and [QTFuel] SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4>. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run. 

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_HHOutpost_MissingPers.description:
One of our people, [TargetName], was supposed to be doing some preliminary scouting work over at [Location|Address], but they never reported in. We’re hoping that they just ran into some bad luck, but too often out here even the smallest misstep can prove fatal.

I’d appreciate someone heading that way and seeing if they can be located. It’d be great if you find them alive, but if not, some closure is the least we can do for their family.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_Lagrange_LRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Someone with a death wish attacked one of our ships hauling some primo product. Our crew on the scene is outta commission, so we need someone to get there fast and recover the stash before those bozos make off with it. Any chance you can handle this for us?  
  
Looks like the attack went down at [Location|Address]. Head over there and deal with the attackers before they get away. Then grab the goods from the [Ship] and take ‘em to Rustville. Oh, and don’t be an idiot and get high on that supply, unless you want me to send someone after you next. 

- Stows

HeadHunters_Patrol_Nyx_VeryEasy_V.description:
Headhunters want some intel on what’s happening around territory. We’ve already set up some monitoring satellites, but nothing beats a good ol’ patrol. You up for it?

If so, get on over to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimin.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [Location|Address].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Nyx_Super_RecoverCargo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

I’m not going dance around the issue, this is an extremely challenging job. You’ll need to bring a strong team of skilled pilots with you to deal with the outlaws that killed the previous contractor and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s cargo. That said, if you take on this contract, we will make it worth your time.

HOW DID WE DO – Complete our short feedback survey on our Spectrum page for a chance to enter our monthly prize draw.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_E_UnocCave_MissionPerso.description:
[TargetName] is a local who only has done a few jobs for Citizen for Prosperity, but they had promise. That is, until they went missing while exploring [Location|Address] last week. Unfortunately, we didn’t hear about it until today. Chances of survival at this point are pretty slim, but we still think its worth confirming what happened to them.
 
CFP could use help on this if anyone is interested. And besides being a good deed, the payment should make it worth the effort. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_H_3AsteroidBase_XenoThr.description:
Hey, 

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. [TargetName] stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near [Location|Address], which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of [TargetName] but also the cargo, which is really needed at [Destination|Address]. If you find it and complete the delivery, it would be a huge help to the CFP members there.   

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro2_Sml_Trdpst_Local_3box_Single_Co.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

HeadHunters_DefendDestructibleEntities_N.description: A band of hired guns has been sent to mess with our interests over at Asteroid Mining Base. Seems someone has been tipped off that if the Fuel Tanks there are destroyed that it will severely interrupt Headhunter operations in the area. That's a problem I want you to fix. Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor [ScripAmount] Council Scrip for a job well done. Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_H_MissingPerson_DestroyI.description:
I'm a bit at the end of my rope. I had sent [TargetName], a pretty dependable Headhunter, out to destroy the XenoThreat data servers at [Location|Address].

That was a while ago and I still haven't heard from them and the servers are still sitting there intact. 

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to [TargetName|NickOrFirst] and help finish destroying the servers.

-Stows out

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank5_JacksonsSwap_Loca.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes</EM4>. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Need a hand taking care of some scrap at Seer's Canyon. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds.

Ruto_StantonStar_Illegal_ClearCrimestat_.description:
Hi there. We haven’t had a chance to work together yet but I’m in a bit of a bind here and I could use another body. Not for nothing, of course. I’m all for a good quid pro quo.

One of my associates who was serving some time in Klescher was supposed to bring me a datachip, but then they went quiet. Now I’m assuming they’re dead, but here’s the deal: if you finish his job, I wipe your crimestat. Not bad, right?

Your predecessor was apparently planning on using some old tunnels to make his escape. He made it sound like they weren't exactly the easiest thing to access, but I trust you can figure it out. I'm guessing you'll find his body somewhere in there and if we’re lucky, he'll still have the chip on him.

Once you get it, finish getting out however you can. Then get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. You might want to watch out for Hurston Security, though. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them. After I get the data and validate it, I’ll wipe your crimestat. 

Then you can go and enjoy your newfound freedom. If you do this right, maybe I’ll have more lucrative work for you down the line.

FoxwellEnforcement_Patrol_Pyro_Medium.description:
A client is concerned about activity near some of their interests. We’ve been contracted to patrol the area and run scans at several locations. Interested? If so, head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD to start the patrol.

The client wasn’t specific about the threats, but they don’t think everything’s on the level out there. Hopefully we’ll be able to bring them some peace of mind.

Additionally, the client arranged for us to offer a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor.


Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutposts_Sabotage.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation].

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_CrimBase_Rank1_MissingPe.description:
Sent [TargetName] out to check out a strange noise in one of our storehouses and haven't heard from them in a while. Turns out they got themselves kidnapped. We've got intel that says they're being held at [Location|Address], but we're not sure about the source. Need someone to swing by and make sure the info is legit.  

Whether it's good news or bad, there are some creds in it for you. 

Stows out.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Pyro_Medium.description:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?

Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike. 

The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours. 

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount]</EM4> Council Scrip to sweeten the pot. 

- Stows

Ling_Pyro_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hello,

Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.

We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll take care of the rest.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearOutHostiles_Pyro.description:
Recently we've had incident reports of numerous Citizens for Prosperity contractors in the system having run-ins with an outlaw hunting party operating out of [Location|Address]. 

To help re-establish safer routes through that sector, you will be dispatched to head there and engage with these outlaws. The group is known to travel in smaller packs, so its important that you and whatever backup you bring wait in the area to deal with all of them or else there's a chance the threat will remain. 

Thank you for helping us,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_XTBase_Rank3_ChainMissi.description:

HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_GenericXSOutposts_Elim.description:
Got a crew that's been hitting Headhunter ships lately. Their leader's a real piece of work named [TargetName]. We've tracked them to  Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation], so we're looking for someone to put them down for good.

This group likes to fight, but shouldn't be a problem for someone like you. 

Get over there and get it done.

Stows out.

FoxwellEnforcement_DestroyNarcotics_Hard.description:
Reports of a spike in drug overdoses around Stanton has security services worried. Seems like some two-bit crew is juicing their profits by cutting their stuff with toxic chemicals. Shutting down this crew and stopping the distribution of their drugs has become a top priority.

A Foxwell informant has revealed that part of this crew has currently set up shop at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Hiring a contractor to hustle over there and destroy whatever drugs they’ve got stashed before they’re spread across the system. Better be careful though, word is this crew is armed to the teeth and determined to profit off that poison no matter what.


Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Foxwell_DefendDestructibleEntities_Pyro_.description:
Any willing pilots in the area? Need some protection around <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> for a client. A band of outlaws has been targeting their <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4>, and if nothing's done about it they'll do some real damage. Need someone to protect the client’s property as much as possible and deal with the thugs.

From the intel we’ve managed to gather, these thugs are small-time but can cause some pain if you’re not careful. So, if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton_L.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti_Interstellar_Med.description:
One of our best distributors got busted in Stanton so we need a replacement. The guy was an incredible salesman, but a shit smuggler. We need someone who won't run face-first into a security patrol or a pack of pirates to pick up some merchandise at these locations:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>

And bring it all to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> before security catches on to what's happening. You'll need enough space on your ship for size <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> containers, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> should make loading and unloading nice and easy. 

-Twitch

HeadHunters_Patrol_Pyro_VeryHard.description:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off? 

If so, start by seeing what’s around the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing <EM4>two friends</EM4> to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Stows out.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton_L.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] 

Reminder, all the <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_StationToOutpost_1box_Si.description:
Got a crate that needs to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. There’s a Clip waiting there for it. They’re a real nasty bastard too, so best not mess this up. 

Just grab the package from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Don’t do anything dumb with it, and you’ll be fine. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_MRT_MultiDefen.description:
It appears that we've lost contact with a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity ships at [Location|Address] after they reported being attacked in their last comm. 

We believe they will be able to hold off the perpetrators until help arrives, but not indefinitely. We need you to rush to their coordinates and deal with the outlaws before its too late.

Unfortunately, we cannot afford even for a single of these vessels to be lost. As such, this contract will only be considered complete if all ships survive the onslaught. 

Can you help us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

DeadSaints_Nyx_VeryHard_RecoverCargo.description:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.

Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Grab a crew you can trust and your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and get your ass over there.

After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.

-Twitch

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_Stanton_WasteScrap.description:
Hi,

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Pyro_Hard.description:
Recently, a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.

Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us? 

It’ll be you against the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>, other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.   

Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_Rank5_Regional_Handyman.description:
The storms over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> are getting to be a real pain in the ass. One of our outposts got absolutely reamed yesterday and needs some serious repairs so we're looking for help.

Figure you'd need to bring <EM4>about six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to deal with at most eight busted pipes</EM4>. We think that’ll cover, but you'll get exact numbers on site.

Hell with this place.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, that <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CrimBase_MRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Just got a frantic comm from a [Ship] that cut out quite dramatically. Seems like they were dumb enough to get lured into a trap, even though I made it damn clear that getting those goods to [Destination|Address] was all they should worry about.   
 
Well, it looks like they failed. Trackers hidden in the cargo now show it at [Location|Address]. Time to send in backup to reclaim our goods and teach a lesson to those who took it. You interested in delivering that message then delivering the goods?

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_CrimBase_MRT_RetrieveCa.description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at [Destination]. 

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to [Destination|Address]. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_CFPOutposts_EliminateS.description:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named [TargetName]. Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty. 

Heard they're posted over at [Location|Address]. Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.

Foxwell_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Stanton_.description: An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to [Location|Address] as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s Fuel Tanks and of their ships that may need assistance. This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site. If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering [ScripAmount] MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on. Stay safe, and good luck, Kevin Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Lagrange_LRT_DefendShip.description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_CFP_Stat.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

BountyHuntersGuild_Bounty_Pyro_Super.description:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TargetName] 
SYSTEM: Pyro
RISK ASSESSMENT: Extreme-Risk Target (Sub-Capital Class Vessel, Heavy Support)
LAST KNOWN LOCATION:  [Location|Address]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: XenoThreat
NOTES: Xenothreat has consistently displayed unprovoked aggression against any law enforcement or security personnel. There is a good chance that they might have other gang members when confronted so exercise caution when engaging.


BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_CFPXSOutposts_ChainElimi.description:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at  [Location|Address] and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.

But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.

Stows out.

FTL_Courier_Stanton_TissueSamples_Rank0.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the <EM4>ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes</EM4>.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

[Contractor|SignOff]

InterSec_Patrol_Nyx_Super.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: There's a growing concern that Vanduul hunting parties are pushing further into Nyx. The first line of defense against this encroachment is increased patrols. InterSec has identified a sector that has seen an uptick in Vanduul activity and are looking for someone to patrol the region and provide an update on it.

You'll begin your patrol at a <EM4>location marker</EM4> sent to your HUD and then scan a series of waypoints along a designated route. The Vanduul ships in this sector are highly skilled and aggressive, so InterSec highly recommends that you <EM4>bring several combat-ready ships along as backup</EM4>.

InterSec understands the immense danger you'll be under on this patrol, so we'll send a special bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor once the sector is clear.      

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_OccuCave_YangsPlace_C.description:
Hey,

Some desperate crew raided one of our outposts and ran off with a bunch of essential supplies. A CFP member tracked them to The cave can only be accessed on foot. but didn’t have the right gear or training to raid the cave themselves. Better that we hire a skilled and well-prepared professional to take care of it for us. 

Here’s some other important intel you should know before taking the job. This crew seems to be based out of that cave and not just using it as a dead drop, so I’d expect that you’ll have to deal with them to get to the cargo. Next, you can bring everything you recover to Yang's Place.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Be Safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_To_RegionC_RegionLink_5.description:
Hi,

It’s incredible how many Citizens for Prosperity locations have started to thrive throughout the system. To sustain these locations, we need to be able to move important supplies between them. Got one such important run here, if you’re interested.  

There’s a few boxes of goods waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that need to cross the system to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Could you move them for us and help us all build a better future?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_To_RegionD_RegionLink_5b.description:
Headhunters got people placed all across the system. Keeping them all stocked and ready to rock if something goes down is essential to our success. Got a cargo run here that’ll help us do just that. 

We got some crates sitting at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> that need to move across the system to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Think you can handle this for us?

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionD_VH_3AsteroidBase_XenoThr.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [Location|Address] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_FaunaCave_ShepherdsRe.description:
Junior surveyor [TargetName] fell out of contact with their team while identifying potentially viable mineral seams in a cave near The cave can only be accessed on foot.. Wild animals have been known to frequent this location, which has led Citizens for Prosperity to believe that the surveyor may have been attacked while on the job and is currently stranded. 

We need someone to find them and render aid if at all possible. If it's too late and they're beyond help, it will at least comfort the rest of the team to know what happened to their friend. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Easy.description:
Any interest in taking out a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> for us? 

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.  

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionB_LRT_Criminals_KillShip.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TargetName] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [Location|Address] and you should find [TargetName|Last] flying around. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CrimBase_Rank1_MissingPe.description:
Sent [TargetName] out to check out a strange noise in one of our storehouses and haven't heard from them in a while. Turns out they got themselves kidnapped. We've got intel that says they're being held at [Location|Address], but we're not sure about the source. Need someone to swing by and make sure the info is legit.  

Whether it's good news or bad, there are some creds in it for you. 

Stows out.

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_Stanton_IronCopper.description:
Hi,

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_M_OccuCave_ChawlasBeach.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near The cave can only be accessed on foot. which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_HRT_RetrieveCa.description:
Hey,

Outlaws in the system have been getting aggressive lately, targeting more of our convoys. They recently ambushed one of our cargo ships and stole supplies desperately needed by our operations. If we don’t get it back, we’re worried that the locals will start losing faith. They need to know that Citizens for Prosperity can’t just be bullied out of operation.

We managed to track the outlaws to [Location|Address]. Now we need someone who isn’t afraid of crossing these criminals to recover the shipment and deliver it to [Destination|Address]. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, do you think you could make the run for us?

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

DeadSaints_Stanton_Easy_RecoverCargo.description:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and your own ship to recover it.

You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.

When you’re done, take the stuff to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll sort you out with a reward.

-Twitch

HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_Rustville_FPSSalvage.description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at Rustville. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

UnafilliatedHH_Pyro_RegionD_M_2steroidBa.description:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them? 

But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you. 

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
There is a group of outlaws at [Location|Address] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionD_CFP_Trad.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Canard View</EM4> to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_Lagrange_VLRT_DefendShi.description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionD_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [Location|Address] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

Refueling_Pyro_Hydrogen_1VS_Rank0.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> is in need of <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4>, so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

RR_Pyro_Checkmate_VE_Civilians_Salvage.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to Checkmate at the L4 Lagrange of Pyro II. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

RR_Pyro_Gaslight_VE_Civilians_Salvage.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to [Location|Address]. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P2M2-Stanton4_Repe.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
Out of an over-abundance of caution, it would be good to see if the security systems have picked up anything new since the last batch of data you delivered. That way we can make sure we’re up-to-date on what’s been happening down there.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Security data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a <EM4>ASD Secure Drive</EM4> that you can collect at your home location.

CleanAir_EscortShip_Easy.description:
Citizens for Prosperity need a combat-experienced pilot to provide extra support to an Alliance Aid pilot who is making a vital trip from <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> for the ongoing relief effort. 

Outlaws have been launching more attacks thanks to the increased activity brought on by the Molina Mold outbreak, so it’ll be your job to make sure that they stay safe while they’re completing their work. This route is relatively safe, so I'm not expecting too much trouble, but its better not to take the risk.

If you’re interested, you’ll rendezvous there and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Stan.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>Fuel Tanks</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

Covalex_Pyro_VeryHard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hi,

Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and complete the delivery.

This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and unless you're super strong a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to shift it all.

I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we can put this all behind us.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_DerelictsCaves_Elimina.description:
Huge swarm of kopions ran down one of our Clips the other day. Never found the body. Word is they ate the poor bastard. 

We need someone to head to Pyro III Abandoned Outpost and shoot every kopion they see. Don't stop ’til the assholes are all dead. 

Watch your back when you go in. If you can’t guess, these bastards are mean. If you get yourself killed, that's on you. 

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionD_CFP_Trad.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Canard View</EM4> to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionA_HH_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Rustville</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton_L.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] 

Reminder, all the <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HaulCargo_AToB_Interstellar_Bulk_Quar_Ca.description:
Hey, it’s El. 

Got a client at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>, who needs their cargo picked up from Ruin Station. They’ve been waiting there a while and are starting to get a bit impatient. Any chance you could handle this for us? 

You’ll need a ship that can fit <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to be able to move them. 

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. CFP_Pyro_RegionB_To_RegionD_RegionLink_5.description:
Hi,

It’s incredible how many Citizens for Prosperity locations have started to thrive throughout the system. To sustain these locations, we need to be able to move important supplies between them. Got one such important run here, if you’re interested.  

There’s a few boxes of goods waiting at <EM4>Frigid Knot</EM4> that need to cross the system to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Could you move them for us and help us all build a better future?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Intro.description:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a<EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.

You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> that they fly by frequently. 

Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_CFPOutposts_XT_Elimi.description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe [Location|Address] off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_Shadowfall_BombingRun.description:
I won't get into the long and complicated politics of why I'm asking you to do this, but it's enough for you to know that I want it done. 

Go to Shadowfall and blow up the XenoThreat fuel reserves there. It'll really be helping me out of a tight spot.

-Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionD_CFPOutposts_ChainElimina.description:
Headhunters are launching an attack near [Location|Address]. This ex-Marine asshole named [TargetName] has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, [TargetName|Last] has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, [TargetName|Last] may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows

RepairO2Kiosk.description:
Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.

HH_Pyro6_Sml_Trdpst_Local_4box_Single_Co.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_Lagrange_MRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Just lost contact with a [Ship] on an important run. Before they went dark, the crew was convinced someone was following them, so I’d put money on them being under attack. 

Looking for someone to get their ass over to [Location|Address] to search for the ship and retrieve the goods. If I’m right, there will be some uninvited guests hanging around that will need to be dealt with too. Once you’ve secured the stuff, it needs to go to Last Landings.   

You down to crack a few skulls and lug some cargo. Sounds simple enough, right? 

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_RegionA_CFP_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_CFPOutpost_FPSSalvage.description:
Hi,

A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at [Location|Address], they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

EckhartSecurity_Defend_Hard.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Location
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

There’s a serious problem brewing for one of our clients at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. They’ve been warned that a highly skilled outlaw crew has their sights set on overrunning and occupying that location. We’ve been hired to make sure that doesn’t happen. 

Need a contractor to deploy to the location immediately. Based on the intel provided by the client, this won’t be a walk in the park. We strongly advise you to bring allies and plenty of supplies to help ward of the impending attack.   

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_HRT_Criminals_KillShip.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out [TargetName]. They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that [TargetName|Last] was spotted flying near [Location|Address] and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.

EchhartSecurity_Nyx_Medium_RecoverCargo.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can salvage a messy situation. A client's trusted pilot apparently wasn't so trustworthy and made off with a shipment. But thankfully our trackers are reporting the shipment's static for the moment, waiting to be picked up. If we play our cards right, there's still time to resolve this.

The abandoned ship is located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and will need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the goods. A ship that can handle <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> is a necessity, and expect contact from whatever outlaws this double-crossing pilot was hoping to sell to. 

Once recovered, deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Hard_V.description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.  

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right. 

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_TradepostToOutpost_4boxe.description:
Our crew at [Destination] needs a restock on some essentials. Looking for someone who can be trusted to move ‘em without any ‘slippage’ or other funny business.  

The boxes are waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need to be dropped at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any interest?   

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

Refueling_Nyx_Hydrogen_6M_Rank4.description:
Heyo,

Over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4>. Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run. 

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Hockrow_Nyx_Easy_MissingPersons.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP51132
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
Need an operative to help us locate the current whereabouts of a client's employee. They were on assignment in Nyx but has failed to report in. Our client is beginning to fear the worst.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate <EM4>[MissingPersonList]</EM4> at <EM4>Central Core & Power</EM4> and confirm their status. 

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
This contract has been flagged as <EM4>combat-likely</EM4> so prepare accordingly.

HeadHunters_Nyx_VeryEasy_RecoverCargo.description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

Foxwell_DefendDestructibleEntities_Nyx_V.description:
Calling all pilots – one of our clients is looking for some protection for their <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4>, based in <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. From what we’ve gathered, the attackers are a group of wannabe outlaw pests who probably haven’t realized the value of the assets they’re trying to destroy, just wreaking havoc for the sake of it. Still, the client’s property is important, so should be kept as intact as possible.

If you take care of them to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_M_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
Got a few scavs that have rooted themselves into [Location|Address]. We have our own plans there and need the place cleared out. 

That's why I want you to ho and turn off their power. Let's see if that doesn't cause these rats to abandon the place for good.

-Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionC_TradepostToOutpost_4boxe.description:
Our crew at [Destination] needs a restock on some essentials. Looking for someone who can be trusted to move ‘em without any ‘slippage’ or other funny business.

-Stows

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_Stanton_OrganMedic.description:
Hi,

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Rank5_Regional_Handyman.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes</EM4>. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Pyro_Super.description:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.  

Already got a spot picked out. If you get to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and its escorts to pass by. 

With a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.

- Stows

EckhartSecurity_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Medium_V.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Need someone to take out a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and deal with the escort ships protecting it. They’ve already interfered with several of our ongoing operations and have become a real problem across several of Eckhart Security cases. Not sure what their endgame is, but it won’t matter once you deal with them.

We’ve let slip that we will be working a job over at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> which should serve as bait to draw them out. The spot is ideal for an ambush because of the <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that’s a perfect place to power down and hide until you’re ready to strike. If you’re available, the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and its escorts should be passing through soon.   

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The main contractor will also receive a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HeadHunters_Nyx_Super_RecoverCargo.description:
This’ll be a fun one for you. We just got word that a transport ship has broken down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Only problem is, every skag and their mother seems to know about it. Place is crawling with all kinds of outlaws trying to get their hands on the cargo onboard. That’s where you come in.

If you can get your best pilots together and <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> you can take out the competition and snag the cargo. It ain’t gonna be easy though. One of my scouts said the assholes guarding this ship have got some serious tech on them.  

I’ve already got a buyer waiting, you just need to take the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll send you the creds.

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionA_CFP_Trad.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Jackson's Swap</EM4> to <EM4>Sunset Mesa</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_HHXSOutpost_Sabotage-El.description:
We're just putting the full picture together now, but so far we've learned that a Headhunter by the name of [TargetName] recently stole some sensitive data that if exposed will be detrimental to Citizens for Prosperity's cause. 

We need to ensure that all traces of the stolen data are eradicated. This means taking out all the Headhunter servers at [Location|Address] as well as tracking down [TargetName|Last] to stop them from further disseminating the information.

Your help is much appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Eckhart_FacilityDelve_ResearchWing_Gravi.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Our client has requested the immediate destruction of a group of servers located at a long-shuttered ASD research site. The servers in question contain information that our client considers extremely damaging and is eager to see the data completely eliminated.

Initial surveillance indicates the servers are within the facility’s <EM4>Energy Lab, located in the Research wing</EM4>. We’ve also picked up on a number of hostile forces, so be on alert.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Stanton_Easy.description:
Some idiots with a deathwish are attacking our ships around <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4>. Can’t let ‘em do that without paying the price. Want to do the honors?

If so, head out and get after ‘em. The crew there is tracking the attacker’s movements and I’ll pass along situational updates as they come in. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_To_RegionD_RegionLink_5b.description:
Headhunters got people placed all across the system. Keeping them all stocked and ready to rock if something goes down is essential to our success. Got a cargo run here that’ll help us do just that. 

We got some crates sitting at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> that need to move across the system to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Think you can handle this for us?

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

Ruto_Stanton1_Illegal_DestroyItems_Narco.description:
Seems there’s a new upstart in the sector who hasn’t been paying the right dues to the right people. To teach them a little lesson, my client wants you to go down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site.

The low-level lugs they got on site will probably make a stink about it and try to stop you. Handle them however you want but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

BountyHuntersGuild_ShipWaveAttack_DrawOu.description:

HH_Pyro_RegionC_TradepostToOutpost_5boxe.description:
Our crew at [Destination] needs a restock on some essentials. Looking for someone who can be trusted to move ‘em without any ‘slippage’ or other funny business.  

The boxes are waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need to be dropped at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any interest?   

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

CleanAir_Small_MedicalSupplies.description:
Hi,

Seems like folks burned through their medical resources trying to figure out how to treat the People's Aliment. Alliance Aid is overwhelmed with requests for medical supply hauls right now. Can you help me clear one of them out?

Here's a small scale ready to go. The supplies are sitting at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> with delivery going to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. All that's required is a a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move the cargo and a ship that can fit <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.   


Safe Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_StationToOutpost_1box_Si.description:
Got a crate that needs to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. There’s a Clip waiting there for it. They’re a real nasty bastard too, so best not mess this up. 

Just grab the package from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Don’t do anything dumb with it, and you’ll be fine. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

HaulCargo_AToB_Interstellar_Bulk_ProFoo_.description:
Hi, 

There’s a bunch of cargo at <EM4>Port Tressler</EM4> that needs to be moved to Levski. The People’s Alliance has a standing order for this stuff because they desperately need it, but it’s not easy to get in Nyx. Funny how they don’t want to be part of the UEE but still rely on us for their survival.  

Anyway, you’ll need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> to knock this one out. 

Covalex Independent Contractors 
 
Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Eckhart_Nyx_SRT_MultiDefendShip.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We have a client currently under attack at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. We have a long history with this client and know that they’re a skilled dogfighter. If they’re struggling to survive, then this situation must be dire.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Tutorial_Part3_NewBabbage.description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in [Location|Name] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the MT MetroLoop transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [Location|Name] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.
