RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutposts_Eliminate.description:
Headhunters just rallied up a crew to go hit Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and wipe out the XenoThreat there, but I'm looking to add some extra insurance. 

See there's this heavy hitter there named [TargetName] who's up in the XenoThreat command structure and we want them taken out. Every other one you kill is gravy, but they're your prime target.

-Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionB_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_C.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

ORS_MA_HaulingLarge.description:
Hey, it’s El.

Off the bat – this particular job’s a big deal, so if you’re looking to take this one on for us, make sure you’re confident in your ability to do a job well. 

We’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver medical supplies to <EM4>Seraphim Station</EM4>. Pick up’s at <EM4>[Location|Target|Address]</EM4>. Bear in mind, this is gonna be a big one, so make sure bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> otherwise it might be a little rough.

I can’t stress the importance of this contract enough – lots of good people got hurt in those attacks, and it’s our responsibility to do what we can to help them in the aftermath. We owe the victims that much, at the very least.

Let’s do right by them,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton_R.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>CRU-L1 Ambitious Dream Station</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Foxwell_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Nyx_Easy.description:
We need a contractor to provide convoy and protection services at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. One of our elite clients' are under attack from a band of outlaws targeting their <EM4>Fuel Tanks and ships</EM4>. You'll need to keep the crew safe as they traverse the area, as well as make sure the assets stay as intact. These thugs look like they can do some real damage, so be sure you engage them with caution or the client might not be the only one to take heavy losses.

If you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> as compensation to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Sacren's Plot</EM4> to <EM4>Gaslight at the L2 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_OutpostToTradepost_3box.description:
Hey,

Just got word that <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> has finished sorting and packing a few boxes of goods. Next step is for us to get them over to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Getting these goods sold will support CFP operations and show folks that good, honest work is possible in this system. You available for the run? 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_YangsPlace_XSOutpost_Local_1box.description:
Hey, 

Some CFP members have put together a little care package for some folks living at <EM4>Yang's Place</EM4>. Unfortunately, they got called away before they could drop it off. Feel like handling this one for us?    

The remote outpost isn’t too far away from the main outpost. Guess you could walk it, if you really want, but driving or flying it there would be a lot faster. Your choice.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Covalex_Nyx_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hi, it's El.

Need a hauler for a job ASAP. One of our contractors had a "personal emergency" and had to ditch their ship and it seems like they're not coming back. Not ideal, really.

Good news is the cargo is still intact, at least according to the tracker. It'd be a huge win for me if you could finish the job by grabbing the cargo at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and bringing it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Seems like this was a pretty big one, you'll need a ship that can transport <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move it all. Really appreciate your help.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

DeadSaints_Nyx_VeryEasy_RecoverCargo.description:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank3_YangsPlace_Local_.description:
If you happen to be in the area, please read this.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for a qualified mechanic to head to <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> with the required supplies and perform some repairs.

As it stands, you’ll need <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to repair five pipes or so.</EM4> That should help us get the outpost functional again. We'll compensate you for your time and materials.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

IDS_ResourceGathering_CryoP.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: <EM4>Cargo Capable Ship</EM4>, Personal Arms, <EM4>Heavy-Duty Tractor Beam</EM4>
Briefing: 
Our latest intel shows that the Shattered Blade have replenished their stock of Vanduul corpses and will shortly be transferring them from the old <EM4>QV Logistics station</EM4>they're operating from to an interested buyer. The UEE can't have another incident like what happened with ASD so they're eager for us to <EM4>recover the cryopods</EM4> and deliver them to <EM4>the freight elevator at [Destination|Address]</EM4>.

While the Shattered Blade members present at the site might offer resistance, they are not the focus of you mission. Deal with them as needed and get the cryopods. 

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_VH_LastDitch_EliminateSp.description:
Word's come down through my bosses that we're settling old debts. I've got an open line on this old-time hitter named [TargetName] who's racked up a hefty kill list. We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at Last Ditch who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. [TargetName|Last] is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out [TargetName|Last], they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_E_1AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [Location|Address] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_UnocCave_MissingPerson.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro2_Sml_Trdpst_Local_5box_Single_Co.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Pyro.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>Fuel Tanks</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipWaveAttack_ClearO.description:

Once you and whoever you're bringing are ready, go to [Location|Address] and engage with these criminals. Since they like to fly in separate packs, be sure you wait around to clear every last one of them out.
 
Good luck,

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_CFPOutpost_BombingRun.description:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at Chawla's Beach and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_StationToOutpost_1box_S.description:
Hey, 

Every once and awhile, Citizens for Prosperity likes to surprise members stationed at our outposts with a little gift to keep morale high. We’ve got the next box ready to go from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Bullock's Reach</EM4>, but need someone to make the delivery for us. Any interest in spreading some good cheer?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Refueling_Multi_Stanton_Super.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FuelType]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Lagrange_LRT_DefendShip.description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_DefendDestructibleEntities_P.description:
Our friends at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> have been compromised. A new gang in the area  are threatening them by targeting their <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4>.  

If those get destroyed its going to be seriously bad for business, so I want you over there pronto on protection duty.  
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

UEETrainingExercise3_DefendShip.description:
Congrats on completing part two of this three-part course.

For your next and final lesson, you will learn how to assist a ship in distress just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol. They will be under simulated attack by our specially trained hostile pilots and it will be up to you to neutralize them as quickly and effectively as possible.

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #3 – Ship in Distress</EM4>

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded [ScripAmount] MG Scrip and a special keepsake.

I know you’re going to do great out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

DeadSaints_Stanton_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
Some upstarts hit my hauling crew on their way to do a delivery. Our tracker is telling us that our ship’s still located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> so I need you to head over there and get the cargo. You’ll need <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to lug the goods from the ship.

I’d bet that whoever attacked us is still there waiting. Arm up, bring your crew, and if you can, give them one from me.

Once you’ve taken back our goods, drop it off at the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

-Twitch

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_M_OccuCave_MissionPerso.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near The cave can only be accessed on foot. which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Adagio_Salvage_Stanton_Intro.description:

A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_H_MissingPerson_DestroyI.description:
I'm a bit at the end of my rope. I had sent [TargetName], a pretty dependable Headhunter, out to destroy the XenoThreat data servers at [Location|Address].

That was a while ago and I still haven't heard from them and the servers are still sitting there intact. 

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to [TargetName|NickOrFirst] and help finish destroying the servers.

-Stows out

HH_Pyro_RegionB_TradepostToOutpost_5boxe.description:
Headhunters crews have been having a streak of good luck. I figure why take them off the job and stop them earning when I could just hire someone to deliver their spoils instead. Here’s the list of pick-ups needed:    

Pick up package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item5|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>.

Once you grab ‘em, everything needs to go to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Make sure it gets done and done right. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_TradepostToOutpost_5box.description:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

There’s a few boxes waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that need to get to <EM4>Bullock's Reach</EM4>. Can you get those supplies to the outpost for us? This might be a simple supply run, but doing these consistently only strengthens our position in the system. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_Stanton_VeryEasy_RecoverCarg.description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_CrimBase_Rank2_MissingPe.description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of [TargetName]. 

Last we saw, they were headed in the direction [Location|Address]. We need someone to head there and track down our missing Prospect. 

If you take any of them down while you're at it, all the better.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_XTBase_VHRT_RetrieveCarg.description:
An informant passed along some interesting news. XenoThreat are about to do a massive ammo resupply run for their forces, and in preparation, they’ve brought all that cargo to [Location|Address]. Seems like a prime time to strike. You interested in killing a bunch of Xenos and then stealing their ammo for us?    

If so, get your shit in order and then clear that base. Once done, grab all the ammo and bring it to Last Landings. You’ll get paid well, and I’m sure we’ll find something fun to do with all that ammo. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CrimBase_HRT_MultiDefen.description:
We just received word that a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity affiliated ships have been targeted by outlaws and that our people are in dire need of assistance. 

If you are available, we need combat ready pilots at [Location|Address] to defend our people. Note that at this dire time, we cannot afford even a single lost ship and expect with your assistance for all of our people make it out alive.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Covalex_Nyx_VeryHard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hi,

Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and complete the delivery.

This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and unless you're super strong a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to shift it all.

I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we can put this all behind us.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimin.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [Location|Address].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Nyx_Easy.description:
Some idiots with a deathwish are attacking our ships around <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. Can’t let ‘em do that without paying the price. Want to do the honors?

If so, head out and get after ‘em. The crew there is tracking the attacker’s movements and I’ll pass along situational updates as they come in. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

----------------------------

HH_Pyro_RegionC_MRT_Criminals_KillShip.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TargetName] has been spotted flying around [Location|Address].

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

Some numskull flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

Foxwell_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Nyx_Very.description:
For any pilots in the area – a group of bandits is targeting one of our clients at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, specifically their <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> and the maintenance ships that manage them. From our intel, it's only a few outlaws trying to make some quick credits, but they're also the type to cause some real damage if you get in their way.

If you take care of them and relocate the client's ship and crew safely, we’re offering <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to The Golden Riviera and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro6_Sml_Trdpst_Local_5box_Single_Co.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_LRT_Criminals_KillShip.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TargetName] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [Location|Address] and you should find [TargetName|Last] flying around. 

Stows out.

Can’t believe how many criminals are crawling around this damn system. Guess we’ll have to make some room for ourselves. 

Got a list of high-level leaders here. Nothing brings chaos and disorder to the existing gangs like a good decapitation attack. The next target is <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, who we’ve tracked to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Feel like ghosting ‘em?   

These old Hathor platform facilities are big and spread out. Doubt there’s a way to do this and not attract the attention of their foot soldiers. Ain’t gonna be easy but sure sounds like fun.

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Lagrange_VLRT_DefendShi.description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_Pyro_Medium_RecoverCargo.description:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

Not sure what happened, but a ship moving some important supplies across the system disappeared around [Location|Address]. Our crew at [Destination|Address] really needs that cargo for an upcoming operation. Any chance you could go looking for the ship and help complete the delivery?

Have no idea what happened, but my bet’s that they got ghosted. Maybe it’s just me, but I’d rather be a prepared pessimist and an ill-equipped optimist. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_XTBase_VHRT_2_MultiDefe.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy transporting urgently needed supplies took a riskier route in order to save time and are savagely being attacked by the XenoThreat. Your combat skills are urgently needed to aid in their defense.

Head to [Location|Address] as soon as you can. We'll see you well compensated for your assistance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Medium_V.description:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?

Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike. 

The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours. 

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount]</EM4> Council Scrip to sweeten the pot. 

- Stows

HaulCargo_MultiToSingle_Interstellar_Lar.description:
Hi, 

Several Citizens for Prosperity outposts in Pyro need supplies. It seems like we regularly do runs like this for them, but this one looks like it might be a bit riskier. A CFP rep let me know that outlaw activity around these sites has spiked recently, but they desperately need these outposts restocked, so we’re going ahead with the delivery. <EM4>Just a head’s up that you could run into trouble, so come prepared</EM4>.       

All the cargo’s waiting at <EM4>Everus Harbor</EM4> and here’s where it’s heading:  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

- Freight elevator at <EM4>Shepherd's Rest</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination3|Address]</EM4>  

According to the manifest, the largest cargo container you’ll need to deal with is <EM4>16 SCU</EM4>. Aside from that, remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.    

[Contractor|SignOff] 
  
Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping

FoxwellEnforcement_EliminateSpecific_Non.description:

<EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> has a reputation for only showing their face in places with civs. Really need you to take down this bounty without there being any civilian collateral damage. Foxwell can’t afford to be caught in the shitstorm that would erupt over the loss of innocent life. 


Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement

HH_Pyro_RegionA_HRT_CitizensForProsperit.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to [TargetName], who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around [Location|Address], so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.

******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

WORK BRIEF: 
I have a job here that might interest you. I need people to go out and do some basic mining in order to pull some geological data for future prospecting. Need someone to scope out and mine <EM4>[AmountToScan] of Torite, [AmountToScan2] of Ice and [AmountToScan3] of Aluminium</EM4> <EM4>Asteroid</EM4>. You'll be helping us out massively. Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

Battaglia, Recco

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_CFP_Outp.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Bueno Ravine</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimin.description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers.

Lima Endicott

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_HHXSOutpost_RetrieveGoo.description:
Hi,

We’ve got a CFP team monitoring Headhunter activity at Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. They let me know a batch of recently stolen CFP supplies were moved into it. Since there’s fewer defenses and personnel there, it feels like a good spot to strike and get our goods back. Interested?    

Do this right and the bigger outpost won’t know until it’s too late. Get in, get the goods, and then bring them to [Destination|Address]. Sound like a plan?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_HHOutpost_FPSSalvage.description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at [Location|Address]. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionD_VH_MissingPerson_Destroy.description:
You ever get a bad feeling that you just can't shake? I had sent [TargetName] to take out the some XenoThreat servers at [Location|Address] and I'm starting think they ran into some serious trouble.

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to them and make sure that those servers are destroyed for good.

-Stows out

GillysPilotSchool_Mission04.description:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.

Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.    

Make your way to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

HH_Pyro_RegionA_XTBase_Rank3_ChainMissin.description:
Those XenoThreat assholes ambushed one of our outposts. We eventually kicked their ass out of there but once the cowards knew they'd been beat, they took [TargetName] hostage as a Human shield. We let 'em go, because we don't betray our own like that, but we're not planning on letting this stand. 

Word is that they fled to their base at [Location|Address]. We need someone to break in, find [TargetName|Last], and relay the info back to me. There's a lot of creds in it for you if you do the job right. 

Keep in mind this isn't their only outpost in the system. If they give you the slip, you may need to track them to another sector. 

Stows out.

Covalex_Stanton_VeryHard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hi,

Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and complete the delivery.

This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and unless you're super strong a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to shift it all.

I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we can put this all behind us.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_XTOutpost_XTXSOutpos.description:
The XenoThreat have mercilessly attacked our people and they are now in desperate need of combat support and medical supplies.

If you're available, you'll need to pick up the supplies at [Location|Address] first before heading to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Once on site, it is important that you neutralize all the hostiles before completing delivery of the supplies.

Additionally, to help prevent an incident like this happening again, we believe that having you destroy the XenoThreat servers at <EM4>Shadowfall</EM4> would act as a further deterrent.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_DefendShip_Nyx_Easy.description:
You busy? A promising prospect was doing a special run for me but ran into trouble with the People’s Alliance around <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. This one’s on me. Knew they weren’t the best dogfighter but thought they could do this without running into any other ships. 

Told ‘em to hold tight and do everything they can to stay alive until support gets there. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for someone with your skillset.  

-Stows

EckhartSecurity_DC_Stanton1_HDPC-Cassill.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.

CONTRACT TYPE: Clear Location
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client is sending frantic comms that one of their locations is under attack. We need a contractor who can hustle to <EM4>Exterior Zone 2</EM4> and clear the location of hostile actors. 

According to onsite personnel, the outlaws are currently holed up near the <EM4>Exterior Zone 2</EM4>. Approach with caution and be prepared to use lethal force if the outlaws resist being removed.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_E_UnocCave_ChawlasBeach.description:
[TargetName] is a local who only has done a few jobs for Citizen for Prosperity, but they had promise. That is, until they went missing while exploring [Location|Address] last week. Unfortunately, we didn’t hear about it until today. Chances of survival at this point are pretty slim, but we still think its worth confirming what happened to them.
 
CFP could use help on this if anyone is interested. And besides being a good deed, the payment should make it worth the effort. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_Solar_HH_Tradepo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (<EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Vaughn_Rockcracker_Warehouse_EliminateSp.description:
There is a member of the Nyx gang the Claw Salamanders, [TargetName], who has made it on to my naughty list. They had been on the run for quite awhile, but just recently popped back up at an old mining station in the Keeger Belt. Our lucky day shall be their last.  

Word is that you can find them at [Location|Address].  Unfortunately, there is a strong chance you may have to do some repairs to the station itself before you can gain access to that particular area.

But I'm sure you're more than up to the challenge.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

HH_Pyro_RegionB_XTBase_VHRT_RetrieveCarg.description:
An informant passed along some interesting news. XenoThreat are about to do a massive ammo resupply run for their forces, and in preparation, they’ve brought all that cargo to [Location|Address]. Seems like a prime time to strike. You interested in killing a bunch of Xenos and then stealing their ammo for us?    

If so, get your shit in order and then clear that base. Once done, grab all the ammo and bring it to The Golden Riviera. You’ll get paid well, and I’m sure we’ll find something fun to do with all that ammo. 

Stows out.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Medium.description:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?

Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike. 

The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours. 

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount]</EM4> Council Scrip to sweeten the pot. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_Lagrange_LRT_DefendShip.description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Tutorial_Part3_Lorville.description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in Lorville finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the Metro Center transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around Lorville – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

FoxwellEnforcement_DestroyNarcotics_Easy.description:
Some folks will do anything for a few creds. There’s a group of upstart outlaws over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have decided to start manufacturing drugs. Turns out they’re not too good at it, or maybe a little too good. The junk they’re pumping out is stronger than the normal stuff and a real danger to anyone who uses it. 

We’ve been hired to knock out their operation and destroy whatever drugs stashes are on site. Armed guards are protecting the place, but they don’t seem too skilled. Our surveillance teams observed one of them almost shoot himself in the foot. Can’t say for certain, but odds are they won’t give a pro like you too many problems.  


Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

CFP_Pyro_CanardView_Local_5boxes_MultiTo.description:
Hi, 

We’re a little shorthanded at one of our outposts and could use some help. We need someone to gather supplies spread across a few buildings and bring them to one spot.

Here’s what needs to be gathered:

Pick up package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Each one needs to end up at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Simple enough, right?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_M_OccuCave_MissionPerso.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near The cave can only be accessed on foot. which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Covalex_Nyx_Super_RecoverCargo.description:
Hey,

Only looking for contractors who are the best of the best for this one. One of our most valued clients is expecting an incredibly important shipment which is now seriously overdue.

Here at Covalex, we pride ourselves on treating all of our clients equally, offering outstanding levels of service regardless of what we're delivering. That being said, if we lose this contract someone's gonna be in hot water and I really can't afford for that person to be me.

The tracker is reporting that the last contractor's ship is over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Don't take any chances with this one, you'll need a ship that can hold <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to collect it all.

Deliver the shipment to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we can put this whole mess behind us. And you'll make a sizeable heap of credits in the process. Not bad, right?

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_XTBase_VHRT_1_MultiDefe.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy transporting urgently needed supplies took a riskier route in order to save time and are savagely being attacked by the XenoThreat. Your combat skills are urgently needed to aid in their defense.

Head to [Location|Address] as soon as you can. We'll see you well compensated for your assistance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Patrol_Nyx_Super_V.description:
After weeks of seeing crime rates increase, we’ve been able to identify a sector that we believe to be the source of the outlaw activity that has been leeching into the surrounding areas. While it would be too much to expect to eradicate all threats, we believe that by sending combat patrols into the area we might be able to start reversing this worrisome trend. Our in-house combat analysts recommend bringing around <EM4>three wingmen</EM4> in combat-ready ships to confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Refueling_Pyro_Hydrogen_2VS_Rank0.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FuelType]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_CrimBase_Rank1_MissingP.description:
[TargetName], a member of the Citizens for Prosperity family, vanished two standard days ago while attempting to find a buyer for some old farming equipment. CFP regrets to report that we have just discovered the wreckage of a vehicle registered under the name of the missing person in an area known to be frequented by pirates. 

We found evidence at the crash site that the victim survived and is most likely being held at [Location|Address]. We are offering a reward to anyone who can track down [TargetName|First] on our behalf. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

ORS_MA_DeliveryPilot.description:
Hello,

Crusader has asked us here at Ling Family Hauling to aid their relief efforts, and it’s extremely important to us as a business and a family to do this right. The thought of what happened to the victims of Orison happening to anyone in my family… We owe it to the survivors to do everything in our power to help them.
The medical supplies Crusader needs are set to get picked up from <EM4>[Location|Target|Address]</EM4> and needs to be dropped at <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>. And be sure to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to speed things along.

Thank you, 
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

Interested contractors need the <EM4>ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes</EM4>.

[Contractor|SignOff]

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_TradepostToOutpost_4box.description:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

There’s a few boxes waiting at <EM4>Frigid Knot</EM4> that need to get to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Can you get those supplies to the outpost for us? This might be a simple supply run, but doing these consistently only strengthens our position in the system. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro4_Med_Trdpst_Local_5box_Single_Co.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Stage1_RegionLink_ToReg.description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to <EM4>Bueno Ravine</EM4>, there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. To make your life easier, be sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_Rustville_Sabotage.description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at Rustville have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Everything needs to be picked up from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> then distributed to the following spots: 

Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_XTBase_VHRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Hey,

One of our supply ships fell prey to a XenoThreat ambush. I’ll spare you the grisly details, but all that really remains is the cargo our people were carrying to [Destination|Address]. Trackers hidden within the cargo shows that XenoThreat collected the goods and then took them to a few locations spread out across [Location|Address].
 
We can’t let the XenoThreat get away with what they did to our crew and keep all those goods too. That’s why we want to strike back on both fronts. We need someone who can raid that location, retrieve the stolen cargo, and teach the Xenos that there will be consequences for their horrendous actions. Can you help us fight back?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_MRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Just got a frantic comm from a [Ship] that cut out quite dramatically. Seems like they were dumb enough to get lured into a trap, even though I made it damn clear that getting those goods to Rustville was all they should worry about.   
 
Well, it looks like they failed. Trackers hidden in the cargo now show it at [Location|Address]. Time to send in backup to reclaim our goods and teach a lesson to those who took it. You interested in delivering that message then delivering the goods?

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank5_SunsetMesa_Local_.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes</EM4>. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_AridReach_FPSSalvage.description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at Arid Reach. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Lagrange_LRT_RetrieveCa.description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a [Ship] carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at [Location|Address]. We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at [Destination|Address]. Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery? 

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.    

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_HRT_CitizensForProsperit.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to [TargetName], who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around [Location|Address], so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_Solar_CFP_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (<EM4>8 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>  

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HaulCargo_Multi2ToSingle_Interstellar_Me.description:
Hi, 

Guess the folks at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:  

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

- Freight elevator at <EM4>Levski</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>     

Please remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to <EM4>8 SCU</EM4>.  

  
Happy Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_M_OccuCave_LastLandings_.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_TradepostToOutpost_4boxe.description:
Our crew at [Destination] needs a restock on some essentials. Looking for someone who can be trusted to move ‘em without any ‘slippage’ or other funny business.  

The boxes are waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need to be dropped at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any interest?   

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

-Stows

Redwind_ASD_Medical Supplies.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL 
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS' 
----------------------------    

ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.

You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4>. 

Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness.  And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along. 

BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.

Get this. There’s a new crew trying to make a name for themselves. From what I’ve heard, they’re in way over their head, but that didn’t stop them from spending some serious creds to acquire [Item].

Currently, some of them are holed up at [Location|Address]. Go there, relieve them, of the [Item], and then bring it to [Destination|Address]. Hopefully when word of what happened there spreads to the rest of the crew, they’ll reconsider their choices in life. 

Stows out.

CitizensForProsperity_DefendShip_Nyx_Ver.description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HeadHunters_DefendDestructibleEntities_S.description:
Our friends at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> have been compromised. A new gang in the area  are threatening them by targeting their <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4>.  

If those get destroyed its going to be seriously bad for business, so I want you over there pronto on protection duty.  
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

Foxwell_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Pyro_Ver.description: Urgent ship aid needed at [Location|Address]. HH_Pyro_RegionA_E_DerelictOutpostsCaves_.description:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in [Location|Address]. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us. 

Stows out.

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Stan.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_Rank1_MissingP.description:
[TargetName], a member of the Citizens for Prosperity family, vanished two standard days ago while attempting to find a buyer for some old farming equipment. Lead Dispatcher

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_CFP_Outp.description:

----------------------------

Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell,  Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

An anonymous comm has tipped us off that Les Arlington, child of gang leader Maltrox Arlington, had been spotted picking up a delivery at a Covalex transfer center. We will provide you with the coordinates of where we believe their current whereabouts are.

Les is an experienced pilot who has been flying for almost as long as they’ve been walking and usually serves as the gang’s get-away pilot. It may be worthwhile to bring extra support ships in order to cut off any attempts at escape.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

RCD_Contested.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS: 
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>shared mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a <EM4>first come, first serve</EM4> basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Super.description:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.  

Already got a spot picked out. If you get to <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and its escorts to pass by. 

With a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.

- Stows

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Easy.description:
Any interest in taking out a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> for us? 

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.  

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows

HH_Pyro_GonersDeal_Local_3box_Single_Cou.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

HeadHunters_Patrol_Nyx_VeryEasy.description:
Headhunters want some intel on what’s happening around territory. We’ve already set up some monitoring satellites, but nothing beats a good ol’ patrol. You up for it?

If so, get on over to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

- Stows

Refueling_Nyx_Hydrogen_2S_1M_Rank1.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FuelType]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_OutpostToStation_1box_S.description:
Hey,

Got word that folks are waiting for an important supply shipment that hasn’t arrived. We thought maybe it had been destroyed but turns out that it accidently got taken to the wrong place. While we look into how the mistake happened, we need someone to head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to pick up package <EM4>#[item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> and deliver it to the correct location at <EM4>the entrance inside Gaslight at the L2 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4>.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

You available for the run?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_Patrol_Nyx_VeryHard.description:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off? 

If so, start by seeing what’s around the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing <EM4>two friends</EM4> to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Stows out.

Adagio_RG_ShipSalvage_Pyro_Rank0_RMC_Rub.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent small-scale order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and Construction Materials by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships. We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

CleanAir_Supply_VentFilters_System-To-Sy.description:
Hey,

There's a medium scale haul of new vent filters at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> waiting to go to <EM4>Levski</EM4>. You available to handle it? 

The team at <EM4>Levski</EM4> is obviously very anxious to get these new filters, and won't stop bugging me about this haul until I give them a delivery ETA. No wonder with how worried everyone is about this Molina mold outbreak. Should be an easy run. All that's needed is a ship that can hold containers <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> in size or smaller, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>. 

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [Location|Address].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RR_Pyro_PatchCity_VE_Civilians_Salvage.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to Patch City at the L3 Lagrange of Pyro III. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

HH_Pyro_RegionC_VLRT_Criminals_KillShip.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TargetName] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around [Location|Address]. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

BountyHuntersGuild_Bounty_Stanton_VeryEa.description:
