GillysPilotSchool_Mission08.description:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.

Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.

You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Tutorial_Part3_Orison.description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in Orison finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the Orison Skyway transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around Orison – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

Refueling_Multi_Stanton_NearLocation_Har.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FuelType]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_CrimBase_MRT_RetrieveCa.description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at Canard View. 

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to Canard View. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_Solar_HH_Statio.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (<EM4>8 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>  

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Patrol_Nyx_Medium_V.description:
Outlaws have been increasing their activity along one of the more popular routes in the system and we’re hoping to provide a deterrent before the problem gets out of hand. As such, we’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and deal with any hostiles you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Battaglia_ScanMineRocks_MoleyBoy.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Mining and MOLE

WORK BRIEF: 
Another special job for you with an extra special payout. Like the previous jobs, I need you to find and extract <EM4> [AmountToScan] of Savrillium, [AmountToScan2] of Lindinium and [AmountToScan3] of Bexalite Asteroid</EM4> and relay your stats back to us. These are pretty rare resources, so they might be tricky to find. 

I can't even tell you how helpful your work has been in the past so I've arranged an extra special payout for this one. These are pretty rare resources, so they might be tricky to find.

By this point you know what you're doing but just going to remind you that <EM4>the United Resource Workers' mining journal on your mobi is great if you're stuck.</EM4>

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
You'll receive a custom ARGO MOLE as payment for all your help.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Nyx_Lindi.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Nyx System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.

Reminder, all the <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

DeadSaints_Stanton_Medium_RecoverCargo.description:
You got a ship and <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>? Good. I’ve got work for you.

Don’t know how they knew we were coming, but one of my haulers got jumped over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. The pilot’s gone silent so I assume they’ve been ghosted, but the cargo tracker is stationary for now.

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch

Vaughn_Rockcracker_Maintenance_Eliminate.description:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out [TargetName] once and for all. 

Start your search at [Location|Address].  These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at  times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.

However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Stanton_VeryHard.description:
Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4>, along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto. 

Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_MissingPerson_DestroyI.description:
I'm a bit at the end of my rope. I had sent [TargetName], a pretty dependable Headhunter, out to destroy the XenoThreat data servers at [Location|Address].

That was a while ago and I still haven't heard from them and the servers are still sitting there intact. 

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to [TargetName|NickOrFirst] and help finish destroying the servers.

-Stows out

CitizensForProsperity_DefendShip_Nyx_Med.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Ship_Refueling_Intro_Pyro.description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: <EM4>make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out</EM4>.

A Club member has run out of ~misssion(FuelType) at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a <EM4>journal entry</EM4> on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Battaglia_ScanRocks_Hard.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Full Area Scan For Ore

WORK BRIEF: 
I need you to check something out for me if you’re not busy. I'm looking to build on our mineral database and need some scans of <EM4>[AmountToScan] of Torite, [AmountToScan2] of Bexalite and [AmountToScan3] of Ice</EM4>. I can handle the mining if you want to leave it. These might be a little tricky to find, just a head's up.

Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Let me know.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

HaulCargo_AToB_Pyro_Small_Medical_Intro.description:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.  

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you. 

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of <EM4>[Item]</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   


Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

UEETrainingExercise1_SearchAndDestroy.description:
If travelling to different star systems around the Empire, helping those in need, and protecting our borders sounds like a rewarding career to you, then maybe you’re ready to become a pilot in the UEE Navy.

The overall demand for naval pilots has increased in recent years which means there’s now more opportunity than ever before. However, to become a Navy pilot, you need to go through specialist training and gain many hours of flight experience.

To give you a small taste of what life as a combat pilot would be like, Gilly’s Flight School has partnered with the UEE Navy to offer a unique opportunity to take a special Patrol Training course that will run you through three scenarios covering a basic patrol. 

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #1 – Scanning a Patrol Point</EM4>

I believe that folks learn best by doing, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding out there. This is about throwing you into the deep end and giving you a chance to swim. You never know what you’re capable of until you’re given the chance.

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded [ScripAmount] MG Scrip. Plus, completing all three will get you a special keepsake.

Can’t wait to see you out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

EckhartSecurity_ShipAmbush_Nyx_VeryEasy_.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

One of our clients has been the victim of consistent harassment so the time has come to send a clear cease-and-desist message by taking out their prized <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>.  The lowlife in question follows a fairly predictable routine making them susceptible to an ambush. We’ve identified <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> as the ideal spot. It features an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting. 

By the way, the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> often flies alone but is sometimes joined by a friend in a single-seat ship. Neither should give you too much trouble, but we have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. There’s a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> in this for the main contractor too.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_CFPXSOutpost_Sabotage.description:
We got big plans about to go down but unfortunately Citizens for Prosperity have people nearby at  Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation].

Since I can't afford to have those bastards cockin' things up for us, I want you to go there and take out their power generators.

Should keep them sidelined until we're done with our business. 

-Stows out

HH_Pyro_RegionD_CrimBase_HRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Need someone to raid a base at [Location|Address] for us. Not sure exactly who’s dug in there, but they attacked one of our ships and took the drugs they were hauling. Really need that shit back. That batch is full of high potency stuff that’s worth a premium. 

Doubt they’ll want to give it back to you, so plan to take it by force. Then bring the goods to Last Landings. And don’t act like an idiot and get any ideas of what you could do with that stuff. Trust me, you don’t wanna get on my bad side. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_CaveHHXSOutpost_Missing.description:
One of our most dedicated people, [TargetName] has gone missing and I'm beside myself thinking what might have happened to them. They had been working undercover to gather intelligence on some local outlaws and managed to track down where some critical data was being stored. 

We need you to go, discern what happened to them, and if the worst has happened, continue their mission to destroy the sensitive data before it can be used against us.

From their last check in with their handler, we believe they were headed to [Location|Address]. I suggest you start your search at the small outposts near there.

Please hurry,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location3|Address]</EM4>  

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Patrol_Nyx_VeryEasy_V.description:
We need someone with combat experience to patrol a travel lane for us. Over the years, we’ve found that it's good to get out there and make ourselves visible. Sometimes a pilot like yourself traveling through an area is enough to deter any potential outlaws. But in case you run into any that are feeling a bit more ambitious, a ship ready for combat is recommended.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. After you’ve scanned all the waypoints and ensured that the route is secure, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_ChainElimAll_3Cluste.description:
Citizens for Prosperity's board just authorized funds to hire security personnel to retake several clusters near Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] that have since fallen into the hands of the Headhunters. While we tried to just accept the loss, it's become apparent that they are crucial to our ongoing operations in the system.

You'll need to clear out each of the locations that will be provided but more importantly, you'll also need to take out [TargetName], who's in charge of the hostiles on site.

These Headhunters are heavily embedded and have a history of violence, so you should prepare accordingly. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Battaglia_Data_Intro.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Data Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and make a copy of their server data</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Nyx_Medium.description:
Our airspace around <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> has been compromised. Enemy ships are threatening the base and any of our ships in the area. Gotta put a stop to this immediately, so get your shit in order and get over there. Just get going and I’ll update you with any relevant info on where you’re needed. 
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_CaveHHXSOutpost_Missing.description:
One of our most dedicated people, [TargetName] has gone missing and I'm beside myself thinking what might have happened to them. They had been working undercover to gather intelligence on some local outlaws and managed to track down where some critical data was being stored. 

We need you to go, discern what happened to them, and if the worst has happened, continue their mission to destroy the sensitive data before it can be used against us.

From their last check in with their handler, we believe they were headed to [Location|Address]. I suggest you start your search at the small outposts near there.

Please hurry,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RR_Pyro_Endgame_VE_Civilians_Salvage.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to Endgame at the L3 Lagrange of Pyro VI. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_Solar_CFP_Outpos.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a bunch of comms this morning. Seems one of the local trash collectors' ship is busted and we're gonna be picking up the slack.

I got a bunch of trash (<EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>

And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_RegionD_CFP_Sta.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> to <EM4>Canard View</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HeadHunters_Pyro_VeryEasy_RecoverCargo.description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionD_HH_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

One of the folks over at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> just hit me up about a pile of cargo, <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>  

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_OutpostToStation_1box_S.description:
Hey,

Got word that folks are waiting for an important supply shipment that hasn’t arrived. We thought maybe it had been destroyed but turns out that it accidently got taken to the wrong place. While we look into how the mistake happened, we need someone to head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to pick up package <EM4>#[item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> and deliver it to the correct location at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

You available for the run?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

WildstarRacing_Race4_SnakePit_OpenTrack.description:
Looking to get some practice track time to improve your piloting skills? Then strap in and throttle up with Wildstar Racing Amateur League.

[RaceDetails]

DISCLAIMER
Wildstar Racing requires the contracted racer to be the vehicle pilot, no substitutes or stand-ins are allowed. Please be mindful that Wildstar Racing utilizes publicly accessible tracks and that other individuals may be present. Wildstar Racing is not responsible for any damage your ship may suffer while racing.

EckhartSecurity_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Intro.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’re looking for contractors with combat experience who are willing to get their hands dirty so to speak. A client of ours was double-crossed by a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and we’ve been waiting for an opportunity to deal with the issue. After tracking them for several weeks, we’ve identified <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> as the ideal spot to intercept them. It features an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting for the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>.

Intel suggests that they may travel with an escort. If they do, you’ll have to deal with them too. Since this is your first contract, we will have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. There’s a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> in this for the main contractor too.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

CFP_ShipWaveAttack_ClearOutHostiles_Nyx_.description:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. Rather than just go around the problem and risk it persisting along the new route, we feel it we be prudent to meet these outlaws head on.

You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to [Location|Address] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_GoldenRiviera_Local_5boxes_Multi.description:
Seems like they can’t tell their ass from their elbow over at [Location] and the place is a mess. I need help collecting supplies spread across the outpost and putting them where they’re supposed to go. Here are the specifics:

Pick up package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item5|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>.
  
All of the above need to end up at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Easy and low-risk work, if you’re interested.

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 
 
Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_Stage1_RegionLink_ToRegi.description:
One of our Judges put out a bulletin asking Headhunters to keep an eye on for [Item]. Got word yesterday that some can be found at [Location|Address]. Feel like making a high ranking Headhunter happy?

All you need to do is get your hands on the goods then run ‘em across system to [Destination|Address].

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_BulkGrade_RegionB_CFP_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Patrol_Nyx_VeryHard.description:
We’ve identified a sector that’s been increasingly riddled with outlaw attacks and we think that if we begin to actively patrol the area we can turn things around. We’d recommend gathering at least <EM4>two wingmen</EM4> to head out there in combat-ready ships and confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionC_HH_Trade.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Gaslight at the L2 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_H_CFPOutposts_MultiElim.description:
We just received reports of a massive attack against [Location] by a large group of armed individuals led by [TargetName], a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that [TargetName|Last] tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [Location|Address] and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Pyro_Mediu.description:
Foxwell has been tracking a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> used by outlaws and discovered a pattern to its movements. The ship should be passing by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> soon.

Looking for a contractor willing to hustle there, hide in the emission cloud, and then spring the trap when the time is right. There’s usually escort ships with the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. Careful not to jump the gun and blow your cover. The element of surprise is crucial from what I’ve read.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_Stage1_RegionLink_ToRegi.description:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.  A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out

EckhartSecurity_DC_Stanton4_S4LD01_Multi.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4> and their crew were identified executing a raid on <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. If their MO holds true, <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again. 

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.    

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_FPSMine_Stanton_Rank.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

These ores can be mined on a planet, or moon orbiting the planet, that we require the ore to be delivered to. 

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_OutpostToTradepost_4boxe.description:
Got some goods that need to be moved up the chain for us. There are a few boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to make their way to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.   

Never thought when I joined the Headhunters that supply chain management would be part of my job, but someone’s gotta keep the goods flowing, I guess. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_H_MissingPerson_Eliminat.description:
We had this kid named [TargetName] volunteer to go take out some XenoThreat near Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Everything we knew about the place said it was gonna be too much for [TargetName|Last] to handle, but they were real keen on boosting their standing with the Headhunters and thought this would do it, so they went alone.

Haven't heard anything but XenoThreat comms coming out of that place since. If you want to go and knock it over, we'll pay you instead. If you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last] that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

ORS_SWA.description:
Just got word that some of the Nine Tails involved in the recent assault on Orison are convening near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> before launching their next attack. We need a capable fighter pilot to head them off and take care of them before they start wreaking havoc again.

To complicate matters, from what we know there’s a very high chance that they might have additional reinforcements inbound, so be sure the extra ships don’t take you by surprise.

All the best,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_HRT_Criminals_KillShip.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out [TargetName]. They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that [TargetName|Last] was spotted flying near [Location|Address] and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_Solar_CFP_RuinT.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

They're doing a clean out at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> and have a bunch of <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> or smaller waste containers that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots. (Don't ask me why. They're paying us is all I know.)

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>

And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

FTL_Courier_Stanton_MicroSatellite_Rank0.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the <EM4>ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes</EM4>.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

[Contractor|SignOff]

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_UnocCave_YangsPlace_M.description:
[TargetName] is a local who only has done a few jobs for Citizen for Prosperity, but they had promise. That is, until they went missing while exploring [Location|Address] last week. Unfortunately, we didn’t hear about it until today. Chances of survival at this point are pretty slim, but we still think its worth confirming what happened to them.
 
CFP could use help on this if anyone is interested. And besides being a good deed, the payment should make it worth the effort. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank1_JacksonsSwap_Loca.description:
A nearby outpost of ours at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

We will need <EM4>three fuses replaced</EM4> and if you could bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes</EM4> that should take care of the rest.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionB_VH_Shadowfall_Sabotage.description:
I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people. 

To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at Shadowfall.

-Stows out

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_E_1AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
Hey,

Outlaws have been targeting CFP supply caches and we’re sick of it. We started hiding trackers in the cargo containers and some just got lifted and taken to [Location|Address].

Can you head there, get back what’s ours, and then take it to [Destination|Address]?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Pyro_unla.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_C.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TargetName] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TargetName|Last] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [Location|Address] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_VeryEasy_RecoverCargo.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_Solar_HH_Statio.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (<EM4>8 SCU</EM4> or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location3|Address]</EM4>

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_Rank0_VE_1AsteroidBase_.description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at Canard View. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Battaglia_ScanMineRocks_Hard.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Ore Needs Gathering

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a big mining job with your name on it. We're looking to update our records about mineral yields so we need someone to scan and extract about <EM4>[AmountToScan] of Torite, [AmountToScan2] of Bexalite and [AmountToScan3] of Ice</EM4> <EM4>Asteroid</EM4> mined if possible. These might be a little tricky to find, just a head's up.

Also, if you're stuck or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Let me know.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Nyx_unlaw.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order

CitizensForProsperity_DefendShip_Nyx_Int.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is in need of pilots with dogfighting experience. If you’re looking to put your skills to the test, I have a mission here for you to try. 

A civilian ship has requested combat support near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Head there and show us that you have the skills to excel in these types of missions and we’ll put you to good use.  

Please be aware. This mission is not a training exercise. This is a real encounter, so please do your best to save the ship in distress. 

Good Luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Pyro_Medium.description:
Our airspace around <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> has been compromised. Enemy ships are threatening the base and any of our ships in the area. Gotta put a stop to this immediately, so get your shit in order and get over there. Just get going and I’ll update you with any relevant info on where you’re needed. 
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

EchhartSecurity_Stanton_Easy_RecoverCarg.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Client's cargo was mid-transport when they ran into some ship trouble, and now a group of opportunistic outlaws are looking to cash in on this.

If you accept, head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and deal with the outlaws guarding the cargo. Extract it using a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, recover the cargo, load it in to a ship that can transport <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and deposit it on the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Adagio_RG_ShipSalvage_Pyro_Safe_Rank1_RM.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent average-sized order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) by stripping abandoned ships. We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Stanton Gateway</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_CFPOutpost_HHEliminateA.description:
We received an emergency comm from Canard View reporting that they are currently under attack by a group of Headhunters. We know our presence in the system has upset the Headhunters, but it hardly excuses this unprovoked attack.

If available, please gather your gear and head out. Just understand that Headhunters are experienced fighters and will not back down easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_SunsetMesa_Local_1box_Single_Co.description:
Hey,

We’ve got an opportunity for any haulers interested in lending a hand or two to Citizens for Prosperity.

There’s a box that needs to be moved from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Shouldn’t take long, if you’re around the outpost and available. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton_B.description:

LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

FoxwellEnforcement_ShipAmbush_Stanton_Me.description:
Foxwell has been tracking a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> used by outlaws and discovered a pattern to its movements. The ship should be passing by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> soon.

Looking for a contractor willing to hustle there, hide in the emission cloud, and then spring the trap when the time is right. There’s usually escort ships with the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. Careful not to jump the gun and blow your cover. The element of surprise is crucial from what I’ve read.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_3AsteroidBase_XhenoTh.description:
A small group of Citizens for Prosperity members were supposed to be delivering sensitive data back to our headquarters in Stanton, but they never arrived. 

We now believe that they were captured by XenoThreat before they could leave the system. I'd like you to investigate [Location|Address] to discover what happened to the missing crew and then destroy any servers they could be using to store the stolen data.

Your help is very appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_VeryHard_V.description:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us. 

We got eyes on a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Nyx_.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>Fuel Tanks</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

BHG_Rockcracker_Warehouse_EliminateBoss.description:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TargetName] 
SYSTEM: Nyx
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
LAST KNOWN LOCATION:  [Location|Address]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: Claw Salamanders
NOTES: Because these abandoned QV Breaker Stations are not fully functional, there is a good chance that you will have to perform some repairs before your able to access the target's location. You may also have to deal with other hazards like dangerous fauna.

Additionally, the intel gathered on [TargetName] has them as a high ranking member of the Claw Salamanders, one who will not appear unless suitably drawn out of hiding. Engage with enough of their lower ranked associates and they will be forced to come deal with you themselves.


BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

HeadHunters_Stanton_Easy_RecoverCargo.description:
Managed to intercept a ship carrying some goods over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> but we hit a snag - our guys didn’t have enough space in their ships to store it. You wanna make some quick creds? Head over there and grab the stuff. Could be a few scavs there by now so be on your guard.

Just don’t forget to bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> as that shit’s heavy.

When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we’ll take care of the rest.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_UnocCave_TheGoldenRivi.description:
I know better than to send someone like [TargetName] out by themselves, but that didn’t stop me from being a fool and doing it. Now the dumb SOB hasn’t returned my comms and nobody has set eyes on them in a few days.

If you got the time, I could use someone to go over to [Location|Address] and see if they’re still there. You get paid even if they wind up being dead.

-Stows

CleanAir_Small_MoldTreatment_System-To-S.description:
Hi,

We’ve joined the effort to help those affected by the Molina mold outbreak. There’s a small scale haul of urgently needed treatment waiting to be picked up from <EM4>NB Int. Spaceport</EM4> and delivered to <EM4>Levski</EM4>. Any chance you’re available?  
   
All you’ll need is a ship that can fit <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to make moving the stuff easier on you. 
 

Safe Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

CFP_Pyro_Intro_Hauling.description:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we need a package picked up from <EM4>Stanton Gateway</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_RegionA_HH_Stat.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>The Golden Riviera</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutposts_BombingRu.description:
It seems that XenoThreat has gotten the same intel we did and are looking to pull off the same job as us. 

I want you to knock the competition out of the picture. Go to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and take out the fuel tanks they got there.

Then my people can finish up without worrying about XenoThreat crashing the party.

-Stows out

Refueling_Multi_Pyro_Hard.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FuelType]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_Stanton_OrganiMass.description:
Hi,

Looking for a contractor with a ship that can carry <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4> to run a delivery for us across Stanton.

This isn't a particularly long delivery route, but you will be moving between couple of different locations. To make sure things go smoothly, bring enough fuel and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to speed up moving the boxes.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank1_YangsPlace_Local_.description:
A nearby outpost of ours at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

We will need <EM4>three fuses replaced</EM4> and if you could bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes</EM4> that should take care of the rest.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_Rank0_Regional_Handyman.description:
One of our spots at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> got kinda wrecked in an attack recently and we need someone to head over there and patch things up.

From what they tell me, you’ll need <EM4>about three fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to sort out at least three pipes.</EM4> Get it done and we’ll get you paid.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>”Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionC_OutpostToTradepost_4boxe.description:
Got some goods that need to be moved up the chain for us. There are a few boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to make their way to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.   

Never thought when I joined the Headhunters that supply chain management would be part of my job, but someone’s gotta keep the goods flowing, I guess. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_Lagrange_LRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Someone with a death wish attacked one of our ships hauling some primo product. Our crew on the scene is outta commission, so we need someone to get there fast and recover the stash before those bozos make off with it. Any chance you can handle this for us?  
  
Looks like the attack went down at [Location|Address]. Head over there and deal with the attackers before they get away. Then grab the goods from the [Ship] and take ‘em to The Golden Riviera. Oh, and don’t be an idiot and get high on that supply, unless you want me to send someone after you next. 

- Stows

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_CFPOutpost_XTEliminateA.description:
XenoThreat forces launched an unprovoked attack near Canard View. We're looking for any available combat operators to go and provide support. 

If you haven't dealt with them before, it's important to know that XenoThreat are trained fighters so this will not be an easy fight, but it's a necessary one.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_Derelicts_EliminateAn.description:
Members of the group Citizens for Prosperity were recently ambushed by several packs of kopions at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and have requested Highpoint's services in dealing with them. For the safety of everyone trying to settle in the area, we require the immediate services of someone who can deal with this on our behalf.

Expect a large number of animals and prepare yourself accordingly.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnima.description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_CFPOutpost_Stage1_Regio.description:
We've received a distress call from [Location|Address]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_H_2AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
One of the local Judges has been trying to get info on some of new gangs in the area. You know, see if anyone's got eyes on what we got. That kinda thing. Anyway, we sent [TargetName] undercover to try and suss out if anyone's getting bright ideas to try and make a move.

Anyway, [TargetName|First] was heading to [Location|Address] to make a deal with some local grunts or whatever but we haven't heard back. Judge is afraid [TargetName|Last] might've been sniffed then snuffed, so we want you to head there and see what's what.

Go find what happened to [TargetName|Last] and get our cargo back. Odds are you'll need to shwack anyone you come across because if [TargetName|Last] is dead, these assholes killed a Headhunter.

Once you get the cargo, drop it off at [Destination|Address] and get a nice little payday.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_M_CFPOutposts_BombingRun.description:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at [Location|Address] and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionD_HH_Stati.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

One of the folks over at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> just hit me up about a pile of cargo, <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>  

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionD_CFP_Trad.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Canard View</EM4> to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

Headhunters_OLP_EliminateAll.description:
Surprise, surprise. Seems like not everyone’s happy that the Headhunters are making inroads in Stanton. One crew in particular has been hitting our people and then scurrying back to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. 

Want you to go there and give ‘em a taste of their own medicine. Removing these lickboots should send a pretty clear message about what happens if you screw with us. 


Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_M_OccuCave_ShepherdsRes.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near The cave can only be accessed on foot. which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Nyx_Rank0.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Nyx System </EM4>

TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for a heavy Antium armor set. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_Stage1_RegionLink_ToRegi.description:
One of our Judges put out a bulletin asking Headhunters to keep an eye on for [Item]. Got word yesterday that some can be found at [Location|Address]. Feel like making a high ranking Headhunter happy?

All you need to do is get your hands on the goods then run ‘em across system to [Destination|Address].

Stows out.

EckhartSecurity_DC_Stanton4_SakuraSun-Go.description:
