CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Clear Location
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client is sending frantic comms that one of their locations is under attack. We need a contractor who can hustle to <EM4>Exterior Zone 2</EM4> and clear the location of hostile actors. 

According to onsite personnel, the outlaws are currently holed up near the <EM4>Exterior Zone 2</EM4>. Approach with caution and be prepared to use lethal force if the outlaws resist being removed.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

ByGroup.GroupName: Squad B - Soldier or Tech x 2 -Target
Squad C - Soldier or Tech x 2 - Target
Squad D - Soldier or Tech x 2 - Target

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_HHOutpost_Sabotage.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to Last Landings and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_Solar_CFP_Statio.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

One of the folks over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> just hit me up about a pile of cargo, <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination3|Address]</EM4>  

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_VE_1AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_XSOutpost_HHEliminateAl.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for security personnel to take a former CFP outpost that's currently serving as a hideout for Headhunters to launch attacks throughout the system. 

Located near Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation], reclaiming this outpost will allow CFP to provide greater support to local efforts to build stability.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionC_HH_Trade.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Seer's Canyon</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_DerelictsCaves_Elimina.description:
Headhunters need someone to take out a pack of kopions that've been giving our guys a hard time. Last saw the things at Pyro III Abandoned Outpost. There's some creds in it for you if you finish the job.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_OutpostToTradepost_3box.description:
Hey,

Just got word that <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> has finished sorting and packing a few boxes of goods. Next step is for us to get them over to <EM4>Frigid Knot</EM4>. 

Getting these goods sold will support CFP operations and show folks that good, honest work is possible in this system. You available for the run? 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_HHOutpost_RetrieveGoods.description:
Hey,

I’ve been hustling to track down what happened to a bunch of important supplies stolen from a CFP outpost. As I suspected, they were taken by the Headhunters who currently have them stashed at [Location|Address]. 

My source also warned me that they might be moving the supplies to a more secure location soon. Feels like our window of getting them back is closing fast. Can you head over to that outpost and reclaim them before they disappear again?

Clearly, it’s a risky op but I wouldn’t be asking if those supplies weren’t important. Secure them and then bring them to [Destination|Address].

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Be safe out there, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_Patrol_Stanton_VeryEasy.description:
Headhunters want some intel on what’s happening around territory. We’ve already set up some monitoring satellites, but nothing beats a good ol’ patrol. You up for it?

If so, get on over to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

- Stows

Ship_Refueling_Intro_Nyx.description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: <EM4>make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out</EM4>.

A Club member has run out of ~misssion(FuelType) at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a <EM4>journal entry</EM4> on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Rank3_Regional_Handyman.description:
Hello,

We've received word that a devastating storm hit <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> which caused some damage to the structures. Our technician on site is still trying to figure out what they can fix but they can’t get everything. If you bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to repair around five pipes</EM4>, we should be able to handle any remaining repairs.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Patrol_Nyx_Super.description:
After weeks of seeing crime rates increase, we’ve been able to identify a sector that we believe to be the source of the outlaw activity that has been leeching into the surrounding areas. While it would be too much to expect to eradicate all threats, we believe that by sending combat patrols into the area we might be able to start reversing this worrisome trend. Our in-house combat analysts recommend bringing around <EM4>three wingmen</EM4> in combat-ready ships to confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

EckhartSecurity_EscortShips_Nyx_Super.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

This contract should only be considered by the most capable of pilots. A highly valued client is currently under attack at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> and requires immediate extraction. They’re sitting in the hangar ready to leave, but are unable to move until the hostile ships in the area have been neutralized. 

I don’t see the outlaws stopping any time soon and our client’s reporting they’re packing high-grade weaponry on their ships. This will be a test of your skill as much as your endurance. Assemble whoever you need and head there immediately to assist them.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

CleanAir_EscortShip_Hard.description:
Alliance Aid has a ship vital to the relief effort leaving from <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. They have received credible threats that they may be attacked and are looking to bring on additional security.

When you're ready, head to the rendezvous with yourself and <EM4>any additional combat ships you can recruit</EM4>  and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

UnafilliatedCFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_1Asteroid.description:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves? 

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

HeadHunters_DefendDestructibleEntities_S.description: Our partners at [Location|Address] need help. A rival outlaw crew are swarming the area and attacking the Fuel Tanks there. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site is absolutely critical to our future plans in the area and its damn important that it remains in working order. With the scale of this attack and the skill of these pilots, there's no doubt that some reliable backup would serve you well. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and stop these bootlicks before they can do any lasting damage. To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn [ScripAmount] Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong. - Stow

HH_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_Rank2_MissingPe.description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of [TargetName]. 

Last we saw, they were headed in the direction [Location|Address]. We need someone to head there and track down our missing Prospect. 

If you take any of them down while you're at it, all the better.

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_XTBase_Rank3_ChainMissi.description:
An upstanding member of the Citizens for Prosperity community, Doctor [TargetName], was recently abducted by XenoThreat while distributing vital medical supplies to one of our settlements.

The kidnappers were last seen entering their base at [Location|Address], but we are uncertain whether they will remain there for long. XenoThreat maintains multiple outposts throughout this system and has been known to swap locations at a moment's notice. 

Considering the danger and the distance you may have to travel, CFP is prepared to offer a substantial reward for determining what happened to Dr. [TargetName|Last].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionA_M_CFPOutposts_Sabotage.description:
Turns out those Citizens for Prosperity bastards have been gathering intel on us. They're going to try to cut us off from several revenue streams and bleed us dry. Can't let that happen. 

Head to [Location|Address] and destroy their data storage. 

That should teach them not to stick their noses where they don't belong.

-Stows out

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_MissingPerson_Theft_H.description:
Hey,

I’ve been tracking Headhunters activity at The Golden Riviera. Recently, they stocked it with supplies we believe were stolen from one of our cargo convoys. [TargetName] offered to go get our goods back but hasn’t checked in since. Really need to know what happened to them and if our supplies are there.

Think this is something you could handle? You’ll probably have to deal with Headhunters forces to get to the bottom of this. Also, any goods you grab should go to [Destination|Address] once you’re out of there.

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_M_XSOutposts_EliminateAll.description:
We learned that Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] is under threat of attack by outlaws and has asked for assistance. We need someone to protect them and drive away the outlaws. 

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_DisableCommsTowers_Hard.description:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.

We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.

Head to <EM4>Last Ditch</EM4> and find the towers. At the <EM4>top is a control panel</EM4> that can be used to disable them.

Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Stanton_ShipGrave.description:
Some numskull flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_CFP_Outp.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Bueno Ravine</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_Rank0_ChawlasBeach_Loca.description:
A nearby outpost of ours at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

We will need <EM4>three fuses replaced</EM4> and if you could bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes</EM4> that should take care of the rest.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Refueling_Pyro_Easy.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> is in need of [FuelType], so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_HHOutpost_Sabotage.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [Location|Address] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_XTXSOutposts_Theft.description:
Hey,

XenoThreat just raided one of our convoys and made off with a bunch of supplies. I’m not sure exactly where they took them, but I know they have a cache of stolen cargo not too far away. If I had to guess, that’s exactly where they took them. 

The spot is Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Need someone to go there, grab the goods inside, and bring them to [Destination|Address]. The outpost is a little ways away from their main operations hub. Normally, there’s fewer forces there than the main outpost, but don’t think this will be a walk in the park. Just be smart and prepared. 

Be safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_MissingPerson_Theft_.description:
Hey,

Wondering if you can help me. I’ve lost touch with a dedicated CFP volunteer named [TargetName] who was tracking down supplies taken by XenoThreat. Their last comm said they believed our stuff was being held at [Location|Address]. I told them to be careful, but haven’t heard anything since.

Any chance you can head out and try to locate [TargetName|First]? While there, if you spot the supplies, please bring them to [Destination|Address]. I’ll give you the same warning I gave [TargetName|First], that spot is a known Xeno stronghold. Better be prepared. Would hate for you to disappear too after visiting that spot. 

Be Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

TarPits_Stanton1_Dupree_SidePed_Sabotage.description:
I’m looking to send a strong message to the crew over at Supply Room and know the perfect way to do it - property damage.

All you need to do is head on over, destroy a few things here and there, and really drive home an important lesson about respecting your betters. 

Do that for me and I’ll be feeling very happy. And generous.

Interested?

HH_Pyro_RegionD_M_OccuCave_MissingPerson.description:
We’re on the market for a new stash house, so I sent [TargetName] over to [Location|Address]. They were supposed to just have a quick look and report back to me if any of the hangars would work for us, but I haven’t heard from them since.

My guess is that someone else was already using the hangar, but I’d sleep better knowing for sure.

If the credits seem right, head over and see if you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. Just be careful. I’d hate to have to hire someone to find your body next.

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_E_LastLandings_FPSSalvag.description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at Last Landings. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

Shubin_RG_Discovery_GroundMine_Stanton_R.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on <EM4>Daymar and Aberdeen</EM4>. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_2AsteroidBase_Crimina.description:
One of our people is currently under attack at [Location|Address]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away. 

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Covalex_Stanton_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
Hi, it's El.

Need a hauler for a job ASAP. One of our contractors had a "personal emergency" and had to ditch their ship and it seems like they're not coming back. Not ideal, really.

Good news is the cargo is still intact, at least according to the tracker. It'd be a huge win for me if you could finish the job by grabbing the cargo at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and bringing it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Seems like this was a pretty big one, you'll need a ship that can transport <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move it all. Really appreciate your help.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Rustville</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

UnafilliatedHH_Pyro_RegionB_M_2steroidBa.description:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them? 

But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you. 

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

Covalex_DeliveryPilot_Stanton_Agricutura.description:
Hiya,

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno

Heyo,

Over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4>. Talk about when it rains it pours!

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

RR_Pyro_Obituary_Rank0_MissingPerson.description:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to [TargetName]. Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to [Location|Address] and find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti_Interstellar_Med.description:
If you've got a fast ship, can discreetly carry size <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> containers, and love getting a huge payout, we need you to head to <EM4>Orison</EM4> immediately and take what you find there to these drop points:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>Levski</EM4>  

The buyers are paying a premium to get their hands on fresh stormwal meat. Stay sharp. If security catches you with this, it's your ass on the line. If you're smart, you'll use a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to get everything loaded up quick. 

-Twitch

HH_Pyro_RegionD_E_1AsteroidBase_Criminal.description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [Location|Address]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Pyro.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

Refueling_Nyx_Easy.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> is in need of [FuelType], so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

EckhartSecurity_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Super.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Recently, we sent a contractor after a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>, who was leading a crew targeting the operations of an extremely important client. Unfortunately, it was a trap and we lost some good people. We can’t let the target get away again, so we’ve decided the best course of action is to give them a dose of their own medicine.  

Ambushing this target seems like the safest course of action, and we’ve identified a good spot for such an attack. There’s an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> that the target and their crew frequently fly by. You can power down your ship and hide there until you’re ready to strike. This crew is ruthless and extremely skilled. Don’t make the same mistake as the previous contractor and go this alone. It would be best for you to bring a few trusted friends to help handle this crew.    

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. Plus, we’ll throw in a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor for taking care of this.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Vaughn_Nyx_Assassination_Rehire.description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more. 

Kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address] and I will consider the slate wiped clean. 

Sincerely,
Vaughn

HH_Pyro2_Sml_Trdpst_Local_4box_Single_Co.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_Lagrange_LRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Someone with a death wish attacked one of our ships hauling some primo product. Our crew on the scene is outta commission, so we need someone to get there fast and recover the stash before those bozos make off with it. Any chance you can handle this for us?  
  
Looks like the attack went down at [Location|Address]. Head over there and deal with the attackers before they get away. Then grab the goods from the [Ship] and take ‘em to Last Landings. Oh, and don’t be an idiot and get high on that supply, unless you want me to send someone after you next. 

- Stows

Ling_Nyx_Easy_RecoverCargo.description:
Hello,

Looking for a quick job? Got a client who's waiting on a shipment but our hauler ran into some engine trouble. Can't seem to get them up and running so we need someone to take over.

Fly out to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and you'll spot their ship. You can't miss it - it's the one that's sitting still in the middle of space. Make sure you bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> along with a decent ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Once you've picked up the goods take them to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_OutpostToTradepost_4boxe.description:
Got some goods that need to be moved up the chain for us. There are a few boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to make their way to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.   

Never thought when I joined the Headhunters that supply chain management would be part of my job, but someone’s gotta keep the goods flowing, I guess. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_Rank5_Regional_Handyman.description:
The storms over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> are getting to be a real pain in the ass. One of our outposts got absolutely reamed yesterday and needs some serious repairs so we're looking for help.

Figure you'd need to bring <EM4>about six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to deal with at most eight busted pipes</EM4>. We think that’ll cover, but you'll get exact numbers on site.

Hell with this place.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, that <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

Ruto_Stanton1_Unlawful_EliminateAll_Stan.description:
This is a bit aggressive for my taste, but credits are credits, right?

Got a client who's looking for a highly motivated individual to head over to [Location|Address] and kill everyone who’s there. 

Basically, start shooting and don’t stop. You'll get paid once the site's clear.

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_E_UnocDerelict_MissingP.description:
One of our people, [TargetName], was supposed to be doing some preliminary scouting work over at [Location|Address], but they never reported in. We’re hoping that they just ran into some bad luck, but too often out here even the smallest misstep can prove fatal.

I’d appreciate someone heading that way and seeing if they can be located. It’d be great if you find them alive, but if not, some closure is the least we can do for their family.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionC_DerelictOutpost_Eliminat.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from [Location|Address]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

FoxwellEnforcement_BombingRun_Stanton_H.description:
An opportunity has presented itself for a client to take action against a group of criminals who have been harassing their business.

According to reports, this group of outlaws are currently laying low at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. The client thinks this is a good time to catch them off guard and bring them to justice. The job is to take out their fuel tanks and putting an end to their smuggling operations once and for all.

These folks are not to be underestimated. You better bring some backup and fly low to avoid the turrets. Priority as always is the fuel tanks.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: An undercover agent of ours was compromised and is now being pursued by the outlaw pack they had infiltrated. As such, they are in need of immediate extraction at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. 

Once on site, engage with all hostiles in order to provide cover so our operative can QT away.

<EM4>Bring additional backup</EM4> and don't underestimate these outlaws. They are violent and motivated so they are unlikely to give up anytime soon.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions

Need you to head there with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_Rank3_ShepardsRest_Loca.description:
If you happen to be in the area, please read this.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for a qualified mechanic to head to <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> with the required supplies and perform some repairs.

As it stands, you’ll need <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to repair five pipes or so.</EM4> That should help us get the outpost functional again. We'll compensate you for your time and materials.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

It appears that we've lost contact with a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity ships at [Location|Address] after they reported being attacked in their last comm. 

We believe they will be able to hold off the perpetrators until help arrives, but not indefinitely. We need you to rush to their coordinates and deal with the outlaws before its too late.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_XTOutposts_Sabotage.description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at Shadowfall our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation. 

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_EscortShips_Stanton_Super.description:
Our crew at <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised. 

Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

Foxwell_DefendDestructibleEntities_Stant.description:
Calling all pilots – one of our clients is looking for some protection for their <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4>, based in <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. From what we’ve gathered, the attackers are a group of wannabe outlaw pests who probably haven’t realized the value of the assets they’re trying to destroy, just wreaking havoc for the sake of it. Still, the client’s property is important, so should be kept as intact as possible.

If you take care of them to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Hey El here,

Got a weird one for you. I was checking the delivery stats for the past week and noticed some discrepancies. Seems we have a couple of deliveries marked as fulfilled but the cargo trackers are still showing as active.

One of these is located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> so I was hoping you could fly over and get to the bottom of this. The order says the hauler was using a ship that could carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> so make sure you have the same. A <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> is a must for this one too.

That cargo needs to be delivered yesterday, so as soon as you've got it take it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I'll get your payment sorted for you.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping

HH_PAF_HaulCargo_Multi2ToSingle_Small_Hy.description:
We’ve been using the old Hathor <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4> and <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4> as stashes, but it turns out some over-eager nullbrains sniffed them out and are trying to boost our shit for their own.

Luckily, the goods are still there - for now. We need someone to visit that PAF and OLP, grab our stuff from the freight elevators, and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4> where we should be able to keep it on ice. 

Here’s the list of what to grab. Don’t care what order you do ‘em in. Be sure to bring a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> at the very least. 

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>

Make sure you’re ready to deal with whatever assholes you run across. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionD_TradepostToOutpost_5boxe.description:
Headhunters crews have been having a streak of good luck. I figure why take them off the job and stop them earning when I could just hire someone to deliver their spoils instead. Here’s the list of pick-ups needed:    

Pick up package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item5|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>.

Once you grab ‘em, everything needs to go to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Make sure it gets done and done right. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_E_FaunaCave_MissionPers.description:
Junior surveyor [TargetName] fell out of contact with their team while identifying potentially viable mineral seams in a cave near The cave can only be accessed on foot.. Wild animals have been known to frequent this location, which has led Citizens for Prosperity to believe that the surveyor may have been attacked while on the job and is currently stranded. 

We need someone to find them and render aid if at all possible. If it's too late and they're beyond help, it will at least comfort the rest of the team to know what happened to their friend. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_M_OccuCave_JacksonsSwap.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near The cave can only be accessed on foot. which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

LawlessSalvage_Clovus.description:
Fortune has shined upon us once again. I’ve just learned of a battle near [Location] that’s just transpired far from the prying eyes of any meddlesome comm arrays, and reinforcements from either of the forces involved have yet to be dispatched. This means that there is a window of opportunity for an enterprising soul to pick the graveyard clean.
 
I’d like to extend this opportunity to all my trusted contacts. Any and all interested parties can have the location… for the right price. Coordinates will be provided once you accept the contract and will remain available until you choose to terminate it.

Of course, speed will be of the essence as you will not only face potential competition from other salvagers, but also the looming possibility of reinforcements arriving to survey the battlefield.

Refueling_Nyx_Hard.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> looking to be topped up with [FuelType] at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Shubin_RG_Discovery_GroundMine_Stanton_R.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of materials from independent miners operating in the area. We got eyes on a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>.

Ella Tieno

Covalex Shipping

Ship_Refueling_Intro_Stanton.description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: <EM4>make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out</EM4>.

A Club member has run out of ~misssion(FuelType) at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a <EM4>journal entry</EM4> on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

GillysPilotSchool_Mission07.description:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.   

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.    

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>

And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Stanton_R.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

CFP_Pyro_RegionC_E_SacrensPlot_FPSSalvag.description:
Hi,

A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at Sacren's Plot, they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HH_Pyro_RegionD_OutpostToTradepost_3boxe.description:
Got some goods that need to be moved up the chain for us. There are a few boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to make their way to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.   

Never thought when I joined the Headhunters that supply chain management would be part of my job, but someone’s gotta keep the goods flowing, I guess. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_Nyx_Bexal.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Nyx System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[Hint_Location] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.

Reminder, all the <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_Stage1_RegionLink_ToRegi.description:
One of our Judges put out a bulletin asking Headhunters to keep an eye on for [Item]. Got word yesterday that some can be found at [Location|Address]. Feel like making a high ranking Headhunter happy?

All you need to do is get your hands on the goods then run ‘em across system to [Destination|Address].

Stows out.

HH_Pyro_RegionA_VH_3AsteroidBase_XenoThr.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [Location|Address] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Nyx_Hard.description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.  

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right. 

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

RR_Pyro_RatsNest_Local_1box_Single_Couri.description:
Any chance you’re at [Destination]?

Need a box hustled from <EM4>the entrance inside Rat's Nest at the L5 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.   

-Smokey

HH_Pyro_RegionA_CrimBase_Rank1_MissingPe.description:
Sent [TargetName] out to check out a strange noise in one of our storehouses and haven't heard from them in a while. Turns out they got themselves kidnapped. We've got intel that says they're being held at [Location|Address], but we're not sure about the source. Need someone to swing by and make sure the info is legit.  

Whether it's good news or bad, there are some creds in it for you. 

Stows out.

EckhartSecurity_DC_Stanton4_S4Compex-A_S.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4> was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at <EM4>Storehouse</EM4>. We’re looking for a contractor ready and willing to execute this bounty before they disappear again.

Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> to face you directly. 

Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

ByGroup.GroupName: Squad A - Tech or CQC x 2
Squad D - Tech or CQC x 2
Squad E - Tech or Soldier or CQC x 2
Squad F - Tech or CQC x 3
Squad I - Tech or Soldier or CQC x 2 - Roaming
Squad H - CQC or Soldier x 2

CFP_Pyro_RegionD_Danger_Stage1_RegionLin.description:
Citizens for Pyro is concerned about one of our local contractors, [TargetName]. They finished up a trade at [Location|Address] and haven’t been seen since. We’re hearing reports that outlaws have been frequenting the area, so I suspect that the worst might have happened.

Either way, [TargetName|Last] has done good work for us in the past and I’d hate for them to wind up as just another one of the system's missing. If you’re willing to find them for me, I’ll see that you get a reward.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Hockrow_Nyx_Super_MissingPersons.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #MP65648
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
A whole crew has gone missing while undertaking a contract in Nyx for a client that I'm unfortunately not allowed to disclose the full details of to you. Lets just say that it wasn't the safest job and the fact the crew is not responding comms is not surprising but it is concerning. It's vital that we ascertain what happened to them. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate <EM4>[MissingPersonList]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and confirm their status. 

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
This investigation has high potential for there to be aggressive and dangerous hostiles on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bringing other skilled associates with you.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_E_CFPOutpost_MultiBombin.description:
Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves. 

I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to [Location|Address] and really mess the place up. 

Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.

-Stows out

Refueling_Multi_Pyro_Super.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FuelType]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of [RefuelRequest], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

RedWind_Pyro_SupplyGrade_RegionB_CFP_Sta.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Jackson's Swap</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_VH_MissingPerson_Destro.description:
One of our most trusted datarunners, [TargetName], has found themselves the victim of a XenoThreat assault. Now both they and the data they were ferrying have been captured and taken to [Location|Address]. 

I am charging you with heading there to ascertain what happened to [TargetName|First] and to destroy data servers which may be housing the stolen information.

Even if the worst has happened, I think they would want us to make sure they data they were charged with protecting isn't used for nefarious gains.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_DefendShip_Nyx_VeryEasy.description:
Guess some folks just can’t dogfight. Sent a young prospect out on patrol, and am now being barraged with comms about how they’re barely hanging on. Had them update me with the details about who they’re up against and I damn near fell outta my chair laughing.    

If this kid can’t handle a People’s Alliance ship, they sure ain’t ready for flight assignments. Appreciate it if you could save their hide anyway.

If you’re free, could you head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and show ‘em how it’s done?

-Stows

Covalex_Pyro_Super_RecoverCargo.description:
Hey,

Only looking for contractors who are the best of the best for this one. One of our most valued clients is expecting an incredibly important shipment which is now seriously overdue.

Here at Covalex, we pride ourselves on treating all of our clients equally, offering outstanding levels of service regardless of what we're delivering. That being said, if we lose this contract someone's gonna be in hot water and I really can't afford for that person to be me.

The tracker is reporting that the last contractor's ship is over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Don't take any chances with this one, you'll need a ship that can hold <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to collect it all.

Deliver the shipment to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we can put this whole mess behind us. And you'll make a sizeable heap of credits in the process. Not bad, right?

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

CFP_Pyro_RegionB_H_MissingPerson_Theft_X.description:
Hi,

Got a tough assignment here. There’s a small, satellite outpost near [Location|Address] that needs to be investigated. I received intel that it’s housing some of our stolen supplies and sent [TargetName] to retrieve them. Haven’t heard anything from them in a while and am worried they ran into trouble.

XenoThreat controls that location, but I hoped [TargetName|First] could slip in and out without getting noticed. Seems like that spot might be more heavily guarded than expected. Looking for someone to take a look and see what happened to [TargetName|First]. Also, if any of our supplies are found there, I need them taken to [Destination|Address]. 

Do you think you can give it a shot? I’m guessing that the Xenos are entrenched there. Prepare accordingly and don’t expect them to make this easy on you.  

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P1M3.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
The files you found in Engineering confirm that Dr. Jorrit is actively pursuing something at the site, but it is still unclear what the doctor is up to. I’m hoping that if you can find the data he was accessing in Research it will provide further clarity.


Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing to locate and <EM4>access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files</EM4> .

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you accessed these files, I'll be sending you <EM4>5 Secure Drives</EM4> with copies of whatever data we've gathered so far. You can collect them at your home location.

Hockrow_FacilityDelve_P3MM_Repeat.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Once you have those, head down to the <EM4>Lab in Site-B</EM4> and <EM4>run the experiment</EM4> so you can <EM4>upload the results</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

HeadHunters_ShipAmbush_Pyro_Easy.description:
Any interest in taking out a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> for us? 

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.  

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows

HH_Pyro_RegionC_E_UnocCave_MissingPerson.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

RedWind_Pyro_SmallGrade_RegionB_CFP_Stat.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

One of the folks over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> just hit me up about a pile of cargo, <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>  

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

CFP_Pyro_Hard_RecoverCargo.description:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination]</EM4>  and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Covalex_Nyx_Easy_RecoverCargo.description:
Hiya,

I've got a client who's been messaging me all morning about a shipment they were supposed to receive and when I checked up on the cargo it turns out that it's sitting completely still in the middle of space.

This is obviously bad for a number of reasons, and not just because I had to spend 20 minutes getting yelled at. Can you head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and see what happened? The original contract called for a ship that could carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> so make sure you've got that and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

Once you've got the cargo, can you make sure it's delivered to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>? Thanks a bunch.

Covalex Independent Contractors

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

Any chance you’re at [Destination]?

Need a box hustled from <EM4>the entrance inside Megumi Refueling at the L5 Lagrange of Pyro VI</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.

HH_Pyro_RegionB_CrimBase_HRT_RetrieveCar.description:
Need someone to raid a base at [Location|Address] for us. Not sure exactly who’s dug in there, but they attacked one of our ships and took the drugs they were hauling. Really need that shit back. That batch is full of high potency stuff that’s worth a premium. 

Doubt they’ll want to give it back to you, so plan to take it by force. Then bring the goods to The Golden Riviera. And don’t act like an idiot and get any ideas of what you could do with that stuff. Trust me, you don’t wanna get on my bad side. 

- Stows

SOO2.description:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:

Your priority is to <EM4>disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters</EM4> that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces. 

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission. 

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

HH_Pyro_RegionD_E_OccuCave_LastLandings_.description:
Some crew whose name doesn’t even deserve to cross my lips stole a bunch of our supplies, and then hid them in The cave can only be accessed on foot.. As if we wouldn’t be able to track them down. Now that we know where they hid the goods it’s time to make them pay. 

Interested in raiding that cave and getting our shit back? Do your worst to whoever’s inside just don’t damage our goods. Then bring everything to  Last Landings. Sounds kinda fun. Makes me miss my days when I applied my other skills to help the gang.

Stows out.

UnafilliatedHH_Pyro_RegionC_M_2steroidBa.description:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them? 

But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you. 

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

57 65 65 76 69 6c
