CFP_Pyro_RegionD_Lagrange_MRT_RetrieveCa.description:
Hey,

I’m concerned a [Ship] moving medical supplies for us might’ve come under attack. The signal was lost around [Location|Address], which has seen a spike in outlaw activity recently. Losing that ship alone would be bad enough, but it’ll be even worse if those supplies don’t make it to Canard View. 

We would need you to search for the ship at its last known position, recover the supplies, and then take them to Canard View. Your help would make a bad situation better. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

CFP_Pyro_RegionA_Rank0_YangsPlace_Local_.description:
A nearby outpost of ours at <EM4>Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]</EM4> is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

We will need <EM4>three fuses replaced</EM4> and if you could bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes</EM4> that should take care of the rest.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HeadHunters_DefendEntitiesAndEscort_Stan.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>Fuel Tanks</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

FTL_Courier_Nyx_ShipAmmo_Rank0.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
FTL requires an entry-level courier to complete deliveries in Nyx.
Courier must provide own transportation.
Prior training in manual lifting is preferred, with the <EM4>ability to move boxes of up to .25 SCU</EM4> in weight.
By accepting this contract you agree to take full responsibility for the safety of the assigned packages.

[Contractor|SignOff]

InterSec_Bounty_Nyx_VeryHard.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec is in need of a highly skilled combat pilot who can locate and neutralize a dangerous Vanduul target.

An operator of ours has identified a Vanduul ship flying within the vicinity of <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. We've been given strict instructions to eliminate any Vanduul spotted on the fringes of UEE space, for fear of encroachment into the Empire's territory.

Bring a <EM4>small fleet of competent pilots</EM4> with you to engage and neutralize the target.

Respectfully, 

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

CitizensForProsperity_DefendShip_Nyx_Har.description:
We just received word that a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity affiliated ships have been targeted by outlaws and that our people are in dire need of assistance. 

If you are available, we need combat ready pilots at [Location|Address] to defend our people. Note that at this dire time, we cannot afford even a single lost ship and expect with your assistance for all of our people make it out alive.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Xenothreat_Showdown.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for a final assault on the XenoThreat outlaw pack that have been plaguing Stanton System. The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

Rayari_Rank1_Harvestable_Single_JuviTeet.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_NoDanger_.description:
[TargetName] is a local who only has done a few jobs for Citizen for Prosperity, but they had promise. That is, until they went missing while exploring [Location|Address] last week. Unfortunately, we didn’t hear about it until today. Chances of survival at this point are pretty slim, but we still think its worth confirming what happened to them.
 
CFP could use help on this if anyone is interested. And besides being a good deed, the payment should make it worth the effort. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_Generic_P.description:
Time is up for [TargetName]. The skav is way past due on paying back the Headhunters, so I need you to punch them out. 

Kill ‘em, not hit ‘em, just in case that’s unclear. 

Someone recently spotted [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address], so head there and take ‘em out.  

Full disclosure, we’ve gotten reports they used some of our creds to hire extra protection. Prepare accordingly. 

Stows out.

Bye.

Hey,

The folks at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> have what I like to call a “pilot’s special” waiting to be distributed - a haul of quantum fuel, hydrogen fuel, and ship ammo. Load it up from a freight elevator and deliver it to the following spots in whatever order works best for you. Expect the containers to all be <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4> 

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Independent Contractors

Chase Hewitt

TheCollector_GG_Karna(DO_NOT_USE_STORE_E.description: Wikelo friend had to trade ship they found for credits. Wikelo surprised to find many crate of Karna guns inside. Friend must not have wanted. Anyway, Wikelo figure out how to make prettier. If you want, bring stuff. Bye.

Firesale_Intro_CFP.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would be able to resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address] with detatrine. </EM4>

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several <EM4>depots</EM4> around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Multi-EliminateBoss_Bespoke_2Location.description:
Crusader Security has received intelligence that a Nine Tails raid currently occurring at [MissionCluster|Address] includes several prominent gang enforcers. Ending this raid and bringing those responsible to justice is a top priority for Crusader Security. That's why we're looking for a contractor willing to go and apprehend those leading it.

At each attack site, you will need to deplete the Nine Tails forces there until you are able to draw out the enforcer in charge.

Considering the brutality deployed by Nine Tails during their recent siege, we recommend that contractors be prepared to use force and strongly encourage them to consider bringing back-up.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

PU_SalvageContractor_Coverup_Stanton2_Ve.description:
Got a particular salvage job that we could use some extra hands on. 

We need you to find a [ship] that got punched out around [location]. Security’s already searching for it and if they find it, they’ll ID it for sure and we’ll be in loads of trouble.

So, we want you to make sure that can’t happen. Either tow the ship out of the search area or rip the entire hull off so nobody can tell who it belonged to. Whatever you decide, keep your mouth shut about this. 

We’ll cred you up and anything you scrap is yours to keep. But if security finds the ship before you’re done, we’ll all be screwed and you won’t get paid so don’t disappoint.

PU_NTLockdown_FleetFind.description:
Crusader Security has learned that the criminal organization known as the Nine Tails have set an illegal blockade around [Location] and stopped all incoming and outgoing quantum traffic in the sector.

The outlaw fleet must be located, and the blockade terminated.

We are urgently requesting any trained security professionals in the system to join Crusader Security forces and protect our scanning ships as they seek out the location of the Nine Tails fleet causing this blockade.

Please bear in mind that with quantum travel disabled and numerous hostiles in the area, this should be considered a high-risk operation. Proper equipment and a full tank of fuel is strongly recommended for all pilots joining this emergency response effort. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

PU_EliminateSpecific_Caves_Pyro3.description:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader [TargetName] is holed up at [location|address] working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without [TargetName|Last] getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out [TargetName|Last], but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.  

Stows out.

PU_EliminateSpecific_DC_Stanton_FOB_CryA.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend [TargetName] from Security Compound. They were recently spotted near the Security Compound and are believed to still be in that area.

While there may be other criminals active at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to Security Compound.
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_H.description:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over [location|address].

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

Hi there,

There’s a few sites on ArcCorp that need their waste and scrap collected (all boxes <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller) and taken to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Doesn’t matter what order you do the run, as long as you grab it all.

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>

You know, my mom was a hauler who specialized in runs like this. It might not be the most glamorous stuff, but she claimed these runs had the best pay-to-risk ratio. Pirates never gave her any trouble when they found out what was on board.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters.description:
Got a minor annoyance the Headhunters need dealt with. There's an orbital sentry at [location|address] that some pesky little troublemaker set up to spy on our ops. Want to make some easy creds and go blow it up for us?

Stows out.

PU_Delivery_Local_Illegal_Intro.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

I know you've done some solid work for us in the past, so I figured I'd see if you were interested in handling a bit of a special run for us that's a bit farther out in the system than what you've been doing so far.

In a nutshell, we need a pilot who's willing to keep their head down, focus on getting the packages delivered, and most importantly, not ask a lot of questions.

See, for a smaller company like us, staying ahead of competition means that we need to offer our clients something they can't get elsewhere - discretion. At Red Wind, as long as you got the credits we'll take whatever to wherever. Understand?

If that sounds good to you, let's see how you do on this run -

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup2|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup3|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff2|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff3|Address]</EM4>

One last bit of advice, it would probably be good to avoid any unnecessary delays once you got the packages onboard, for example being searched by local law enforcement.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at [location|address] where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.      

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it. 

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us. 

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.     

- Smokey

HexPenetrator_Bounty_1.description:
Our analysts have examined the intel seized from those XenoThreat recon teams but the data appears to be locked behind a sophisticated encryption system and requires a custom cryptokey to access.

We've managed to locate several XenoThreat lieutenants operating in the system, you are to find and engage the suspects and see if they are in possession of a cryptokey that will allows us to access the intel.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Stanton2.description:
Thanks to a recent arrest, we have learned the location of an active bounty by the name of [TargetName]. They are currently believed to be holed up at [Location|Address]. You have been authorized to enter the site, find them, and resolve the bounty.

We have every reason to believe that there will be other criminal elements at the site, but for the moment, only [TargetName|Last] is your concern. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

NorthRock_Bounty_General_PVP.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship. 

The suspect you would be after is known as <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

An extreme-risk target typically pilots a sub-capital class vessel, has several heavily-armed allies, and is expected to be very difficult to apprehend. It may be useful to bring along support staff to assist with engaging this target.

RESPONSIBILITIES

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

PU_TripMinesTheft_DC_Stanton_SecPed_Aban.description:
I was hopin’ you’d be interested in pulling a little job for us. Got some goods over at [Location|Address] that are just right for the taking. Only problem is – and it’s a big one – the bastards running the place have the whole area rigged with proximity mines. 

You’ll need to find someway through, or if you can’t be bothered, someway to trigger the lot. Either way, just try not to blow yourself up. Then you just need to grab the stuff and take it over to [Destination|Address].

It won’t be easy to pull off, but if you do, I promise I’ll make it worth your while.

PU_NTLockdown_FleetDestroy_L4.description:
Crusader Security has confirmed the location of the outlaw Nine Tails fleet responsible and is mobilizing now to end the quantum blockade of [Location].

We are again seeking trained security professionals to join with our emergency response efforts and assist in neutralizing this dangerous threat.

Before accepting, please be aware that the Nine Tails are fully expected to offer considerable resistance and that until the blockade is ended, quantum travel will not be possible in the sector.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

PU_Space_Escort_Rescue_Battaglia_Intro.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: ARMED ESCORT

WORK BRIEF:  
An urgent comm has arrived from a miner out near [Location]. They picked up a possible threat in the area and are rightly concerned that they will not be able to make it to [Destination] without an armed ship escorting them.
DURATION:
This is an active situation and needs an immediate response.   
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate once the miner is escorted to their final destination. If hostilities do occur, a combat pay bonus will be issued.
SPECIAL NOTES:
There is a good reason the miner is shelling out for an escort. The area has seen more than its fair share of trouble recently. Do what you have to so my miner comes back in one piece.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_GuardianMX.description:
You Humans enjoy strange letter combinations. It very funny. Guardian ship very useful but if you want even more useful, bring me things. I give you better ship. Look better. Act better.

Thank you. Bye.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Legal_Ha.description:
ATTN: Mercenaries with Cargo Handling Experience

Nine Tails are currently assaulting one of our facilities at [Location|address]. As they just received a delivery of confidential materials, we don’t believe this is a coincidence. BlacJac needs someone to hurry to the location and secure these important boxes before the Nine Tails do. You are authorized to use lethal force against any who attempt to stop you. 

As part of our standard security protocol, the confidential materials were integrated into another consignment and secured in the automated vault. You’ll need to find the relevant retrieval codes for the confidential materials and enter it at the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. Retrieval codes are stored locally on datapads and only given to high-ranking staff. Hopefully they’re alive to help you, but considering the complete comms blackout, we fear that’s not the case. There's a chance Nine Tails have already gotten their hands on the datapads.  

Once you’ve gathered all the confidential materials, they will need to be delivered to [dropoff1|address]. Payment is contingent upon their delivery.


Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

Firesale_HH.description:

The good news is that <EM4>depots</EM4> across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal_In.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking [Location|address]. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [dropoff1|address]. 


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

Wish I could see the surprise look on the faces of the lowlifes running the place when it happens.

-Bit Zeros

The Headhunters have assembled a special strike team whose sole purpose is to attack, disrupt, and undermine our operations. As much as I’m loath to admit it, they’ve had a few small successes and are quickly becoming a concern. 

XenoThreat knows the best way to kill a snake is by cutting off its head, so we’re issuing a kill order for the strike team’s commander [TargetName], who according to our intelligence sources, has been hiding at [Location|Address] for a few days now. 

I’d expect strong resistance from the Headhunter forces there. From what we’ve heard, [TargetName|Last] got this command partially because of the fierce loyalty they inspire in others. Putting your own crew together to tackle this would be a solid operational strategy. 

Happy Head Hunting,

Comm. Spec. Engler

Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of <EM4>Tungsten</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_XenoThreat_vs_HeadHun.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on [TargetName]. As a Clips level member of the Headhunters gang, [TargetName|Last] has led operations that have targeted XenoThreat operatives, missions, and infrastructure. For these transgressions, XenoThreat will pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates [TargetName|Last].  

LOCATION UPDATE: [TargetName|Last] was seen near [Location|Address] not too long ago.  If you decide to accept this contract, you should head to the coordinates immediately. [TargetName|Last] knows we’re looking for ‘em and has been traveling with an escort recently. Don’t be surprised if they’re not alone.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
Rough & Ready recently provided fueling services for a hauler named [TargetName], who agreed to deliver their next load of supplies to us as compensation. Well, we just found out that the lying skag sold their latest shipment to a rival gang instead. 

We’re looking for someone to track down and eliminate [TargetName|Last] for the double cross. 

An old friend of mine just spotted the skag at [Location|Address]. Looks like they're loaded with more cargo that’s not coming our way, and traveling with an escort. We’re only paying you to take out the ship, so anything you find aboard is yours to keep.

- Smokey

PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_General_.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship. 

The suspect you would be after is known as <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.description:

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_E.description:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over [location|address].

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

Rayari_Rank3_IrradiatedPearls.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

YardRush_Mining_Medium_HH_Stanton.description:

Up to you how you get the stuff. Mine it, steal it, buy it from a trader - I don’t care as long as I get what I need refined and delivered. Might be worth checking Daymar or Aberdeen to start.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliv.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Braden Corchado

HexPenetrator_RecoverDeliver.description:
Attention CDF volunteers, XenoThreat's gone off the grid. We suspect that they have gone dark in order to prep for the final phase of their plan. 

History has proven that XenoThreat like to fight so it stands to reason that this might be an attack of some kind so we're calling on volunteers to deliver supplies to the Gateway station near the Stanton-Pyro jump point to shore up for a potential assault.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Illegal_.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_Defend_Lawful_Stanton4_H.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can assemble a security team in order to protect [Location|Address] against hostile threats. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Provide own security team to assist.
• Protect the site against hostile threats; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with managing a team.

ContainersHeist.description:
I’m looking at an inventory transfer record right now that is bursting at the seams with a whole lot of very valuable cargo that is practically begging to be stolen. Sure there’s probably a few people there guarding the goods, but the harder the fight the sweeter the loot, right?

Normally, we’d be all over a job like this, but we got another target in our sights right now and I’d hate for info this good to rot.  

What do you say? You wanna crack at it? Send me a few creds and the location is all yours.

-Bit Zeros

Tutorial01_Basics_NewBabbage.description:
Congratulations on taking your first steps into the universe!

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space. 

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.

CleanAir_System-To-System_SingleToMulti_.description:
All right, this one is going to be a bit different. See, with everything going on with Alliance Aid, we had a screw up with our contracts and an important shipment got overlooked. Since lives are at stake, and you've already done so much to help the Transport Division, I was kinda hoping that you'd be able to step up and do a double run for us?

There's a medium scale haul of <EM4>Molina Mold treatment on microtech</EM4> and shipment of <EM4>ventilation filters on Hurston</EM4> waiting for pick-up. You'll need to make both stops, load up everything, and bring it all to <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

And I would double check to make sure you have your <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you before heading out. Would be a huge headache if you forgot to bring one!  

It's really amazing of you to be helping out like this,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_XenoThreat_vs_HeadHun.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on [TargetName]. As a Clips level member of the Headhunters gang, [TargetName|Last] has led operations that have targeted XenoThreat operatives, missions, and infrastructure. For these transgressions, XenoThreat will pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates [TargetName|Last].  

LOCATION UPDATE: [TargetName|Last] was seen near [Location|Address] not too long ago.  If you decide to accept this contract, you should head to the coordinates immediately. [TargetName|Last] knows we’re looking for ‘em and has been traveling with an escort recently. Don’t be surprised if they’re not alone.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Stanton2_Flo.description:
Thanks to a recent arrest, we have learned the location of an active bounty by the name of [TargetName]. They are currently believed to be holed up at [Location|Address]. You have been authorized to enter the site, find them, and resolve the bounty.

We have every reason to believe that there will be other criminal elements at the site, but for the moment, only [TargetName|Last] is your concern. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro3_Ea.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.description:
Some numbskull is trying to dig up dirt on the Headhunters. Some orbital sentries were dropped at [location|address] to spy on us. We’ve also spotted a ship checking on them. Simple proposition for you. Go wipe out the sentries there and we’ll pay you for it. That sound like something you’d be into?

As for the ship, you can do whatever you want with it, but if it spots you, don’t be surprised if it tries to go get some back up. That’s just how these things go.

Stows out.

PU_MissingPerson_Stations_Pyro_CFP_Pyro3.description:
Two locals we work with were out salvaging at [Location|Address] when they had some issues with faulty equipment. One managed to escape, but their partner, [TargetName] was unfortunately left behind.

With the state they were last reported to be in, I’m guessing they didn’t make it, but I’d like to know for sure. If you’re willing, I could use your help in finding their remains.

If you can track them down, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated for the effort.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_Standard.description:
Hey, 

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name [TargetName] has been located at [Location|Address].

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

Crusader Security is seeking a contractor willing to clear all Nine Tails operators in the area. Contractors should expect to use force and are strongly encouraged to consider bringing back-up.

Liaison Officer Bautista

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP_Pyro6.description:
Leave it to the lying UEE to say they’re not involved with the operations of Citizens for Prosperity simply because they “donate” supplies to a tertiary aid organization who then immediately delivers it right to them. 

We just got word that one of these government aid shipments was dropped off at a Citizens for Prosperity aligned outpost. That’s why we’ll pay you to raid [Pickup1|Address] and claim the [item] for the cause. Once you deliver everything to [Dropoff1|Address] we can redistribute the shipment to help in our fight. Nothing better than using the enemies resources against them. 

But don’t think they’ll just hand the stuff over to you. Even though Citizens for Prosperity are supposedly here to bring peace, you best be prepared to go toe to toe with ‘em. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend [TargetName] who has so far been able to evade capture. They are coordinating an active raid that has spread throughout [Location|Address].

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the packages. You'll be able to ID them by their serial numbers: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>,
<EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> and
<EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

Braden Corchado

Northrock Service Group

Rayari_Rank1_Gems_Single_Jaclium.description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart_Int.description:
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In relation to a jointly committed crime, a group warrant has been issued for:
     [Target1]
     [Target2]
     [Target3]

It is currently believed that they are no longer traveling together in order to evade capture, and may soon flee the system.  You should strongly consider recruiting additional help in order to execute all the warrants in the limited time frame. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the targets. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract when all targets have been dealt with in the allotted time.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Rayari_Rank2_IrradiatedKopionHorns_Gathe.description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but for our scientists to continue their efforts they need resources that the company's suppliers have been unable to deliver. 

There is a sizeable population of kopions that have been exposed to radiation near <EM4>[Location]</EM4>. Rayari is seeking an contractor to collect <EM4>irradiated kopion horns</EM4> and deliver them to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Due to the scarcity of this resource, we are prepared to pay a high service fee. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

Eliminate members of the Nine Tails Organization.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Stanton4_Medium.description:

LOCATION: [LagrangeLocation]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
A recently acquired Shubin Interstellar mining claim awaiting processing was discovered to have been jumped by a rogue mining outfit who are actively stealing ore from the site.  While local authorities have been notified, there is concern that valuable assets may be harvested before an official investigation can be launched.

Therefore, as is our right as claim holders, we wish to secure a mercenary force to go to [Location] and destroy the several orbital sentries that are protecting this illegal operation. Caution is advised as there may still be a few illegal miners at the location along with any reinforcements they muster. 




*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
My associates and I have found ourselves in a little predicament and could use some help. There’s an orbital sentry at [location|address] that’s spying on us. We don’t know who put it there, but it sure as hell can’t stay. 

Thing is we’re business minded folks first and foremost and worry that if we blow it up ourselves it’ll start shit. That’s why it’s better if someone like you does it. Should be a quick and easy gig for someone interested in earning some creds.   

- Smokey

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic.description:
Interested in doing a little hunting? 

[TargetName] sabotaged one of our fuel shipments and cost us a ton of creds, so I’m looking for someone to make ‘em pay for what they did. Just got word [TargetName|Last] was spotted at [Location|Address]. If you head there now, there’s a good chance you can pick up their trail and take ‘em out for good. 

[TargetName|Last] didn’t work alone, so don’t be surprised if they’re traveling with extra protection.

- Smokey

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Stanton4_Hard.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LagrangeLocation]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
A local Stanton independent mining team was working [Location] as Shubin Interstellar contractors when a hostile force attacked and took over the site. We believe that the perpetrators are still at the claim using the equipment left behind to harvest the valuable ore there for themselves.

Among the equipment lost were a handful of orbital sentries that had unfortunately not yet been fully deployed at the time of the attack. Long range scans of the claim have led us to conclude that the outlaws have activated the orbital sentries and are using them to protect their illegal operations.

To reclaim the site, we are seeking contractors to go to [Location], destroy the orbital sentries, and clear the site of hostile miners. Efficiency is strongly recommended as there is a high risk they will call for reinforcements once they discover they’re being evicted. 




*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

TheCollector_Vehicle_Super_Idris.description: Since Wikelo has done good business with you, make you this very special trade. Idris is a powerful ship perfect for big important person like you. Wikelo has even done mod to make it more dangerous! Bring me a few items and the ship is yours.

YardRush_Salvage_LargeDontation_Intro_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to do a resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address] and bring them the salvaged materials. </EM4>

Scrap it yourself or take it off some unsuspecting scav. Should be able to find some wrecks orbiting around most planets. Your call. Either way, as soon as we get the supplies, we’ll put it to good use building back up everything we lost.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Stanton1_Int.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

PU_ShipHijacked_Rclmr_Retrieve_Datapad.description:
Ran into a bit of crap luck that I'm hoping you can help me right.

A few days ago, I hired the crew of the 'Pride of Arliss' to obtain some important data for me. They pulled off the job no problem, but the bastard of a captain comm'd me demanding more credits. Turns out it wasn't the first time he's tried to pull this trick either because in middle of "negotiating" with me, his ship was attacked by some very pissed off individuals looking to teach him a lesson.

Our comm got cut off when the shooting started and that was the last I heard from him. I'm guessing he's as good as ghosted, but I want you to head to the Pride of Arliss and try to get my data off the captain's personal datapad.

Once you have it, I set up a secure transmission channel at the ARC-L1 rest stop. Travel there and when you're in range, submit the data to me through this contract to get paid.
  
Don’t try to screw me over either. Karma can be a real asshole.

PU_HijackedShip_Caterpillar_Stanton4.description:
Here’s the deal - A couple of long timers got snagged pulling a job for me and I want you to spring them. 

A friendly mechanic has arranged for their prison transport to run into some trouble en route, venting the front door and bringing the ship to a halt. You’re gonna go, dispatch any security escorting the transport, find the prisoner manifest aboard, and use it to locate my crew’s cryopods.

The popsicles I’m after are [NameKill1], [NameSave2], [NameSave1], and [NameSave3]. All have been loyal and deserve better than rotting in jail.

At least I think they've been loyal... I'm still wondering how they got pinched in the first place. I can't shake the feeling that one of them may have been doubling dealing. Tell you what, if you find any proof that one of my crew has been working with the Advocacy, liquidate their cryopod and I’ll see you get a bonus. 

Once you've activated the right pods and my people are starting to thaw, get the hell out of there and let the retrieval team handle the rest. This last bit is important. See, once they’re defrosted, they're gonna be sent off to retirement. No sense in them knowing any more about my business than they already do, i.e. I don’t want these lunks seeing your face or even knowing you exist. 

Once you’re back on your way, I’ll send you a hefty pile of well deserved creds.

Now just in case you’re getting any ideas along the lines of “Why don’t I just free everyone?” or “Wouldn’t it be easier to shut them all up permanently?” Forget it. The politics of this whole thing is more complicated than you need to know. Just trust me when I say that if any extra prisoners get freed or die without me ordering it, you’ll be the one who pays. Want all your money? Do what you’re told and that’s it. 

-Twitch

Pacheco_Stanton1_HijackedShip_Caterpilla.description:
Here’s the deal - A couple of long timers got snagged pulling a job for me and I want you to spring them. 

A friendly mechanic has arranged for their prison transport to run into some trouble en route, venting the front door and bringing the ship to a halt. You’re gonna go, dispatch any security escorting the transport, find the prisoner manifest aboard, and use it to locate my crew’s cryopods.

The popsicles I’m after are [NameSave2], [NameKill1], [NameSave3], and [NameSave1]. All have been loyal and deserve better than rotting in jail.

At least I think they've been loyal... I'm still wondering how they got pinched in the first place. I can't shake the feeling that one of them may have been doubling dealing. Tell you what, if you find any proof that one of my crew has been working with the Advocacy, liquidate their cryopod and I’ll see you get a bonus. 

Once you've activated the right pods and my people are starting to thaw, get the hell out of there and let the retrieval team handle the rest. This last bit is important. See, once they’re defrosted, they're gonna be sent off to retirement. No sense in them knowing any more about my business than they already do, i.e. I don’t want these lunks seeing your face or even knowing you exist. 

Once you’re back on your way, I’ll send you a hefty pile of well deserved creds.

Now just in case you’re getting any ideas along the lines of “Why don’t I just free everyone?” or “Wouldn’t it be easier to shut them all up permanently?” Forget it. The politics of this whole thing is more complicated than you need to know. Just trust me when I say that if any extra prisoners get freed or die without me ordering it, you’ll be the one who pays. Want all your money? Do what you’re told and that’s it. 

-Twitch

*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

A hostile fleet of ships equipped with quantum jammers have created a blockade around  [Location|address], disabled the station's defensive turrets, and stolen a large supply of Zeta-Prolanide. In response, the CDF has received authorization to activate its volunteer force. 

Though the overall situation is dire, the theft of the Zeta-Prolanide is our priority. Without direct action, the loss of the sector's Zeta-Prolanide stores could have a devastating effects to the wider economy of the whole system.

CDF volunteers are tasked with heading to these locations, recovering the stolen Zeta-Prolanide, and transferring it back to the station before the material completely degrades and is no longer viable. Just be careful, intel suggests that larger clusters of Zeta-Prolanide have a higher outlaw presence.

Since time is of the essence, having a tractor beam to assist in moving the cargo is highly advised.

As an added incentive, volunteers will receive regular bonus payments for their combined efforts.

You might have heard of [TargetName] before. They’re an extreme-risk target and they’ve been making headlines recently. The hope is you’ll be able to put together a response team and help BlacJac shut them down for good. Our most recent intel has their sub-capital ship and heavily armed escorts flying over at [Location|Address].
 
I’d recommend making sure you’ve got an up-to-date imprint before heading out. Just in case. 

Good luck,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

TheCollector_SlimyLMG.description: This gun has picture of amazing creature on side. Use it and it make you big and strong like Yormandi. Spit lightning. Bring my items and then you get it. Bye.

TheCollector_F55(DO_NOT_USE_NOW_LOOT).description: Sometimes you shoot people, but if you are last thing they see before dead gun should look amazing, right? Wikelo will make your gun look much better. Bring me items I need and then I give you the gun. Bye.

PU_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Stanton3_Int.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

I have more bounties than I have bounty hunters at the moment, so I'm looking to expand our roster. 

If you do a good job on this first one, there'll be more contracts to follow. 

Let's see how you do trying to deal with the bounty on [TargetName]. They're believed to be hiding over at [Location|Address]. 

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Our resistance movement is growing by the day, but that comes with some unwanted attention.  Recent scans discovered orbital sentries at [location|address] and a ship running a patrol pattern. We believe this is part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, most likely funded by the UEE. 

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to destroy the sentries ASAP.  Since they already have eyes and ears on us, sending in someone from outside the org would draw less attention. If you take the gig, you’ll be paid promptly once the sentries are destroyed.
 
Now, while the patrol ship isn’t the main target, we suspect that if it escapes it might have reinforcements in reserve. Might be smart to deal with it promptly. 

If you decide to help us, XenoThreat will remember you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Stanton4.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend [TargetName] from [Location|Address]. 

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

NorthRock_Bounty_PVP_Intro.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship. 

The suspect you would be after is known as <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in [location|address]. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic.description:
I have a delicate situation that needs handling. After years of being a loyal member of Rough & Ready, [TargetName] defected from the gang and is out there shopping secrets to our rivals. We need [TargetName|Last] ghosted immediately. 

With stuff like this, I’ve found it’s always better to pay someone unassociated with us to do the deed. Scans picked up [TargetName|Last] near [Location|Address] not too long ago. We’ll pay you well to head there now and take care ‘em for us. 

[TargetName|Last] isn’t an idiot and knows we’ll be coming after ‘em. Be prepared for a helluva fight and don’t expect ‘em to be alone.

- Smokey

PU_Delivery_Local_Illegal_Deliver5_Stant.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got another special job that I could use you on. This one's a bit more complicated since there's a few more packages to keep track of. Here's the list:

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup2|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup3|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup4|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item5|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup5|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff2|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff3|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff4|Address]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item5|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff5|Address]</EM4> 

Make sure the right packages get to where they're going. You really don't want to have to explain a mix up to these particular clients.

PU_EliminateAll_Unlawful_EliminateCompet.description:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at [Location|Address], but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

What I want you to do, is go there and kill all the guards while making sure all the workers remain unharmed.

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Elimin.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: [Contractor|Auth]
RISK ASSESSMENT: Moderate Risk Target (Possible Armed Support)
RUSH CONTRACT: [Contractor|BountyTimed]

Under the authority of Hurston Dynamics as granted by the UEE, a bounty has been issued for [TargetName] relating to crimes against the corporation. 

The subject is believed to be recently located at [Location|Address], potentially with several allies. Force may be required to gain access to the site and neutralize [TargetName|Last]. [Location|CaveSize]

Payment will be released only after the bounty has been deemed complete.
 

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_Delivery_Local_Illegal_Deliver1_Stant.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got another special job that I could use you on. Should be a quick run.

PACKAGE FOR PICK UP
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>)

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

And please remember not to bother the clients or any of their guests. Professionalism is the key here.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at [location|address] where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.      

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it. 

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us. 

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.     

- Smokey

PU_Defend_Lawful_Stanton2_M.description:
Crusader Security has learned that [Location|Address] is currently being threatened by a local gang and we’re looking to hire a contractor to put together a security team to deal with any attacks. 

This gang has a bit of a record, but they’re still pretty green overall. I expect it will be relatively straightforward for you and your team to handle.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_H.description:
A fledgling syndicate have set up shop over at [Location|Address] and have been trying their hand at cracking into the drug market. Unfortunately, their product has been linked to several deaths in and around Crusader. With how potent this stuff is, it’s posing a serious threat to the public. 

Crusader is working to take down the whole operation, but as long as their product is circulating, the bodies are starting to pile up. 

We want you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there before they get a chance to sell it. However, you should expect their stash to be extremely well guarded.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti2_RefinedOre_Tung.description:
Hey there,

There’s some refined ore in containers <EM4>1 SCU</EM4> or smaller that needs to be moved from a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to production facilities on microTech. You can plan the drop offs anyway you want. Doesn’t matter what order they get done as long as they get there.  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4> 

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Independent Contractors

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

The refinery at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> has been busy. They’ve processed a mix of refined ores and are looking to get the containers (<EM4>16 SCU</EM4> or smaller) shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see where this stuff is needed and was able to put together this run.

Hi,

There’s a load of stims at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me?

PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_NoDanger_.description:
[TargetName] is a local who only has done a few jobs for Citizen for Prosperity, but they had promise. That is, until they went missing while exploring [Location|Address] last week. Unfortunately, we didn’t hear about it until today. Chances of survival at this point are pretty slim, but we still think its worth confirming what happened to them.
 
CFP could use help on this if anyone is interested. And besides being a good deed, the payment should make it worth the effort. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Vaughn_ReaserchFacilitySide_RegionA_Elim.description:
I've been conscripted to provide a trigger pull for a very motivated client. The target is <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, a loathsome character by all accounts who's seemed to relish the temporary authority that their mercenary position affords them. They believe their sadism to be righteous and my client would like to remind them otherwise.

They have recently been hired by ASD as part of a mercenary team at <EM4>[Location]</EM4>, so it won't be an easy approach as there will undoubtedly be other armed individuals. I'll expect you to react accordingly, but [TargetName|Last] is your target.

You will be paid upon completion.

All the best,

Vaughn

Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.  

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you. 

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of <EM4>Corundum</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton4_MTPro_ReHiring.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself. 

To reevaluate your skills, we would like you to apprehend [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to vehicle suitably outfitted for combat.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoTh.description:
[TargetName] was recently revealed to be a mole for XenoThreat. It all makes sense now because the skav was a major asshole. Unfortunately, they split before we could handle it ourselves. 

Based on all they learned about our ops, we need ‘em taken out pronto. They see one of us coming and they’ll just run again, but I figured someone like you has a better chance of getting close enough for a killshot. 

We just got word [TargetName|Last] was hanging around [Location|Address]. Looks like there’s other ships around protecting ‘em too. Think you got the skill to rid the ‘verse of a traitorous bastard and their bastard friends?  

Stows out.

CleanAir_Small_ResourceGathering_Researc.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_Stanton3.description:
A security officer by the name of [TargetName] is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at [Location|Address] along with a host of other eager types in uniforms. 

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of [TargetName] which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic.description:
Rough & Ready have been in business with [TargetName] for years but that relationship has taken a turn for the worse. For a while, we were supplying them with fuel on credit but when it came time to collect the coward went into hiding. If [TargetName|Last] can’t pay with creds, guess they’re gonna pay with their life.

An associate just clocked [TargetName|Last] at [Location|Address]. I’d love for you to head there now to make the stingy bastard pay.

By the way, it looks like [TargetName|Last] isn’t traveling alone, so I’d make sure you’re fully stocked before going after ‘em. 

- Smokey

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
Recently made an interesting discovery that someone set up a handful of orbital sentries at [location|address]. Guess they’re trying to grab some info about our operations there. They even have a few ships guarding to make sure nothing happens to them. 

Of course, we want these bastards gone, but I’m worried that getting rid of it ourselves would be bad for business. That’s why we’re looking for a little ‘plausible deniability’. Someone from outside of R&R to eliminate the problem, so whoever is behind it can’t directly tie the attack back to us. I know this won’t be a walk in the park, especially with those guards lurking. Who knows how many reinforcements they have at the ready? But if you manage to get it done, we’re prepared to see you paid right. 

Think you’ve got the skills to pull this off? 

- Smokey

TheCollector_Battle.description: Bring me armor and other things and I give you special test armor. First version. Very special. Bring and I give. Bye.

TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_Fortune.description: Hello, practicing on making ship fly better. Xi'an help human make ship. Fly good. Salvage good. But Wikelo can make better if you want. Bring things and will do. Bye.

PU_FPS_EliminateTarget.description: Kill the drug dealer who has been taking more than his cut on the profits

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_Generic_P.description:
The Headhunters recently loaned credits to [TargetName] under some clear conditions. Specifically, pay us back or we’ll kill you. Wild to think that wasn’t enough of an incentive, but here we are past the payment deadline. Now as much as we like [TargetName|First], I need you to make good on our promise.

[TargetName|Last] was last seen at [Location|Address]. Track ‘em down, ghost ‘em, and get paid. It’s as simple as that. 

Stows out.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Illegal.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic.description:
I have a delicate situation that needs handling. After years of being a loyal member of Rough & Ready, [TargetName] defected from the gang and is out there shopping secrets to our rivals. We need [TargetName|Last] ghosted immediately.

- Smokey

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
My associates and I brokered a deal with a hauler named [TargetName] to deliver supplies to us. Funny thing is the shipment never showed up. They claimed pirates raided their ship and took our supplies, but it turns out that story’s 100% ranta dung.

Lying to back out of our deal can’t go unanswered and you’re going to make that message abundantly clear. [TargetName|Last] was recently seen with an escort at [Location|Address]. As long as you kill [TargetName|Last], we don’t care what happens to the cargo they’re hauling. 

- Smokey

TheCollector_Nov_LotsOfZipZap(DO_NOT_USE.description:
You need useful weapon. Yes, yes, understand. Wikelo make useful weapon more beautiful too. You see things I need. You bring? I do.

Bye.

PU_Collect_Covalex_Personal_Ed.description:
My brother was one of those people who died when that Covalex station near Crusader blew. Even worse, he was borrowing something of mine when it happened. Now some red tape asshole is trying to tell me that I have to wait to get my stuff back. Yeah right. First you kill my brother and now you want me to be patient? The nerve of these corporate jillos. Forget that. Instead, I figured I'd hire someone to go to Gundo to get my stuff and take it to [Destination] for me. I mean, what the hell are they gonna do about it? Anyway, it's what my brother would have wanted. It's gonna be the box marked 156.

- Ed

PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliv.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in Hangar 13. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

YardRush_Mining_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of resources is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to do a resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Up to you how you get the stuff. Mine it, steal it, buy it from a trader - I don’t care as long as I get what I need refined and delivered. Might be worth checking the asteroid clusters near LaGrange points to start.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_Destroy_Generator_KeypadLocked_DC_Sta.description:
I need your help on a job, but I can’t get too detailed about the specifics. If that doesn’t work for you, than don’t worry about it.

You’re going to head to Lobby and blow up a power generator for us. Now, they keep the gen locked up, so you’ll have to hunt down the access codes first. Thankfully, they typically keep copies of the code on datapads. (Thinks it’ll keep ‘em safe from being hacked.)

You get that generator destroyed, and it’ll be your bank account blowin’ up next.

- Bit Zeros

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
A price has been set on the heads of [TargetName] and [TargetName2]. 

While having to hit two targets isn't that weird, the client wants to send a very specific message, so they need to targets hit at the exact same moment. The extra credits should make up for the hassle.

And unfortunately since the pair aren't traveling together, it goes without saying that to pull it off you're gonna need some help. Make sure you bring people you trust can handle more than one ships since the targets are known to travel with backup.

PU_Delivery_DC_Stanton_Courier_To_Stanto.description:
Greetings Qualified Shipping Partner!

Ready to try your hand delivering a fairly sizeable shipment of packages? Then how about you assist with taking this allotment to the [Dropoff1] at [Dropoff1|Address]. Just clear enough space on your ship first and you should be all set!

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER) 
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>
