YardRush_Salvage_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to do a resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address] and bring them the salvaged materials. </EM4>

Scrap it yourself or take it off some unsuspecting scav. Should be able to find some wrecks orbiting around most planets. Your call. Either way, as soon as we get the supplies, we’ll put it to good use building back up everything we lost.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton2_CruSec_Intro.description:
In an effort to increase the safety of Crusader and its environs, Crusader Security is seeking qualified individuals to assist with the collection of bounties in the area. 

We have evaluated that you possess the skill set needed and as such, we would like to offer you an initial trial bounty contract for [TargetName] last seen at [Location|Address]. 

Upon the successful completion of this contract, you will be placed on Crusader's Verified Freelancer list and be eligible for any future bounty collection work as it becomes available.


CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

KillAndCollectAnimals.description: Locate any type of Kopion and bring us some of their horns

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Sta.description:
Crusader Security has learned that [Location|Address] is currently being used as a base of operations for numerous illegal activities.

In order to put a stop to this "nest of criminals," we are seeking a contractor to go to the site and clear all the hostile elements. By force if necessary.

And just so you know, sometimes gangs like this will bring in civilians to do work for them, often through coercion. This should go without saying, but if you see any civilians they are to be protected. Crusader Security cannot have one of their contractors going around indiscriminately shooting people.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart_Low.description:
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In relation to a jointly committed crime, a group warrant has been issued for:
     [Target1]
     [Target2]
     [Target3]

It is currently believed that they are no longer traveling together in order to evade capture, and may soon flee the system.  You should strongly consider recruiting additional help in order to execute all the warrants in the limited time frame. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the targets. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract when all targets have been dealt with in the allotted time.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Spirit_C1.description: Wikelo love useful cargo ship. Spirit is very useful. If you want one, can make for you. Just bring me things and I will do. Bye.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Illegal_.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton_NorthRock_Intro.description:
Hey,

Hope everything is going all right. I may have reached out to you already, but just in case, I wanted to message you again. I'm a logistics officer for the Stanton branch of Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system, and we are looking to expand our portfolio of qualified contractors.

Now, even though you are certified by the Bounty Hunters Guild, Northrock will need you to complete a pro tem contract to make sure you're a good match. I'm thinking I'll start you off collecting the bounty on <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>. They were last seen at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. 

Get that done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton2_H.description:
A client of mine‘s trying to negotiate a deal, but isn’t having much luck. The other party feels like they got all the leverage because they’re sitting comfortably on a pile of inventory. To help move the negotiations along, I’m gonna need you to head down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Now, I should probably tell you that the site’s being protected by some very serious people, so getting to the stash is going to be a bit tricky, but I trust you’ll find a way.

YardRush_Mining_Medium_Intro_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of resources is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you and whoever else you want to bring along are going to do a resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Up to you how you get the stuff. Mine it, steal it, buy it from a trader - I don’t care as long as I get what I need refined and delivered. Might be worth checking the asteroid clusters near LaGrange points to start.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

Vaughn_Stanton1_EliminateSpecific_Standa.description:
A security officer by the name of [TargetName] is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at [Location|Address] along with a host of other eager types in uniforms. 

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of [TargetName] which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_St.description:
Hey, 

Got a contract for you that requires a bit more tactics than usual. A high-level criminal by the name [TargetName] is hiding with a large contingent of outlaws at [Location|Address]. 

Our intel suggests that [TargetName|Last]’s forces most likely will act as defensive line in order to protect their boss. My best guess is that you will have to deal with them before you gain access to [TargetName|Last].

That said, I don’t want you shooting indiscriminately. Sometimes these outlaws keep civilians around and they should be treated like non-combatants.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_EliminateAll_Unlawful_EliminateCompet.description:
A client is getting out produced by a new competitor and is looking to throw a wrench into the works.

You’re going to head to [Location|Address] and kill all the civies who work there. 

Do what you want with the gun-toting goons guarding the workers, but remember that they aren’t the priority.

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti3_Processed_Mixed.description:
Hey,

The folks at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> have what I like to call a “pilot’s special” waiting to be distributed - a haul of quantum fuel, hydrogen fuel, and ship ammo. Load it up from a freight elevator and deliver it to the following spots in whatever order works best for you. Expect the containers to all be <EM4>16 SCU</EM4> or smaller.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4> 

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Independent Contractors

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_H.description:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over [location|address].

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

PU_EliminateAll_Caves_Pyro2.description:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in [Location|Address]. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us. 

Stows out.

PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_EliminateCompe.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [Location|Address], but [TargetName] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti3_RefinedOre_Mixe.description:
Hey,

The refinery at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> has been busy. They’ve processed a mix of refined ores and are looking to get the containers (<EM4>16 SCU</EM4> or smaller) shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see where this stuff is needed and was able to put together this run.

PU_Delivery_Local_legal_Deliver_2_Stanto.description:
Greetings Qualified Shipping Partner!

Ready to contribute to our growing and expanding delivery network?  Have a vessel at your disposal that can carry several packages and fly between local planetary bodies and satellites? We have just the opportunity for you with this carefully selected itinerary -

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>

If this sounds like something you're interested in, please accept this offer right away! Just be sure to bring your own <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> for maximum efficiency. 


Looking forward to working with you,

Unified Distribution Management
 -Delivering the Total Package-

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.description:
Some idiots think they can blatantly spy on the Headhunters and get away with it. They’ve set up several orbital sentries at [location|address] and have a few ships patrolling the area. We don’t know who’s behind it but we honestly don’t care. We just need it gone. 

Let us know if you feel like putting some real brash bastards in their place. We’ll pay you well and deliver the creds the second the job is done. 

Keep in mind that it’s really only the sentries we care about. The ships they got patrolling are only a concern if they get in your way or if they try to call in some friends to stop you. 
 
Stows out.

TheCollector_OrbVolt_KopSkull.description:
Hello. Can make fun change to gun if you want. Use kopion skin for pattern and little skull dangle. Very effective. Shoot much better.

All you need is bring me parts to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> and will make. 

Bye.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_VehicleEn.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>[System] </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. This purchase order is more complex than typical, requiring multiple mining methods, but since you've proven your skill thus far, we think you and your team are up for the challenge.

Reminder, <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Recent scans discovered several orbital sentries and ships at [location|address]. We believe they’re part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, in response to our recent actions in the Stanton system. Seems XenoThreat must be doing something right, if they’re out here spying like this.

We’re looking for an experienced and highly-skilled merc willing to eliminate this operation. If you don’t want Pyro to become a surveillance system, then this is your chance to stop it. The sentries probably won’t be too big of an issue, but pay mind to the patrol ships. If they manage to break away, you’ll have a whole lot more trouble breathing down your neck. 

You’ll have our gratitude and a sizable payment once the job is done. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

TheCollector_vglFlightsuit.description: Ships have big windows. Everyone can see you flying. You should look the best. Wikelo has very good flight suit for you. Do trade, bring me what I need and Wikelo give suit. Give blueprint as well if you do not have.

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti2_RefinedOre_Alum.description:
Hi there,

The refinery at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> has been busy. They’ve processed a bunch of <EM4>Aluminum</EM4> into containers <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> or smaller, and are looking to get it shipped out from a freight elevator. PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_RR.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Our resistance movement is growing by the day, but that comes with some unwanted attention.  Recent scans discovered orbital sentries at [location|address] and a ship running a patrol pattern. We believe this is part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, most likely funded by the UEE. 

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to destroy the sentries ASAP.  Since they already have eyes and ears on us, sending in someone from outside the org would draw less attention. If you take the gig, you’ll be paid promptly once the sentries are destroyed.
 
Now, while the patrol ship isn’t the main target, we suspect that if it escapes it might have reinforcements in reserve. Might be smart to deal with it promptly. 

If you decide to help us, XenoThreat will remember you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_HH_Pyro6.description:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system. 

That shipment was delivered to [Pickup1|Address]. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the [item], and take it to [Dropoff1|Address] so we can properly dispose of it. 

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_Stanton2_Floating.description:
Following their latest attempted siege, Nine Tails forces have begun to conduct targeted raids in an effort to continue to disrupt Crusader operations. The current attack has targeted [MissionCluster|Address] and it’s vital that we put a stop to the aggression there. 

Crusader Security is seeking a contractor willing to clear all Nine Tails operators in the area. Contractors should expect to use force and are strongly encouraged to consider bringing back-up. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_Intro.description:
Hey,

Hope everything is going all right. I may have reached out already, but I wanted to be sure and introduce myself. I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system today, providing a variety of services to all major governmental bodies as well as various private concerns. The reason I am contacting you is because we believe someone with your skills could be a boon to our clients. 

Not only that, but I think we'd be good fit for you. Our contractors traditionally get a higher rate of pay than a lot of our competitors in system, and a lot of them tell me how they really enjoy being tasked with the challenging and interesting work we offer. 

Now, Northrock holds itself to such high-standards so before we can make anything official, you'll need to achieve approved contractor status by completing a pro tem contract. 

I was hoping you could capture several wanted members of an outlaw gang: [Target1], [Target2], and [Target3].

Get that done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

Firesale_Large_Intro_CFP.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would recruit a full fleet to resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address] with detatrine. </EM4>

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several <EM4>depots</EM4> around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Delivery_DC_Stanton_Internal_Stanton4.description:
Hi,

There’s a whole heap of packages over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that need to be carted around the facility to their proper storage place. Would mean a lot if you could personally see to it all getting sorted.

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup2]</EM4>
     · Package <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup3]</EM4>

HexPenetrator_Comm_2.description:
One of the suspects captured during the recent attacks revealed that XenoThreat is looking to remotely access a number of comm arrays around the system.

Having XenoThreat listening into comms is extremely dangerous for the people living here, so the CDF has been enlisted to reset the comm array, then defend it from any XenoThreat Vanguards that will attempt to reconnect to the servers. 

Once those Vanguards have been defeated, clear out any remaining hostile ships in the area.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_Delivery_Local_Holiday_Stanton4.description:
Happy Luminalia!

I have a huge favor to ask. Thanks to some very ill timed maintenance issues, my ship is out of commission for at least a week and I won't be able to finish delivering presents to everyone on my gift list.

Looked into using FTL but with their holiday pricing I'll end up paying more credits than what the gifts cost! 

Figured I would see if you're interested in helping me out. I get my gifts delivered on time and you get some extra Luminalia spending credits. 

The gifts are wrapped and waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. [DescriptionSetup].

Thanks in advance and may your light glow a little brighter this year!

Sincerely,
[GiftSender|First]

Tutorial02_Shopping_Orison.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with Orison and take you to visit Kel-To, a weapons store here in Orison.

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

Lima Endicott

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Our resistance movement is growing by the day, but that comes with some unwanted attention.  Recent scans discovered orbital sentries at [location|address] and a ship running a patrol pattern. We believe this is part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, most likely funded by the UEE. 

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to destroy the sentries ASAP.  Since they already have eyes and ears on us, sending in someone from outside the org would draw less attention. If you take the gig, you’ll be paid promptly once the sentries are destroyed.

If you decide to help us, XenoThreat will remember you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

YardRush_Salvage_MediumDonation_Intro_CF.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you and a team of your choosing could resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address] with salvaged materials.</EM4> It would go a long way in helping us rebuild what was lost in the attacks.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to acquire what we need, but should be able to find some wrecks to scavenge orbiting around most planets. 

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking [Location|address]. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [dropoff1|address]. 


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutl.description:
Hey,

We could use your help.

A local we work with was completing a delivery for us, but unfortunately, she ran into some outlaws and had to surrender her [Item]. Silver lining is the outlaws didn’t notice the trackers we placed in the cargo and now we know they’ve taken their haul to [Location|Address]. 

We’d like you to recover the packages for us and finish delivering them to [Destination|Address]. I don’t imagine the outlaws will give them up willingly, but I wouldn’t ask you to put yourself in harm’s way if these supplies weren’t of critical importance.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd suggest you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, what do you say?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Rayari_Rank0_Harvestable_Single_Revenant.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal_In.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a security professional for a retrieval op at [Location]. The location is currently under attack and security forces on-site are unresponsive and presumed dead. We believe confidential materials recently delivered to the facility for temporary holding were the target of the raid. Your main focus will be collecting those boxes and delivering them to a secure location.  

For security reasons, the confidential materials were delivered as part of a larger shipment and secured in the automated vault. The materials have unique retrieval codes that must be entered on the keypad at the package conveyor. Protocols require that only senior security officers can carry a datapad containing a code, but considering the volatile situation, we can't guarantee that the Nine Tails haven’t taken possession of them. Once secured, deliver all of the confidential materials to [dropoff1] for payment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|address].
• Use force as necessary to collect the confidential materials.
• Deliver the confidential materials to [dropoff1|address].

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment. 
• Access to a spaceship that can transport cargo.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.
• Experience hauling important cargo.

KillAndCollectAnimals_Stanton4_Hard.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari has been continuing our efforts into the next generation of scientific research, but recently, we’ve had to halt an invaluable research project due to a lack of biological materials critical to our efforts and are eager to have our stock restored.

As such, we are seeking people who can track down multiple species in the wild, acquire the requisite biological components from the different specimens, and deliver them to [destination|address].

For more information on the animals in question, refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.

Let’s grow together,

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

TheColllector_Vehicle_Ground_ATLS_Orange.description: Many Human work place have orange color there. Must mean work to you. This suit does work. Make sense.

PU_ShipHijacked_Rclmr_Unlawfull_Delivery.description:
Hey there. 

Nine Tails got themselves a little problem. As it turns out, they got a little side biz in the underground organ trade. Now that an area I generally like to steer well clear of, but a gig’s a gig, right? It seems that one of their mobile butcher shops aboard the 'October Rising' got pinched by private security while out chopping. Now the Nine Tails are willing to cut ties with the ship and its crew (who are probably all dead anyway), but they need a particular crate extracted. Guess it was a special order or something.

Anyway, get aboard the October Rising, get the package, and get out.

Security’s still hanging around so watch yourself and maybe bring some friends, but remember, your priority is the package. If you're looking to save yourself some extra hassle, you could also black out the area by shutting down the nearest comm array if you want to avoid the crimestats for, you know, killing a bunch of a security. But hey, you do you.

Once you’re out, drop the package off at the clinic on Grim HEX and I’ll sort your payment.

Easy peasy,

Ruto

PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliv.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
My associates and I brokered a deal with a hauler named [TargetName] to deliver supplies to us. Funny thing is the shipment never showed up. They claimed pirates raided their ship and took our supplies, but it turns out that story’s 100% ranta dung.

Lying to back out of our deal can’t go unanswered and you’re going to make that message abundantly clear. [TargetName|Last] was recently seen with an escort at [Location|Address]. As long as you kill [TargetName|Last], we don’t care what happens to the cargo they’re hauling. 

- Smokey

Firesale_Medium_Intro_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock.

That’s why you and whoever else you want to bring along are going to do a detatrine resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that <EM4>depots</EM4> across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Recove.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>

HexPenetrator_Incursion_1.description:
Waves of XenoThreat ships have been pushing into Stanton system and attacking random civilians. We can't tell if this is an isolated attack or a reaction to our recent initiatives, but we need them stopped.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_Derelict_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Sta.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: Hurston Dynamics
RISK ASSESSMENT: Moderate Risk Target (Possible Armed Support)
RUSH CONTRACT: Hurston Dynamics

Under the authority of Hurston Dynamics as granted by the UEE, a bounty has been issued for [TargetName] relating to crimes against the corporation. 

The subject is believed to be recently located at [Location|Address], potentially with several allies. Force may be required to gain access to the site and neutralize [TargetName|Last]. [Location|CaveSize]

Payment will be released only after the bounty has been deemed complete.
 

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that [location|address] is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high. 

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton4.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary or security professional to report to [Location|Address] and destroy the drugs being stored there. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Clear the site of drugs; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• No ongoing addiction issues.

CleanAir_Large_ResourceGathering_Researc.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are working around-the-clock to assist with the treatment for the current fungal outbreak in Levski. Due to logistic issues, our team at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> is running low on a key resource in their research. Losing production at that location would hamper the Alliance Aid’s effort to cure people suffering from this terrible affliction in a timely manner.

That’s why we're eager for the help of anyone who can find and deliver this vital supply to <EM4>[Destination]</EM4>.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

HeadHunters_Patrol_Stanton_Hard.description:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there? 

The route starts at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to <EM4>bring a friend</EM4> to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 

- Stows

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_Generic_P.description:
[TargetName] borrowed a bunch of creds from the Headhunters and thought the smart move was to try and hide instead of paying us back, so I need someone to make an example of [TargetName|Last].

They were just spotted at [Location|Address], so I’d recommend heading there now before the trail goes cold. [TargetName|Last] is a paranoid sort, so don’t be surprised if they’re not alone. Handle it however you want as long as [TargetName|Last] is dust when you’re done.   

Stows out.

Tutorial02_Shopping_NewBabbage.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [Location|Name] and take you to visit Kel-To, a weapons store here in [Location|Name].

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_RR_Pyro6.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Rough & Ready have been in business with [TargetName] for years but that relationship has taken a turn for the worse. For a while, we were supplying them with fuel on credit but when it came time to collect the coward went into hiding. If [TargetName|Last] can’t pay with creds, guess they’re gonna pay with their life.

An associate just clocked [TargetName|Last] at [Location|Address]. I’d love for you to head there now to make the stingy bastard pay.

By the way, it looks like [TargetName|Last] isn’t traveling alone, so I’d make sure you’re fully stocked before going after ‘em. 

- Smokey

PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Stanton2_Int.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.description:
Some numbskull is trying to dig up dirt on the Headhunters. Some orbital sentries were dropped at [location|address] to spy on us. We’ve also spotted a ship checking on them. Simple proposition for you. Go wipe out the sentries there and we’ll pay you for it. That sound like something you’d be into?

As for the ship, you can do whatever you want with it, but if it spots you, don’t be surprised if it tries to go get some back up. That’s just how these things go.

Stows out.

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_E.description:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over [location|address].

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you could resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address] with salvaged materials.</EM4> It would go a long way in helping us rebuild what was lost in the attacks.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to acquire what we need, but should be able to find some wrecks to scavenge orbiting around most planets. 

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Do you value Humanity’s freedom? If so, I’m offering you a chance to prove it. Recent scans discovered orbital sentries and patrolling ships at [location|address]. We believe they’re part of a UEE espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat. It’s important that we stop their intelligence gathering before we launch our next mission.

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to eliminate these forces immediately. The sentries are the priority, but the ships might prove a bigger issue if they’re allowed to escape. You’ll have to evaluate the situation more closely once you’re on site. 

We could take care of it ourselves, but want to send in a contractor so the scum behind it don’t know who hit them. Payment will be sent promptly upon completion. Plus, the satisfaction of knowing you’re helping a good cause.

Comm. Spec. Engler

Firesale_Medium_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock.

That’s why you and whoever else you want to bring along are going to do a detatrine resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that <EM4>depots</EM4> across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. Security Post Kareah is under attack by an unknown number of assailants. 

Crusader is seeking contractors to quickly travel to the station and eliminate all trespassers in the vicinity before our security forces are overwhelmed.  

We’re not sure whether the attackers are targeting the contraband in our evidence lockup or our CrimeStat database, but whatever they’re after, they need to be dealt with. You will receive a combat bonus for each target neutralized.  

By accepting this contract, you agree to abide by all Crusader Security protocols: If you harm any guards or other authorized contractors while on the station, your contract will be terminated and you will be marked as a target.

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>[System] </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. This purchase order is more complex than typical, requiring multiple mining methods, but since you've proven your skill thus far, we think you and your team are up for the challenge.

Reminder, <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Tutorial01_Basics_Orison.description:
Congratulations on taking your first steps into the universe!

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space. 

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
Some asshole going by the name [TargetName] has been running a scheme where their cargo ship requests refueling services only to ambush our ships when they get there. Even loaded the damn thing up with real cargo to make sure it passes scans. We’ve spread the word so nobody in Rough & Ready will fall for the trap again, but I want this skag punished. 

I think [TargetName|Last] knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around [Location|Address]. Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all. 

- Smokey

PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_07.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

It appears that second time's the charm for the Arlington gang. After one failed attempt, the recently escaped criminal family has managed to boost an Idris from a repair yard. Now we know what the mining laser and biometrics they stole were for. 

Since we had such success capturing them the first time, Eckhart Security has been granted the warrant for the gang’s arrest. This is going to take considerable firepower to bring down a capital ship of this ability.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to track down the Idris and neutralize the gang.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract and will be adjusted based on the final evaluation of you and your team's combat effectiveness rating. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of resources is practically out of stock.

Stows

HexPenetrator_DataHeist_4.description:
We've received tips that XenoThreat's intending to launch another attack on Stanton system. The CDF has petitioned the Advocacy to create a new initiative called Operation Overdrive to stop this attack before it happens. 

The CDF is dispatching volunteers to infiltrate and obtain any intel that could give insight into what they're planning. Needless to say, expect heavy resistance from any XenoThreat on site.

As an added incentive, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnima.description:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near <EM4>[Location]</EM4>. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.  

Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

An associate just clocked [TargetName|Last] at [Location|Address]. I’d love for you to head there now to make the stingy bastard pay.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro5_Ha.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Braden Corchado

Northrock Service Group

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Recent scans discovered several orbital sentries and ships at [location|address]. We believe they’re part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, in response to our recent actions in the Stanton system. Seems XenoThreat must be doing something right, if they’re out here spying like this.

We’re looking for an experienced and highly-skilled merc willing to eliminate this operation. If you don’t want Pyro to become a surveillance system, then this is your chance to stop it. The sentries probably won’t be too big of an issue, but pay mind to the patrol ships. If they manage to break away, you’ll have a whole lot more trouble breathing down your neck. 

You’ll have our gratitude and a sizable payment once the job is done. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
Some asshole going by the name [TargetName] has been running a scheme where their cargo ship requests refueling services only to ambush our ships when they get there. Even loaded the damn thing up with real cargo to make sure it passes scans. We’ve spread the word so nobody in Rough & Ready will fall for the trap again, but I want this skag punished. 

I think [TargetName|Last] knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around [Location|Address]. Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all. 

- Smokey

Xenothreat_Showdown_PreXeno.description:
Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for the final assault that XenoThreat have been planning. The Navy has officially requested any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system. This will include volunteers outside of those who have participated in the Overdrive Initiative.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

If successful, this will complete this Overdrive Initiative series and you will receive temporary access to the F7A Hornets or a free upgrade if you currently own an F7C.

PU_EliminateSpecific_Caves_Pyro.description:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader [TargetName] is holed up at [location|address] working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without [TargetName|Last] getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out [TargetName|Last], but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.  

Stows out.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at [location|address] where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.      

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it. 

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us. 

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.     

- Smokey

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Illegal.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
My associates and I brokered a deal with a hauler named [TargetName] to deliver supplies to us. Funny thing is the shipment never showed up. They claimed pirates raided their ship and took our supplies, but it turns out that story’s 100% ranta dung.

Lying to back out of our deal can’t go unanswered and you’re going to make that message abundantly clear. [TargetName|Last] was recently seen with an escort at [Location|Address]. As long as you kill [TargetName|Last], we don’t care what happens to the cargo they’re hauling. 

- Smokey

TheCollector_GG_VentureSuit(DO_NOT_USE_S.description: You like adventure, right? This armor good for it. Let you go dangerous places, but not too heavy. Stay light. Wikelo found these and will trade if you want. You win, Wikelo win. Bye.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Legal_In.description:
ATTN: Mercenaries with Cargo Handling Experience

Nine Tails are currently assaulting one of our facilities at [Location|address]. As they just received a delivery of confidential materials, we don’t believe this is a coincidence. BlacJac needs someone to hurry to the location and secure these important boxes before the Nine Tails do. You are authorized to use lethal force against any who attempt to stop you. 

As part of our standard security protocol, the confidential materials were integrated into another consignment and secured in the automated vault. You’ll need to find the relevant retrieval codes for the confidential materials and enter it at the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. Retrieval codes are stored locally on datapads and only given to high-ranking staff. Hopefully they’re alive to help you, but considering the complete comms blackout, we fear that’s not the case. There's a chance Nine Tails have already gotten their hands on the datapads.  

Once you’ve gathered all the confidential materials, they will need to be delivered to [dropoff1|address]. Payment is contingent upon their delivery.


Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_M.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We got word that a syndicate spiked a rival’s drug package and its causing chaos on the streets. Forensics have identified the source, a production facility over at [Location|Address]. Word is the drug manufacturers don’t even know they have a poisoned crop on their hands.

We’re sorting through how to handle the arrests, but the important thing is to get this crap off the streets now. I need you to get down there and destroy the drugs they’re storing on site.

They won’t be happy about it, so you’ll probably have a fight on your hands, but the important thing is clearing out the product.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Our resistance movement is growing by the day, but that comes with some unwanted attention.  Recent scans discovered orbital sentries at [location|address] and a ship running a patrol pattern. We believe this is part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, most likely funded by the UEE. 

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to destroy the sentries ASAP.  Since they already have eyes and ears on us, sending in someone from outside the org would draw less attention. If you take the gig, you’ll be paid promptly once the sentries are destroyed.
 
Now, while the patrol ship isn’t the main target, we suspect that if it escapes it might have reinforcements in reserve. Might be smart to deal with it promptly. 

If you decide to help us, XenoThreat will remember you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_NTLockdown_FleetFind_L5.description:
Crusader Security has learned that the criminal organization known as the Nine Tails have set an illegal blockade around [Location] and stopped all incoming and outgoing quantum traffic in the sector.

The outlaw fleet must be located, and the blockade terminated.

We are urgently requesting any trained security professionals in the system to join Crusader Security forces and protect our scanning ships as they seek out the location of the Nine Tails fleet causing this blockade.

Please bear in mind that with quantum travel disabled and numerous hostiles in the area, this should be considered a high-risk operation. Proper equipment and a full tank of fuel is strongly recommended for all pilots joining this emergency response effort.

Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
Recently made an interesting discovery that someone set up a handful of orbital sentries at [location|address]. Guess they’re trying to grab some info about our operations there. They even have a few ships guarding to make sure nothing happens to them. 

Of course, we want these bastards gone, but I’m worried that getting rid of it ourselves would be bad for business. That’s why we’re looking for a little ‘plausible deniability’. Someone from outside of R&R to eliminate the problem, so whoever is behind it can’t directly tie the attack back to us. I know this won’t be a walk in the park, especially with those guards lurking. Who knows how many reinforcements they have at the ready? But if you manage to get it done, we’re prepared to see you paid right. 

Think you’ve got the skills to pull this off? 

- Smokey

PU_EliminateSpecific_DC_Stanton_Wh_Greyc.description: I ain’t got time to waste so I’ll get straight to the point - [TargetName] needs to be dead and I want you to do it. We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off? 

If so, start by seeing what’s around the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing <EM4>two friends</EM4> to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Stows out.

Looking for an excuse to hit the skies with your cargo-ready vessel? Earn credits and explore the local area with this following carefully selected itinerary -

PACKAGE FOR PICK UP
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

If being your own supervisor and getting paid to fly your very own ship sounds like the perfect job, this contract is just what you've been looking for. Just be sure to bring your own <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> for maximum efficiency.

Unified Distribution Management
 -Delivering the Total Package-

PU_EliminateAll_Unlawful_EliminateCompet.description:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

TheCollector_Vehicle_Small_MISC_Prospect.description: Wikelo loves rocks. Wants to help you get more better rocks. Made this Prospector more better for that tough job. Trade items and you can have.

There’s some junk waiting at a freight elevator in <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that needs to go to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> for processing. I've confirmed that the containers won't be bigger than <EM4>4 SCU</EM4>.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoTh.description:
[TargetName] was recently revealed to be a mole for XenoThreat. It all makes sense now because the skav was a major asshole. Unfortunately, they split before we could handle it ourselves. 

Based on all they learned about our ops, we need ‘em taken out pronto. They see one of us coming and they’ll just run again, but I figured someone like you has a better chance of getting close enough for a killshot. 

We just got word [TargetName|Last] was hanging around [Location|Address]. Looks like there’s other ships around protecting ‘em too. Think you got the skill to rid the ‘verse of a traitorous bastard and their bastard friends?  

Stows out.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.description:
Headhunters are looking for a merc to do a little clean up for us. Found out that someone’s trying to spy on us over at [location|address]. Can’t let that stand. We need a skilled operator to take care of the orbital sentries they dropped there, and if needed, deal with any of their ships that get in your way. Seems like a decently run op, so hitting it might not be easy but it sure should be fun. 

Let us know if you’re the right one for the gig. Creds will be transferred once our scans show it’s gone. 

Stows out.

PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CF.description:
Unfortunately, one of our community partners, [TargetName], has been missing for a few days. Their family contacted Citizens for Prosperity for help and I told them we would do what we could. That said, with so much time passed, I’m not too hopeful.

Whatever their current state is, we're looking for someone to be our eyes on the ground for this one. There’s a strong chance that they were headed to [Location|Address], an area known to be very dangerous.

If you can track them down and confirm their status, one way or another, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_EliminateAll_Unlawful_EliminateCompet.description:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at [Location|Address], but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

Rayari_Rank3_YormandiEyes.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_Collect_Covalex_Personal_Anya.description:
Hi,

I'll totally understand if you don't want to help with this, but if you can it would be amazing.

See, my boyfriend passed away during the Covalex Gundo tragedy. They said I would get all of Scott's stuff back once the investigation was complete, but as far as I know, it's been done for a while now and they still haven't given any indication of when I can get his property. It's been hard enough dealing with all this, and knowing that a package is going to show up in a month or two and rip open all these wounds, it's just too much. I would prefer to deal with it now and get it over with. If you could find a way to get his personal effects (Employee ID# 104) and drop them off at [Destination], I'd be very grateful.

Thanks for your help,
Anya

PU_Delivery_Local_DrugProduction_Stanton.description:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order. 

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

* TO-DO LIST *

1. PROCESSING - Take the raw material from  [Pickup1|Address] to [Pickup2|Address]
2. PACKAGING - Take the refined product from  [Pickup2|Address] to [Pickup3|Address]
3. DISTRIBUTION - Take the finished goods from  [Pickup3|Address] to [DropOff1|Address]

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Guess what [TargetName] and [TargetName2] have in common? 

You're gonna kill 'em both!

Difficult part is that I need you to kill them at the same time so that one doesn't have a chance to escape, or worse, kill the person trying to kill them. 

So put together a team to track one target while you handle the other. Divide and conquer!

And despite the fact they made a mess big enough to get themselves killed, my understanding is that they are relative lightweights. Don't expect you to meet too much resistance.

Tutorial03_Ship_NewBabbage.description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in [Location|Name] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the MT MetroLoop transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [Location|Name] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

YardRush_Mining_Medium_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of resources is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you and whoever else you want to bring along are going to do a resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Up to you how you get the stuff. Mine it, steal it, buy it from a trader - I don’t care as long as I get what I need refined and delivered. Might be worth checking the asteroid clusters near LaGrange points to start.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton3_M.description:
One of my clients has been unhappy to learn that someone's been muscling in on their territory. Now rather than going down the more traditional route of killing some people and starting a whole thing, they’ve opted to send a different kind of message instead.

You’re gonna go down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

CleanAir_RecoverCargo_VIP.description:
Since you've been doing so much work helping out the Defense Division I wanted to come to you with this contract direct. It's a bit of a delicate one. Two VIPs fell ill and the worry was that if word got out they were being transported they would become major targets.

Unfortunately, it seems that's exactly what happened. Our attempts to smuggle them from Nyx to Stanton for medical treatment have failed, and now the ship carrying them is under attack. 

We need you to hurry to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, neutralize the attackers and ensure that the cryopods make it safely to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

In fact, I want you to make sure you have a ship that can carry the cryopods just in case their original transport is too damaged to go on.

I sincerely hope you manage to pull this rescue mission off. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.description:
Some numbskull is trying to dig up dirt on the Headhunters. Some orbital sentries were dropped at [location|address] to spy on us. We’ve also spotted a ship checking on them. Simple proposition for you. Go wipe out the sentries there and we’ll pay you for it. That sound like something you’d be into?

As for the ship, you can do whatever you want with it, but if it spots you, don’t be surprised if it tries to go get some back up. That’s just how these things go.

Stows out.

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti2_RefinedOre_Coru.description:
Hey there,

There’s some refined ore in containers <EM4>1 SCU</EM4> or smaller that needs to be moved from a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to production facilities on microTech. You can plan the drop offs anyway you want. Doesn’t matter what order they get done as long as they get there.  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4> 

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Independent Contractors

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

PU_Delivery_Local_legal_outpost_Pyro_CFP.description:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to Pyro, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens of Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

We’ve got several deliveries ready to go. Do them in whatever order you want. All that matters is that they get there. 

- Package <EM4>#[item1|serialnumber]</EM4> goes from <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>.
- Package <EM4>#[item2|serialnumber]</EM4> goes from <EM4>[Pickup2|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Dropoff2|Address]</EM4>.
- Package <EM4>#[item3|serialnumber]</EM4> goes from <EM4>[Pickup3|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Dropoff3|Address]</EM4>.
- Package <EM4>#[item4|serialnumber]</EM4> goes from <EM4>[Pickup4|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Dropoff4|Address]</EM4>.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

TheCollector_BigBooma.description:
Wikelo find very strange but functional weapon while wandering through your systems. It very simple but very effective. If you bring me things, I show you what I do to it.

Very fun.

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in [location|address]. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

PU_EliminateAll_Unlawful_Stanton4.description:
This is a bit aggressive for my taste, but credits are credits, right?

Got a client who's looking for a highly motivated individual to head over to [Location|Address] and kill everyone who’s there. 

Basically, start shooting and don’t stop. You'll get paid once the site's clear.

YardRush_Salvage_LargeDontation_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to do a resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address] and bring them the salvaged materials. </EM4>

Scrap it yourself or take it off some unsuspecting scav. Should be able to find some wrecks orbiting around most planets. Your call. Either way, as soon as we get the supplies, we’ll put it to good use building back up everything we lost.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_NoNonHostile.description:
We got lucky and some recent scans of [Location|Address] have shown that an open bounty by the name of [TargetName] is hiding out there. You have been authorized to enter the site, find them, and resolve the bounty.

However, in addition to the bounty and their criminal accomplices, the site is likely to have civilians present as well. While we're eager to see [TargetName|Last] dealt with, we can't have any civilian casualties. Use care when engaging with the hostiles. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton4_E.description:
Seems there’s a new upstart in the sector who hasn’t been paying the right dues to the right people. To teach them a little lesson, my client wants you to go down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site.

The low-level lugs they got on site will probably make a stink about it and try to stop you. Handle them however you want but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

Hi,

There’s a load of stims at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me? 

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.    

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>

Covalex Independent Contractors

Got a request in to transfer a few packages from the [Pickup1] at [Pickup1|Address]. 

Thought you might like this one since it’s nice to have a simple run to do every once in a while.
