PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_EliminateCompe.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [Location|Address], but [TargetName] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_Stanton2.description:
A security officer by the name of [TargetName] is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at [Location|Address] along with a host of other eager types in uniforms. 

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of [TargetName] which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

TheCollector_Vehicle_Large_Connie_Tau.description: Wikelo came across plans to build Constellation Taurus ship. Nice ship, but Wikelo make a little better. Prettier too. If you want, bring stuff.

YardRush_Salvage_MediumDonation_CFP.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you and a team of your choosing could resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address] with salvaged materials.</EM4> It would go a long way in helping us rebuild what was lost in the attacks.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to acquire what we need, but should be able to find some wrecks to scavenge orbiting around most planets. 

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_Stanton2.description:
Hey, 

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name [TargetName] has been located at [Location|Address]. 

Based on our intel, its highly unlikely that the target’s going to be sitting and waiting out in the open. You most likely will have to infiltrate the facility and draw them out. 

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick. 

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_05.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Two bank guards were reported missing last week. A few hours ago, their bodies turned up in a trash heap in Magnus with their biometrics stolen. Thankfully, a nearby dumpling cart had a security camera that captured the corpses being dropped. Facial recognition was able to ID one Kass Dent, romantic partner to Maltrox Arlington and parent of Les Arlington. Using the vid to construct a timeline, we have provided the coordinates of where Kass is currently believed to be hiding. 

Kass is suspected of a long list of murders, with these two only being the most recent. We recommend only bringing highly skilled wingman to try and keep the casualty count at a minimum.  

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_HH_Pyro1.description:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system. 

That shipment was delivered to [Pickup1|Address]. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the [item], and take it to [Dropoff1|Address] so we can properly dispose of it. 

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

HaulCargo_AToB_Stanton2_ReHire.description:
Hey,

Have a bit of good news for you. Covalex recently finished an evaluation of our contractor pool, and decided to reconsider your status as a cargo hauler. To requalify, all you need is to successfully complete the following delivery.

Pick up <EM4>Titanium</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and deliver it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. In order to complete this haul in a fast and efficient manner, you'll need a ship that can haul <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Hopefully everything goes smoothly so we can welcome you back to the team.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_Cry.description:
I won’t go into the whole long boring story of why, but there are a few bits of [Location|Address] that we need destroyed. The important part is that I want to pay you a hefty chunk of credits to do it. I almost feel like you should be paying us for this because of how fun it’s going to be.

Don’t even care how you get it done. Grenades, rocket launcher, day old Torpedo Burrito, it’s all the same to us.

-Bit Zeros

YardRush_Mining_CFP_Stanton.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you could deliver the needed supplies to<EM4> Pyro Gateway. </EM4>We have arranged shipment to Pyro from there.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to procure and refine the resources, but Daymar or Aberdeen might be good places to start mining.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need an available independent pilot for a quick local delivery.

PACKAGE FOR PICK UP
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

RED WIND DELIVERY PILOT NEEDED

PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_NoNonHostiles_.description:
A senior security official by the name of [TargetName] has been marked for termination. While they can be found at [Location|Address], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

Normally, I would recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. However, in this instance a more delicate touch is required. While you should feel free to eliminate any and all of the security forces on site, you must ensure the safety of all the civilian workers there.

Tiresome for sure, but a requirement none the less. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_SalvageContractor_PvP_Pyro.description:
Fortune has shined upon us once again. I’ve just learned of a battle near [Location] that’s just transpired far from the prying eyes of any meddlesome comm arrays, and reinforcements from either of the forces involved have yet to be dispatched. This means that there is a window of opportunity for an enterprising soul to pick the graveyard clean.
 
I’d like to extend this opportunity to all my trusted contacts. Any and all interested parties can have the location… for the right price. Coordinates will be provided once you accept the contract and will remain available until you choose to terminate it.

Of course, speed will be of the essence as you will not only face potential competition from other salvagers, but also the looming possibility of reinforcements arriving to survey the battlefield. 

If you’re still hesitating, just remember, fortune favors the bold.

-cd

PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro5.description:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to [TargetName]. Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to [Location|Address] and find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

TheCollector_GeminiShotgun.description: Shooting can be messy. Red Human Blood everywhere. Not a problem with this shotgun. Splashes blends right in! I give it to you if you give me everything I want on list. Good trade.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_Generic_P.description:
Time is up for [TargetName]. The skav is way past due on paying back the Headhunters, so I need you to punch them out. 

Kill ‘em, not hit ‘em, just in case that’s unclear. 

Someone recently spotted [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address], so head there and take ‘em out.  

Full disclosure, we’ve gotten reports they used some of our creds to hire extra protection. Prepare accordingly. 

Stows out.

PU_PVP_Bounty_Stanton_NorthRock_PrisonEs.description:
Convicted criminal [TargetName] has escaped from a local rehab facility and Northrock's been contracted to return the inmate to custody. In my experience, escaped prisoners tend not to give up peacefully, so use any method you can to find and subdue the escapee. 

Might be worth staking out spots where they could attempt to hack their record clean. Wouldn't be the first time a prisoner has tried to wipe their sentence after escaping.

Good hunting,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_ServiceBeacon_CombatAssistance_NPCSpa.description: [InitiatorName] is requesting combat assistance in [InitiatorLocation]. If accepted, you will be paid [PaymentAmount] aUEC upon elimination of the threat.

PU_ScrambleRace_NFR.description:
You fast? You deadly? You looking to make some serious creds? Then I got the race for you.

I'm talking a weapons free, old school scramble. Pilot a [RaceType|Short], collect checkpoints, steal points from the leader, and win big. Whoever gets enough points first is declared champion and gets a fat payout. 2nd and 3rd place even get prizes too.  

Let me know if you're interested, and I'll send you the starting coordinates once the race is set up. In the meanwhile, feel free to get your [RaceType] ready to go. [RaceType|ScrambleRaceASOP]

PU_Delivery_DC_Stanton_Internal_Stanton1.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

They need it done efficiently and without a lot of bother.


DO NOT TAKE THIS CONTRACT - unless you are reliable. Red Wind has a reputation that our clients trust and for good reason.

PU_MissingPerson_Stations_Pyro_CFP_Pyro2.description:
Hey,

I’m getting pretty worried about one of our local contractors, [TargetName]. They finished up a trade at [Location|Address] and haven’t been seen since. We’re hearing reports that outlaws have been sneaking aboard there, and if that’s true, I suspect that the worst might have happened.

Either way, [TargetName|First] has done good work for us in the past and I’d hate for them to wind up as just another one of Pyro’s missing. If you’re willing to find them for me, I’ll see that you get a reward. 

Just be careful. Hate for you to go missing too.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Delivery_DC_Stanton_Courier_To_Stanto.description: <= UNINITIALIZED =>

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Illegal_.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart_Har.description:
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In relation to a jointly committed crime, a group warrant has been issued for:
     [Target1]
     [Target2]
     [Target3]

It is currently believed that they are no longer traveling together in order to evade capture, and may soon flee the system.  You should strongly consider recruiting additional help in order to execute all the warrants in the limited time frame. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the targets. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract when all targets have been dealt with in the allotted time.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_M.description:
One of my clients has been unhappy to learn that someone's been muscling in on their territory. Now rather than going down the more traditional route of killing some people and starting a whole thing, they’ve opted to send a different kind of message instead.

You’re gonna go down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_Danger_Py.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near [Location|Address] which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Rayari_Rank1_Gems_Multi.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: <EM4>saldynium, jaclium, and carinite</EM4>.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_Destroy_Servers_Pyro.description:
One of our datarunners went MIA while transporting vital operational information. A few hours ago, we determined that they were hit by a Headhunter raiding party and the contents of the ship’s datastores were transferred to their servers at [location|address]. 

While we have every reason to believe that our encryption will hold, we cannot take the risk that the contents of those files will be exposed. You are being ordered to head there and ensure our data remains private by destroying the Headhunter servers.

I strongly encourage thoroughness. Raze everything and everyone you can to the ground.

Comm. Spec. Engler

Tutorial02_Shopping_Area18.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with Area18 and take you to visit Cubby Blast, a weapons store here in Area18.

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

PU_SalvageContractor_Coverup_Stanton2_Ea.description:
Got a particular salvage job that we could use some extra hands on. 

We need you to find a [ship] that got punched out around [location]. Security’s already searching for it and if they find it, they’ll ID it for sure and we’ll be in loads of trouble.

So, we want you to make sure that can’t happen. Either tow the ship out of the search area or rip the entire hull off so nobody can tell who it belonged to. Whatever you decide, keep your mouth shut about this. 

We’ll cred you up and anything you scrap is yours to keep. But if security finds the ship before you’re done, we’ll all be screwed and you won’t get paid so don’t disappoint.

PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_Danger_Py.description:

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_XenoThreat_vs_HeadHun.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on [TargetName]. A known member of the Headhunters gang, [TargetName|Last] has betrayed Humankind by being a known alien ally who associates with them in both a personal and business capacity. XenoThreat wants these traitorous associations stopped immediately before they bring more alien influence to Pyro. We’ll pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates [TargetName|Last] for these crimes against Humanity.  

LOCATION UPDATE: [TargetName|Last] was recently spotted with an escort at [Location|Address]. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_MissionGiverReputationTest_Eckhart.description:
All the ranking members of the Arlington gang are now behind bars and their criminal gang is out of commission. 

This was a pretty impressive collar. Good work.

-Miles

Miles Eckhart
Founder & CEO
Eckhart Security, LLC.

HexPenetrator_DataHeist_1.description:
We've received tips that XenoThreat's intending to launch another attack on Stanton system. The CDF has petitioned the Advocacy to create a new initiative called Operation Overdrive to stop this attack before it happens. 

The CDF is dispatching volunteers to infiltrate and obtain any intel that could give insight into what they're planning. Needless to say, expect heavy resistance from any XenoThreat on site.

As an added incentive, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Legal_Stanton1.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Contraband Elimination
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: R. Russel
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Local criminals have been identified using [Location|Address] to manufacture large quantities of illegal. Hurston Security requires a contractor to go to the facility and eliminate all contraband being stored there.

Payment will be sent once all the contraband is eliminated.

YardRush_Salvage_Intro_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to do a resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address] and bring them the salvaged materials. </EM4>

Scrap it yourself or take it off some unsuspecting scav. Should be able to find some wrecks orbiting around most planets. Your call. Either way, as soon as we get the supplies, we’ll put it to good use building back up everything we lost.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_EliminateC.description:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to [Location|Address] and kill [TargetName]. What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_Delivery_Local_Illegal_Deliver2_Stant.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got another special job that I need a pilot I can trust to handle.

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER)
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>

This is a very important client for us so please treat them and their packages with extra respect.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking [Location|address]. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [dropoff1|address]. 


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

CleanAir_Small_ResourceGathering_Researc.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WitHelp_Stanton3_.description:
ATTN: Former Mercenary Operator

I’m aware that BlacJac stopped offering security work, but due to staffing changes it was decided to offer you another chance.

We’ve gotten word that [Location|Address] needs some assistance dealing with a local outlaw gang. BlacJac is looking to have you go to the site and assist in eliminating this threat.

And since you’re already on thin ice as is, I don’t want to hear that you were involved in any friendly fire incidents.

If you’re able to pull this operation off, we can see about getting you reinstated.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Delivery_Local_legal_outpost_Pyro_CFP.description:
Hey, 

Need two packages delivered. Package <EM4>#[item1|serialnumber]</EM4> needs to be grabbed from <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>, and package <EM4>#[item2|serialnumber]</EM4> is going from <EM4>[Pickup2|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Dropoff2|Address]</EM4>. Should be an easy way to make a few creds. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_EliminateAll_Unlawful_Stanton2.description:
This is a bit aggressive for my taste, but credits are credits, right?

Got a client who's looking for a highly motivated individual to head over to [Location|Address] and kill everyone who’s there. 

Basically, start shooting and don’t stop. You'll get paid once the site's clear.

Xenothreat_PAR_PreXeno.description:
Attention CDF volunteers, XenoThreat finally launched their attack against Jericho Station at the Pyro Gateway in Stanton.

The Navy has requested CDF forces to help combat XenoThreat forces in the area and/or recover supplies from the wreckage and safely deliver them to Jericho station. 

The Navy has organized a community stipend to handle the distribution of payment. This will be distributed among all CDF volunteers at assigned intervals. An indicator will appear on your HUD to measure these payouts.

Please note that the supplies are highly volatile if not handled correctly. Use caution while transporting these materials:
* Zeta-Prolanide degrades over time until breaking down completely.
* AcryliPlex Composite becomes explosively unstable if damaged.
* Diluthermex releases a destructive energy pulse if exposed to quantum travel.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Have another pair that need to be eliminated:
[TargetName] and [TargetName2]

They've been in the wind for a few days now, but just popped up. If we don't get them now, I'm not sure we will get another chance.  You need to enlist a partner to make sure both targets are hit at the same time.

As far as them putting up resistance, [TargetName] is known to bring along a friend to watch their back, and I suspect [TargetName2] will do likewise.

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_M.description:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over [location|address].

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_RR_Pyro6_Med.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.    

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>Clio Derelict Outpost</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>Clio Derelict Outpost</EM4>

Glad I never picked up the habit myself because I swear I get more delivery update requests for “where are my stims?!?” than any other kind of shipment.

PU_Defend_Lawful_Stanton2_VH.description:
Crusader Security has learned that [Location|Address] is currently being threatened by a well-known gang operating in the area and we’re looking to hire an experienced security team to deal with any attacks. 

Try to make sure that whoever you bring along is properly qualified. You’re going to need all the help you can get to deal with this group.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_EliminateAll_Outposts_Derelict_Pyro_H.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from [Location|Address]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CF.description:
One of our people, [TargetName], was supposed to be doing some preliminary scouting work over at Pyro VI Abandoned Outpost, but they never reported in. We’re hoping that they just ran into some bad luck, but too often out here even the smallest misstep can prove fatal.

I’d appreciate someone heading that way and seeing if they can be located. It’d be great if you find them alive, but if not, some closure is the least we can do for their family.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Vaughn_Stanton1_EliminateBoss_EliminateC.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [Location|Address], but [TargetName] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_HH.description:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system. 

That shipment was delivered to [Pickup1|Address]. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the [item], and take it to [Dropoff1|Address] so we can properly dispose of it. 

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

HeadHunters_Patrol_Stanton_Medium.description:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available? 

All you need to do is head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it. 

Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 


Stows out.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic.description:
Interested in doing a little hunting? 

[TargetName] sabotaged one of our fuel shipments and cost us a ton of creds, so I’m looking for someone to make ‘em pay for what they did. Just got word [TargetName|Last] was spotted at [Location|Address]. If you head there now, there’s a good chance you can pick up their trail and take ‘em out for good. 

[TargetName|Last] didn’t work alone, so don’t be surprised if they’re traveling with extra protection.

- Smokey

TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Scorpius.description: Don't know what the name mean, but ship is very fast, very good in fight. With tweak, can better. You see list of what Wikelo need, go get and I make. Bye.

PU_Delivery_Local_Holiday_Stanton3.description:
Happy Luminalia!

I have a huge favor to ask. Thanks to some very ill timed maintenance issues, my ship is out of commission for at least a week and I won't be able to finish delivering presents to everyone on my gift list.

Looked into using FTL but with their holiday pricing I'll end up paying more credits than what the gifts cost! 

Figured I would see if you're interested in helping me out. I get my gifts delivered on time and you get some extra Luminalia spending credits. 

The gifts are wrapped and waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. [DescriptionSetup].

Thanks in advance and may your light glow a little brighter this year!

Sincerely,
[GiftSender|First]

YardRush_Mining_Large_Intro_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of resources is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to do a resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Up to you how you get the stuff. Mine it, steal it, buy it from a trader - I don’t care as long as I get what I need refined and delivered. Might be worth checking the asteroid clusters near LaGrange points to start.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawf.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*

YardRush_Mining_Large_CFP _Stanton.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would recruit a full fleet to deliver the supplies to <EM4> Pyro Gateway. </EM4> We have arranged shipment to Pyro from there.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to procure and refine the resources, but Daymar or Aberdeen might be good places to start mining.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

With your business in Lorville finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the Metro Center transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around Lorville – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System
WORK EXPERIENCE: Mining, Commodity Trading
TERMS*: 
As a member of Alliance Aid, Shubin Interstellar is dedicated to assisting in the production of as many high quality ventilation filters as possible. These filters are key to stopping the spread of Molina Mold and keeping more people from being stricken with the People’s Ailment. 

We’ve just received word from our facility at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> that their stockpile of a vital resource is getting low. Our normal supplier won’t be able to do a resupply run for a while, so we’re hoping you might be able to do a small scale run of it now to bridge the gap.

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem

Clinical Research Outsourcing

Hey There,

I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract.

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TargetName]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid. 

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado

Northrock Service Group

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

TheCollector_Favours_IrradiatedPearls.description:

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_P.description:
Some idiots think they can blatantly spy on the Headhunters and get away with it. They’ve set up several orbital sentries at [location|address] and have a few ships patrolling the area. We don’t know who’s behind it but we honestly don’t care. We just need it gone.

Keep in mind that it’s really only the sentries we care about. The ships they got patrolling are only a concern if they get in your way or if they try to call in some friends to stop you.

POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LagrangeLocation]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
A local Stanton independent mining team was working [Location] as Shubin Interstellar contractors when a hostile force attacked and took over the site. We believe that the perpetrators are still at the claim using the equipment left behind to harvest the valuable ore there for themselves.

Among the equipment lost were a handful of orbital sentries that had unfortunately not yet been fully deployed at the time of the attack. Long range scans of the claim have led us to conclude that the outlaws have activated the orbital sentries and are using them to protect their illegal operations.

To reclaim the site, we are seeking contractors to go to [Location], destroy the orbital sentries, and clear the site of hostile miners. Efficiency is strongly recommended as there is a high risk they will call for reinforcements once they discover they’re being evicted.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal_Ea.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a security professional for a retrieval op at [Location]. The location is currently under attack and security forces on-site are unresponsive and presumed dead. We believe confidential materials recently delivered to the facility for temporary holding were the target of the raid. Your main focus will be collecting those boxes and delivering them to a secure location.  

For security reasons, the confidential materials were delivered as part of a larger shipment and secured in the automated vault. The materials have unique retrieval codes that must be entered on the keypad at the package conveyor. Protocols require that only senior security officers can carry a datapad containing a code, but considering the volatile situation, we can't guarantee that the Nine Tails haven’t taken possession of them. Once secured, deliver all of the confidential materials to [dropoff1] for payment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|address].
• Use force as necessary to collect the confidential materials.
• Deliver the confidential materials to [dropoff1|address].

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment. 
• Access to a spaceship that can transport cargo.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.
• Experience hauling important cargo.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
If you had asked me, I would've said [TargetName] and [TargetName2] would have wound up eventually killing each other. But instead you're going to get the honor of killing them both at the same time.

You're going to have to work for it, though.

Each one is trouble. Serious records, highly trained, and too smart to fly without backup.

Gather the best crew you can on this one. You'll need it. And don't be stingy. You can't spend credits if you're dead.

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in Hangar 13. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

If you need help locating this resource, I suggest checking the <EM4>'Forager's Guide'</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal for more information.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem

Clinical Research Outsourcing

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

XenoThreat has placed a kill order on the head of [TargetName]. As a member of the Headhunters gang, [TargetName|Last] hacked into XenoThreat systems to steal information on our operations and personnel. The harm done can only be rectified by ensuring [TargetName|Last] can never do something like this again. That’s why XenoThreat will pay anyone who can track down and assassinate [TargetName|Last].     

LOCATION UPDATE: Recent scans identified [TargetName|Last] traveling with other ships near [Location|Address]. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Recent scans discovered several orbital sentries and ships at [location|address]. We believe they’re part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, in response to our recent actions in the Stanton system. Seems XenoThreat must be doing something right, if they’re out here spying like this.

We’re looking for an experienced and highly-skilled merc willing to eliminate this operation. If you don’t want Pyro to become a surveillance system, then this is your chance to stop it. The sentries probably won’t be too big of an issue, but pay mind to the patrol ships. If they manage to break away, you’ll have a whole lot more trouble breathing down your neck. 

You’ll have our gratitude and a sizable payment once the job is done. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

Firesale_CFP.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would be able to resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address] with detatrine. </EM4>

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several <EM4>depots</EM4> around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

PU_BlockadeRunner_Stanton4.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

A hostile fleet of ships equipped with quantum jammers have created a blockade around  [Location|address], disabled the station's defensive turrets, and stolen a large supply of Zeta-Prolanide. In response, the CDF has received authorization to activate its volunteer force. 

Though the overall situation is dire, the theft of the Zeta-Prolanide is our priority. Without direct action, the loss of the sector's Zeta-Prolanide stores could have a devastating effects to the wider economy of the whole system. 

While local security forces are investigating the incursion, they've tracked the stolen inventory to several locations. CDF volunteers are tasked with heading to these locations, recovering the stolen Zeta-Prolanide, and transferring it back to the station before the material completely degrades and is no longer viable. Just be careful, intel suggests that larger clusters of Zeta-Prolanide have a higher outlaw presence.

Since time is of the essence, having a tractor beam to assist in moving the cargo is highly advised.

As an added incentive, volunteers will receive regular bonus payments for their combined efforts.

OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking [Location|address]. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [dropoff1|address].

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton3_BlacJac_Intro.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Not sure if you’re interested, but BlacJac is looking to expand our roster of bounty hunters. We got more jobs than our current contractors can handle, so I’m hoping that you might be able to help pick up some of the slack.  

Your qualifications look good on paper, but before we make anything official, BlacJac needs to see how you perform in the field firsthand. Even got a test case all lined up – we want you to sort out [TargetName]. They were last seen at [Location|Address]. Should be a fairly straightforward bounty without too much resistance. Perfect thing to sharpen your teeth on.

Good luck,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton3_E.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

It seems there’s a new operator trying their hand at manufacturing drugs over at [Location|Address], but the product they’re putting out is extremely toxic. 

We’re sorting through how to handle the arrests, but the important thing is to prevent any more of their supply getting distributed. I need you to get down there and destroy the drugs they’re storing on site.

There's a good chance the facility isn't abandoned, so you might run into these thugs when you head down there, so be ready for a fight. But if their gun skills are anything like their chemistry, it probably won’t be much of one. 

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

Rayari_Rank2_IrradiatedValakkarPearl_Gat.description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are stopping at nothing to halt the ongoing regeneration crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need a rare resource that the company's suppliers cannot obtain. 

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather <EM4>irradiated valakkar pearls</EM4>, which can be extracted from adult valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have found a qualifying population inside the storm near <EM4>[Location]</EM4>. Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is prepared to generously compensate anyone who can assist with gathering the pearls. 

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_ZeusES.description: Wikelo can make new version of Zeus ship. I know it important ship to Human. Not sure why, but yes, very useful ship. Anyway, can upgrade and make a little prettier. What I need listed, if you want, bring. Bye.

PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliv.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
I really hope that you're not buddies with [TargetName] or [TargetName2] because I need you to ghost the pair of them... at the same time...

Of course they wouldn't make this easy on us and travel in the same ship or something obvious like that. No. You're going to have to put together a crew so that you can down both targets simultaneously. 

As soon as one of them is dead, be ready to drop the other one too. Can't risk either of them getting away.

And I figure I should mention that not only are both pretty good pilots, but that they'll be traveling with backup too. Nothing you can't handle I'm sure.

PU_HijackedShip_890_Stanton4.description:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at [Location] and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard. 

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters. 

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy. 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_EliminateCompe.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [Location|Address], but [TargetName] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CF.description:
Unfortunately, one of our community partners, [TargetName], has been missing for a few days. Their family contacted Citizens for Prosperity for help and I told them we would do what we could. That said, with so much time passed, I’m not too hopeful.

Whatever their current state is, we're looking for someone to be our eyes on the ground for this one. There’s a strong chance that they were headed to [Location|Address], an area known to be very dangerous.

If you can track them down and confirm their status, one way or another, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoTh.description:
[TargetName] was recently revealed to be a mole for XenoThreat. It all makes sense now because the skav was a major asshole. Unfortunately, they split before we could handle it ourselves. 

Based on all they learned about our ops, we need ‘em taken out pronto. They see one of us coming and they’ll just run again, but I figured someone like you has a better chance of getting close enough for a killshot. 

We just got word [TargetName|Last] was hanging around [Location|Address]. Looks like there’s other ships around protecting ‘em too. Think you got the skill to rid the ‘verse of a traitorous bastard and their bastard friends?  

Stows out.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description: Tecia Pacheco

PU_EliminateAll_Unlawful_EliminateCompet.description:
A client is getting out produced by a new competitor and is looking to throw a wrench into the works.

You’re going to head to [Location|Address] and kill all the civies who work there. 

Do what you want with the gun-toting goons guarding the workers, but remember that they aren’t the priority.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro6.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_NTLockdown_FleetFind_Antagonist_L5.description:
I told the Nine Tails that blocking quantum travel to hold a whole area hostage was gonna attract the wrong kind of attention, but do they listen to me? No. Now Crusader’s got dozens of scanning ships out there poking their noses into things I’d rather stay hidden. 

That’s why I'm trying to hire as many people as I can to help me out. I wanna pay you for each Crusader scanning ship you take out. 

In fact, I’ll even up your rate per-ship if all of you hit a certain number of kills. Call it a performance incentive.

And if you're really feeling like an overachiever, take out any fools brave enough to try running cargo to the blockaded station. I've got some suppliers who'll be appreciative of the extra demand.

If this sounds like something you're interested in, accept this offer right away! 

Looking forward to working with you,

Unified Distribution Management
 -Delivering the Total Package-

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in [location|address]. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over [location|address].

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

- Smokey

All right,

Over at [Location|Address] there a few certain things they have in their possession that need to be liberated. Sure there may be a few guards or concerned individuals you’ll have to deal with, but for the most part it’s a relatively straight forward transaction – grab the stuff from the [Location] and take it to us at [Destination|Address]. 

Sometimes simple is best.

-Bit Zeros

PU_Delivery_DC_Stanton_Courier_To_Stanto.description: <= UNINITIALIZED =>

HexPenetrator_DataHeist_5.description:
We've received tips that XenoThreat's intending to launch another attack on Stanton system. The CDF has petitioned the Advocacy to create a new initiative called Operation Overdrive to stop this attack before it happens. 

The CDF is dispatching volunteers to infiltrate and obtain any intel that could give insight into what they're planning. Needless to say, expect heavy resistance from any XenoThreat on site.

As an added incentive, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_Collect_Covalex_Personal_Thrace.description:
Hey,

So this is a little awkward for me to talk about, but it turns out that one of the people who passed away on that Covalex station disaster, Kyomi Santos, actually bequeathed me something in her will. I was surprised to hear it, but apparantly I'm now the proud owner of everything stored in box #173. The people at Covalex say I'll be able to get it when the station opens back up but ... this is the awkward part ... I kind of really need it right now. Normally I'd just wait, but I'm trying to start my own business (I make cakes in the shape of people's homeworlds) and the credits I get from selling it will really be a huge help. I've got a little bit stashed away now that I can use to pay for someone to deliver it from Gundo to [Destination] for me. I know the whole things a little bit irregular, but if there was any other way I wouldn't be asking.

Thanks for the help,
Thrace

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CFP_vs_XT_Idris_Event.description:
Hey, 

The rumors are true. XenoThreat has deployed an Idris to stalk and attack Citizens for Prosperity operations in a dramatic escalation of their hostility towards us. We just received word the ship, under the command of [TargetName], is advancing toward [location|address]. We can’t get our own forces there fast enough to fight them, and are in desperate need of help. 

We’re looking to hire someone brave enough to take it to these bastards. It’s not enough to scare them away, we need to guarantee that it can’t come after us again. 

Not sure if you’ve faced down an Idris before, but it’s a tall task for someone to take on alone. I’d highly recommend recruiting others to the cause.   

Best,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_NTLockdown_FleetDestroy_L5.description:
Crusader Security has confirmed the location of the outlaw Nine Tails fleet responsible and is mobilizing now to end the quantum blockade of [Location].

We are again seeking trained security professionals to join with our emergency response efforts and assist in neutralizing this dangerous threat.

Before accepting, please be aware that the Nine Tails are fully expected to offer considerable resistance and that until the blockade is ended, quantum travel will not be possible in the sector.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoTh.description:
Headhunters got word there’s a XenoThreat op in the works that's targeting one of our crews. We don’t have precise details about the plan but we know that [TargetName] is organizing it. Instead of sitting back and waiting for something to happen, we’ve decided to be proactive. 

[TargetName|Last] was just spotted with others around [Location|Address]. We can’t mobilize anyone fast enough to get there. I want you to rush there and deliver a preemptive strike.   

Stows out.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Illegal_.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton1_Gre.description:
I’m looking to send a strong message to the crew over at Storehouse and know the perfect way to do it - property damage.

All you need to do is head on over, destroy a few things here and there, and really drive home an important lesson about respecting your betters. 

Do that for me and I’ll be feeling very happy. And generous.

Interested?

PU_ServiceBeacon_CombatAssistance_NPC_Sp.description:
[HIGH THREAT]

 ~serviceBeacon(InitiatorName) is requesting combat assistance in deep space. If accepted, you will be paid ~serviceBeacon(PaymentAmount) aUEC upon elimination of the threat.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at [location|address] where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.      

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it. 

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us. 

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.     

- Smokey

TheColllector_Vehicle_Ground_ATLS_RedNBl.description: Wikelo give deep red and green colors to make ATLS legs look like they cooling from heat. Very pretty.

OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Spooner
RISK ASSESSMENT: High

FoxwellEnforcement_Patrol_Stanton_Hard.description:
Several unknown ships have been spotted in areas frequented by haulers delivering goods for our client. They’re worried these ships are monitoring their haulers in preparation for an ambush, so they’ve hired us to patrol the area. 

Start by going to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan it to ensure it’s clear. After that, we’ll send you to some other areas to scan for potential threats. We recommend that you bring a <EM4>wingman</EM4> and plenty of supplies to be ready to handle whatever might come your way.     

Also know that successfully completing this contract will earn the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Illegal.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton2_M.description:
We’ve been investigating a recent bout of OD’s and they all seem to have originated with a bad batch of drugs made over at [Location|Address]. 

I’m working with other contractors to ferret out those responsible, but people are dying as long is the product is still out there. 

I want you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there. Should buy us some time before we shut them down for good.

They will have guards protecting their supply, so be prepared to engage with hostiles.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_HeadHunters_R.description:
Headhunters recently discovered some orbital sentries focused on our operations and we don’t like it one bit. I’m looking to pay someone to go to [location|address] and make it abundantly clear they should stay the hell out of our business. Doubt they’ll be receptive to a discussion about it, so I’d be prepared to evict them with extreme force. 

Based on our scans, this won’t be a walk in the park. Wouldn’t be a bad idea to come prepared with plenty of ammo. Payment will be sent promptly once the job is done. 

Stows out.

KillAllAnimals_Stanton4_Easy.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a professional to bring the number of [Creature] in the wild back to within acceptable parameters. Their population is increasing too quickly, and culling some of their numbers will help ensure the situation doesn’t spiral out of control.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation.
• Locate the [Creature] on [Location].
• Use force as necessary to eliminate the [Creature].

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 1 year of relevant mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with extermination

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

PU_EliminateSpecific_Caves_Pyro5.description:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader [TargetName] is holed up at [location|address] working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without [TargetName|Last] getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out [TargetName|Last], but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.  

Stows out.

Xenothreat_PAR.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, XenoThreat forces started to ambush Naval convoy ships transporting vital supplies while en route to Jericho station at the Pyro Gateway in the Stanton System. The Navy has requested CDF forces to help recover these supplies from the wreckage and safely deliver them to Jericho. 

The Navy has organized a community stipend to handle the distribution of payment. This will be distributed among all CDF volunteers at assigned intervals. An indicator will appear on your HUD to measure these payouts.

Please note that some of these supplies are highly volatile if not handled correctly. Use caution while transporting these materials:
* Zeta-Prolanide degrades over time until breaking down completely.
* AcryliPlex Composite becomes explosively unstable if damaged.
* Diluthermex releases a destructive energy pulse if exposed to quantum travel.
 
Additionally, while not as volatile, the supplies of DynaFlex lost during the attack are still urgently needed by the Navy to complete their repairs of the Javelin and should be a priority for recovery.    

Also, XenoThreat hostiles might still be in the area so be careful. CDF volunteers with combat experience are also urged to contribute by securing these areas from lingering XenoThreat forces.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

That shipment was delivered to [Pickup1|Address]. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the [item], and take it to [Dropoff1|Address] so we can properly dispose of it.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_BlockadeRunner_Stanton3.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

A hostile fleet of ships equipped with quantum jammers have created a blockade around  [Location|address], disabled the station's defensive turrets, and stolen a large supply of Zeta-Prolanide. In response, the CDF has received authorization to activate its volunteer force. 

Though the overall situation is dire, the theft of the Zeta-Prolanide is our priority. Without direct action, the loss of the sector's Zeta-Prolanide stores could have a devastating effects to the wider economy of the whole system. 

While local security forces are investigating the incursion, they've tracked the stolen inventory to several locations. CDF volunteers are tasked with heading to these locations, recovering the stolen Zeta-Prolanide, and transferring it back to the station before the material completely degrades and is no longer viable. Just be careful, intel suggests that larger clusters of Zeta-Prolanide have a higher outlaw presence.

Since time is of the essence, having a tractor beam to assist in moving the cargo is highly advised.

As an added incentive, volunteers will receive regular bonus payments for their combined efforts.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Legal_Ea.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking [Location|address]. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [dropoff1|address]. 


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoTh.description:
XenoThreat recently hit a Headhunters' stronghold. I’ll spare you the details, but they did some truly heinous shit to our crew. We’ve identified the leader of the op as [TargetName] and are looking for a little payback. We don’t care what you do to get the job done. Only that [TargetName|Last] is dead. 

A source just told us that you can track down this XenoThreat scum over at [Location|Address]. This sicko’s a pro and never travels alone, so don’t expect taking them out to be a walk in the park.  

Stows out.

PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP_Pyro5.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have entrenched themselves at [Pickup1|Address]. To keep them from getting too comfy at that station, we want to show them what life is really like in our system. We’ll pay you to hit the station, grab the [item], and kill anyone that gets in your way. 

Payment hinges on you delivering those supplies to [Dropoff1|Address]. Anyone you kill will just be a perk.     

Comm. Spec. Engler
