PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Do you value Humanity’s freedom? If so, I’m offering you a chance to prove it. Recent scans discovered orbital sentries and patrolling ships at [location|address]. We believe they’re part of a UEE espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat. It’s important that we stop their intelligence gathering before we launch our next mission.

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to eliminate these forces immediately. The sentries are the priority, but the ships might prove a bigger issue if they’re allowed to escape. You’ll have to evaluate the situation more closely once you’re on site. 

We could take care of it ourselves, but want to send in a contractor so the scum behind it don’t know who hit them. Payment will be sent promptly upon completion. Plus, the satisfaction of knowing you’re helping a good cause.

Comm. Spec. Engler

YardRush_Salvage_LargeDontation_Intro_CF.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you could recruit a full fleet to resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address] with salvaged materials.</EM4> It would go a long way in helping us rebuild what was lost in the attacks.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to acquire what we need, but should be able to find some wrecks to scavenge orbiting around most planets.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_RR_Pyro2.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Assassination_PVE_Vaughn_Rehiring.description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more. 

Kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address] and I will consider the slate wiped clean. 

Sincerely,
Vaughn

PU_Multi-EliminateBoss_Bespoke.description:

PU_EliminateSpecific_Caves.description:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader [TargetName] is holed up at [location|address] working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without [TargetName|Last] getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out [TargetName|Last], but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.  

Stows out.

Rayari_Rank1_Gems_Single_Saldynium.description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Stanton2_Hard.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LagrangeLocation]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
A local Stanton independent mining team was working [Location] as Shubin Interstellar contractors when a hostile force attacked and took over the site. We believe that the perpetrators are still at the claim using the equipment left behind to harvest the valuable ore there for themselves.

Among the equipment lost were a handful of orbital sentries that had unfortunately not yet been fully deployed at the time of the attack. Long range scans of the claim have led us to conclude that the outlaws have activated the orbital sentries and are using them to protect their illegal operations.

To reclaim the site, we are seeking contractors to go to [Location], destroy the orbital sentries, and clear the site of hostile miners. Efficiency is strongly recommended as there is a high risk they will call for reinforcements once they discover they’re being evicted. 




*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

GMCapture.description:
To test the preparedness of our response teams, we would like volunteers to simulate an assault against a CDF Idris by neutralizing and taking control of the vessel.

To be clear, the goal of the exercise is not to destroy the Idris, but for you to attempt to board the craft and maintain control of it as long as possible. Volunteers should expect to meet full resistance from the Idris' highly trained crew and are encouraged to get an updated imprint beforehand.

Coordinates will be provided upon confirming your participation.

Thanks and good luck.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Do you value Humanity’s freedom? If so, I’m offering you a chance to prove it. Recent scans discovered orbital sentries and patrolling ships at [location|address]. We believe they’re part of a UEE espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat. It’s important that we stop their intelligence gathering before we launch our next mission.

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to eliminate these forces immediately. The sentries are the priority, but the ships might prove a bigger issue if they’re allowed to escape. You’ll have to evaluate the situation more closely once you’re on site. 

We could take care of it ourselves, but want to send in a contractor so the scum behind it don’t know who hit them. Payment will be sent promptly upon completion. Plus, the satisfaction of knowing you’re helping a good cause.

Comm. Spec. Engler

HexPenetrator_Bounty_2.description:
Our analysts have examined the intel seized from those XenoThreat recon teams but the data appears to be locked behind a sophisticated encryption system and requires a custom cryptokey to access.

We've managed to locate several XenoThreat lieutenants operating in the system, you are to find and engage the suspects and see if they are in possession of a cryptokey that will allows us to access the intel.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_EliminateAll_Unlawful_NoNonHostiles_S.description: Everybody holds grudges, right? I mean, when you get popped pulling a crime, I get that you’re a little sour, but that’s pretty much the game, right?

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_RR_Pyro2_Med.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
Rough & Ready recently provided fueling services for a hauler named [TargetName], who agreed to deliver their next load of supplies to us as compensation. Well, we just found out that the lying skag sold their latest shipment to a rival gang instead. 

We’re looking for someone to track down and eliminate [TargetName|Last] for the double cross. 

An old friend of mine just spotted the skag at [Location|Address]. Looks like they're loaded with more cargo that’s not coming our way, and traveling with an escort. We’re only paying you to take out the ship, so anything you find aboard is yours to keep.

- Smokey

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
Normally, the pair of [TargetName] and [TargetName2] would be too much to take on together. They both are about as good as it gets when it comes to dogfighting and the crew they fly with are almost as good.

But recently they split - not sure why - and are flying separate for the moment.  Someone thinks this may be the best chance to take them out. 

Gather some personnel you can trust and plan a simultaneous raid against both targets. It's too dangerous to risk one of them living after such a direct move against them.

Hey, 

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name [TargetName] has been located at [Location|Address]. 

Based on our intel, its highly unlikely that the target’s going to be sitting and waiting out in the open. You most likely will have to infiltrate the facility and draw them out. 

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick. 

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

FoxwellEnforcement_Patrol_Stanton_Super.description:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.

Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.   

Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> at the end of the patrol.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

NorthRock_HijackedShip_890J_Stanton.description:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at [Location] and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard. 

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters. 

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy. 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP_Pyro1.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have entrenched themselves at [Pickup1|Address]. To keep them from getting too comfy at that station, we want to show them what life is really like in our system. We’ll pay you to hit the station, grab the [item], and kill anyone that gets in your way. 

Payment hinges on you delivering those supplies to [Dropoff1|Address]. Anyone you kill will just be a perk.     

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart_Eas.description:
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In relation to a jointly committed crime, a group warrant has been issued for:
     [Target1]
     [Target2]
     [Target3]

It is currently believed that they are no longer traveling together in order to evade capture, and may soon flee the system.  You should strongly consider recruiting additional help in order to execute all the warrants in the limited time frame. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the targets. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract when all targets have been dealt with in the allotted time.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4_Legal_Ha.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a security professional for a retrieval op at [Location]. The location is currently under attack and security forces on-site are unresponsive and presumed dead. We believe confidential materials recently delivered to the facility for temporary holding were the target of the raid. Your main focus will be collecting those boxes and delivering them to a secure location.  

For security reasons, the confidential materials were delivered as part of a larger shipment and secured in the automated vault. The materials have unique retrieval codes that must be entered on the keypad at the package conveyor. Protocols require that only senior security officers can carry a datapad containing a code, but considering the volatile situation, we can't guarantee that the Nine Tails haven’t taken possession of them. Once secured, deliver all of the confidential materials to [dropoff1] for payment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|address].
• Use force as necessary to collect the confidential materials.
• Deliver the confidential materials to [dropoff1|address].

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment. 
• Access to a spaceship that can transport cargo.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.
• Experience hauling important cargo.

TheCollector_SB_NavyArm(DO_NOT_USE_NOW_L.description:
Know you humans like your navy. Wikelo understand. Very big ships. Powerful too. Wikelo can give armor set that look like navy color. Very easy to make. 

See what Wikelo need, get and bring to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> and it will be yours.

Wikelo

PU_Multi-EliminateAll_Modular_3Locations.description:
Following their latest attempted siege, Nine Tails forces have begun to conduct targeted raids in an effort to continue to disrupt Crusader operations. The current attack has targeted multiple buildings on [MissionCluster|Address] and it’s vital that we put a stop to the aggression there.

Crusader Security is seeking a contractor willing to clear all Nine Tails operators in the area. Contractors should expect to use force and are strongly encouraged to consider bringing back-up. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_EliminateAll_DC_Stanton_Stor_HDPC-Far.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Neutralize Hostile Force
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Dalik
RISK ASSESSMENT: High

Our security forces have been notified of an ongoing outlaw incursion at Storehouse, and we are in need of an independent operator capable of clearing out the hostile actors. 

According to onsite personnel, the outlaws are currently holed up near the Storehouse. Approach with caution and be prepared to use lethal force if the outlaws resist being removed.

Payment will only be authorized once the location has been effectively cleared.




** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for someone to handle a delicate situation. We’ve discovered a ship and orbital sentries at [location|address] spyin’ on us. We’re in a bit of a bind because we don’t want to start a larger fight with whoever’s behind this. That’s why we’re looking for some hired help who can quickly and discreetly take care of it for us. Interested?

Last thing, once you’re out there, make sure to keep an eye on that ship. Bet as soon as you start blowin’ up their sentries they’re gonna try to bring in some help to stop you.
 
- Smokey

PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_Danger_Py.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near [Location|Address] which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Firesale_Large_HH.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to do a detatrine resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that <EM4>depots</EM4> across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton4.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking [Location|address]. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [dropoff1|address]. 


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_E.description:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over [location|address].

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

HexPenetrator_Bounty_3.description:
Our analysts have examined the intel seized from those XenoThreat recon teams but the data appears to be locked behind a sophisticated encryption system and requires a custom cryptokey to access.

We've managed to locate several XenoThreat lieutenants operating in the system, you are to find and engage the suspects and see if they are in possession of a cryptokey that will allows us to access the intel.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_St.description:
Hey, 

Got a contract for you that requires a bit more tactics than usual. A high-level criminal by the name [TargetName] is hiding with a large contingent of outlaws at [Location|Address]. 

Our intel suggests that [TargetName|Last]’s forces most likely will act as defensive line in order to protect their boss. My best guess is that you will have to deal with them before you gain access to [TargetName|Last].

That said, I don’t want you shooting indiscriminately. Sometimes these outlaws keep civilians around and they should be treated like non-combatants.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:

CleanAir_Bulk_ResourceGathering_Filters_.description:
POSTING: Resource Gathering 
LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System
WORK EXPERIENCE: Mining, Commodity Trading
TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is stepping up to help stop the spread of the People’s Ailment. Our facilities are helping in the efforts to produce much needed ventilation filters to replace the faulty ones responsible for the spread of the dangerous Molina Mold, but we need your help to hit that ambitious goal. 

Our current stockpiles of an important resource are not sufficient enough, so we need contractors who can deliver a large-scale haul of it to <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4>.

Resources tied to another contract will not be accepted.   

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_Stanton1_Eckhart_Med.description:
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In relation to a jointly committed crime, a group warrant has been issued for:
     [Target1]
     [Target2]
     [Target3]

It is currently believed that they are no longer traveling together in order to evade capture, and may soon flee the system.  You should strongly consider recruiting additional help in order to execute all the warrants in the limited time frame. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the targets. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract when all targets have been dealt with in the allotted time.

This contract is non-negotiable.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton1_Illegal_.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

Face off against the frigid winds that cover the mountains of the Euterpe Advanced Research Laboratories or bide your time and hope the weather clears. Whatever your choice, know that the Icebreaker takes no prisoners.

PU_Multi-EliminateAll_Bespoke_3Locations.description:
Following their latest attempted siege, Nine Tails forces have begun to conduct targeted raids in an effort to continue to disrupt Crusader operations. The current attack has targeted multiple buildings on [MissionCluster|Address] and it’s vital that we put a stop to the aggression there.

Crusader Security is seeking a contractor willing to clear all Nine Tails operators in the area. Contractors should expect to use force and are strongly encouraged to consider bringing back-up. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

Rayari_Rank0_Harvestable_Single_SunestBe.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

NorthRock_Bounty_EscapedConvict_PVP_Intr.description:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract. 

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system. 

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TargetName]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid. 

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

HaulCargo_SingleToMulti2_Processed_Stims.description:
Hi,

There’s a load of stims at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me? 

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.    

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>

Glad I never picked up the habit myself because I swear I get more delivery update requests for “where are my stims?!?” than any other kind of shipment. 

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Independent Contractors

Chase Hewitt

PU_Destroy_Items_KeypadLocked.description:
One of our datarunners went MIA while transporting vital operational information. A few hours ago, we determined that they were hit by a Headhunter raiding party and the contents of the ship’s datastores were transferred to their servers at [location|address]. 

While we have every reason to believe that our encryption will hold, we cannot take the risk that the contents of those files will be exposed. You are being ordered to head there and ensure our data remains private by destroying the Headhunter servers.

I strongly encourage thoroughness. Raze everything and everyone you can to the ground.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Multi-EliminateBoss_Modular_2Location.description:
Crusader Security has received intelligence that a Nine Tails raid currently occurring at [MissionCluster|Address] includes several prominent gang enforcers. Ending this raid and bringing those responsible to justice is a top priority for Crusader Security. That's why we're looking for a contractor willing to go and apprehend those leading it.

At each attack site, you will need to deplete the Nine Tails forces there until you are able to draw out the enforcer in charge.

Considering the brutality deployed by Nine Tails during their recent siege, we recommend that contractors be prepared to use force and strongly encourage them to consider bringing back-up.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

PU_DestroyNarcotics_legal_Stanton4_E.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary or security professional to report to [Location|Address] and destroy the contraband being stored there. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Clear the site of contraband; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• No ongoing addiction issues.

PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton1_Aba.description:
I’m looking to send a strong message to the crew over at [Location|Address] and know the perfect way to do it - property damage.

All you need to do is head on over, destroy a few things here and there, and really drive home an important lesson about respecting your betters. 

Do that for me and I’ll be feeling very happy. And generous.

Interested?

PU_Destroy_BombingRun_Pyro_AttackCFP.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that [location|address] is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high. 

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_CitizensForPyro.description:
Hey, 

The rumors are true. XenoThreat has deployed an Idris to stalk and attack Citizens for Prosperity operations in a dramatic escalation of their hostility towards us. We just received word the ship, under the command of [TargetName], is advancing toward [location|address]. We can’t get our own forces there fast enough to fight them, and are in desperate need of help. 

We’re looking to hire someone brave enough to take it to these bastards. It’s not enough to scare them away, we need to guarantee that it can’t come after us again. 

Not sure if you’ve faced down an Idris before, but it’s a tall task for someone to take on alone. I’d highly recommend recruiting others to the cause.   

Best,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Recover_Stash_Lawf.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>Ghost Hollow</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from <EM4>Ghost Hollow</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in [location|address]. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

PU_TowShip_Prototype.description:
Got a particular salvage job that we could use some extra hands on. 

We need you to find a [ship] that got punched out around Port Tressler. Security’s already searching for it and if they find it, they’ll ID it for sure and we’ll be in loads of trouble.

So, we want you to make sure that can’t happen. Either tow the ship out of the search area or rip the entire hull off so nobody can tell who it belonged to. Whatever you decide, keep your mouth shut about this. 

We’ll cred you up and anything you scrap is yours to keep. But if security finds the ship before you’re done, we’ll all be screwed and you won’t get paid so don’t disappoint.

TheCollector_Vehicle_Ground_Nox.description: Wikelo know many Xi'an. Talk slow but very interesting if you have patience. This is very fast little thing to get you across planet. Wikelo made a few tweaks to make it zippier. If you want, Wikelo will make for you. Bye.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Stanton1_Hard.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LagrangeLocation]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
A local Stanton independent mining team was working [Location] as Shubin Interstellar contractors when a hostile force attacked and took over the site. We believe that the perpetrators are still at the claim using the equipment left behind to harvest the valuable ore there for themselves.

Among the equipment lost were a handful of orbital sentries that had unfortunately not yet been fully deployed at the time of the attack. Long range scans of the claim have led us to conclude that the outlaws have activated the orbital sentries and are using them to protect their illegal operations.

To reclaim the site, we are seeking contractors to go to [Location], destroy the orbital sentries, and clear the site of hostile miners. Efficiency is strongly recommended as there is a high risk they will call for reinforcements once they discover they’re being evicted. 




*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

TimeTrial_Ship_Stanton2b_YadarValley.description:
Ready to set a new personal best with Wildstar Racing Amateur League?

The cranes, refinery towers, and bridges of rocky terrain in the Yadar Valley will require you to think fast and fly even faster, if you wish to triumph.

RACE DETAILS

* FEATURES: Low-Altitude Flying

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Legal_Ea.description:

Nine Tails are currently assaulting one of our facilities at [Location|address]. As they just received a delivery of confidential materials, we don’t believe this is a coincidence. BlacJac needs someone to hurry to the location and secure these important boxes before the Nine Tails do. You are authorized to use lethal force against any who attempt to stop you. 

As part of our standard security protocol, the confidential materials were integrated into another consignment and secured in the automated vault. You’ll need to find the relevant retrieval codes for the confidential materials and enter it at the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. Retrieval codes are stored locally on datapads and only given to high-ranking staff. Hopefully they’re alive to help you, but considering the complete comms blackout, we fear that’s not the case. There's a chance Nine Tails have already gotten their hands on the datapads.  

Once you’ve gathered all the confidential materials, they will need to be delivered to [dropoff1|address]. Payment is contingent upon their delivery.


Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

Hello,

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_RR_Pyro5.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

HexPenetrator_Kareah.description:
Attention all CDF volunteers, we received a distress call from Security Post Kareah. It turns out XenoThreat used the comm arrays as a distraction to lure law enforcement away so they could launch an attack on the station.

We've learned that they're attempting to access their systems, so all volunteers must immediately divert to retake Kareah and clear out all XenoThreat forces.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

Shubin_RG_Discovery_ShipMining_EnegryEng.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>[System] </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. This purchase order is more complex than typical, requiring multiple mining methods, but since you've proven your skill thus far, we think you and your team are up for the challenge.

Reminder, <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

PU_Destroy_BombingRun_DC_Stanton_CryAstr.description:
We’ve been trying to access some sensitive data over at [Location|Address] but there seems to only be one backdoor we can use. The issue is we need someone onsite to trigger it. And I really do mean trigger it.

If you can head over there and destroy part of their infrastructure, the emergency back up systems will kick online and we should be able to access everything we want. 

Wish I could see the surprise look on the faces of the lowlifes running the place when it happens.

-Bit Zeros

PU_EliminateAll_Unlawful_EliminateCompet.description:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at [Location|Address], but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

What I want you to do, is go there and kill all the guards while making sure all the workers remain unharmed.

YardRush_Mining_Large_HH_Stanton.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of resources is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to deliver the supplies to<EM4> Pyro Gateway. </EM4>I have ship waiting to take it to Pyro from there.

Up to you how you get the stuff. Mine it, steal it, buy it from a trader - I don’t care as long as I get what I need refined and delivered. Might be worth checking Daymar or Aberdeen to start.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP_Pyro5.description:
Leave it to the lying UEE to say they’re not involved with the operations of Citizens for Prosperity simply because they “donate” supplies to a tertiary aid organization who then immediately delivers it right to them. 

We just got word that one of these government aid shipments was dropped off at a Citizens for Prosperity aligned outpost. That’s why we’ll pay you to raid [Pickup1|Address] and claim the [item] for the cause. Once you deliver everything to [Dropoff1|Address] we can redistribute the shipment to help in our fight. Nothing better than using the enemies resources against them. 

But don’t think they’ll just hand the stuff over to you. Even though Citizens for Prosperity are supposedly here to bring peace, you best be prepared to go toe to toe with ‘em. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliv.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for some important packages that were stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to different derelict outposts. We need you to head there and recover the packages. You'll be able to ID them by their serial numbers: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>, <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> and <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the packages, fly them back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for the  cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Packages <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>, <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> and <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> from <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
Some asshole going by the name [TargetName] has been running a scheme where their cargo ship requests refueling services only to ambush our ships when they get there. Even loaded the damn thing up with real cargo to make sure it passes scans. We’ve spread the word so nobody in Rough & Ready will fall for the trap again, but I want this skag punished. 

I think [TargetName|Last] knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around [Location|Address]. Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all. 

- Smokey

PU_Bounty_PVE_Group_NorthRock_ReHiring.description:
Hey,

I've been thinking over everything that went down and decided to speak to management. They've agreed to give you another chance but only if you successfully complete a contract for us.

We can look at reinstating your employment status if you can bring in this criminal trio:
[Target1]
[Target2]
[Target3]

They evaded the last Associate who went after them, so you bringing them all in would definitely earn you some points.

Hopefully you've gotten your act together since your last job.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

HighpointWildernessSpecialists_KillAnima.description:
A client has contacted us about resolving a <EM4>[Creature]</EM4> infestation issue before it gets any worse. Several locations around <EM4>The cave can only be accessed on foot.</EM4> are currently beset by the creatures. There’s a growing concern that if this goes on for too much longer, then the natural habit will be ravaged beyond repair. Are you available to take care of this issue?

You can refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for more specific information on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

PU_Delivery_DC_Stanton_Specific_Stanton4.description:
Greetings Qualified Shipping Partner!

Looking for an excuse to hit the skies with your cargo-ready vessel? Earn credits and explore the local area with this following carefully selected itinerary -

PACKAGE FOR PICK UP
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION

If being your own supervisor and getting paid to fly your very own ship sounds like the perfect job, this contract is just what you've been looking for. Just be sure to bring your own <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> for maximum efficiency. 

Looking forward to working with you,

Unified Distribution Management
 -Delivering the Total Package-

PU_HijackedShip_890_Stanton3.description:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at [Location] and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard. 

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters. 

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy. 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton1_H.description:
A client of mine‘s trying to negotiate a deal, but isn’t having much luck. The other party feels like they got all the leverage because they’re sitting comfortably on a pile of inventory. To help move the negotiations along, I’m gonna need you to head down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Now, I should probably tell you that the site’s being protected by some very serious people, so getting to the stash is going to be a bit tricky, but I trust you’ll find a way.

Payment will only be authorized once the location has been effectively cleared.

Headhunters are looking for a merc to do a little clean up for us. Found out that someone’s trying to spy on us over at [location|address]. Can’t let that stand. We need a skilled operator to take care of the orbital sentries they dropped there, and if needed, deal with any of their ships that get in your way. Seems like a decently run op, so hitting it might not be easy but it sure should be fun. 

Let us know if you’re the right one for the gig. Creds will be transferred once our scans show it’s gone. 

Stows out.

Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

PU_Jumptown2_Child_Legal_S3.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We’ve been able to trace a recent surge of contraband to an automated production facility at [Location|Address]. We can’t be sure how much longer the site will be up and running, so BlacJac needs someone on site to sweep through, secure the contraband, and transport it to us at Baijini Point. Once there, you can use the administrative commodity terminal to transfer the contraband to us and collect your reward.

We haven’t been able to determine what kind of hostile force will be present, but whatever you encounter, you’re authorized to use lethal force as necessary. 

The more contraband you manage to bring to us, the more credits you’ll earn.

Thanks,
Lt. Aaron Riegert

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_HH_Pyro3.description:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system. 

That shipment was delivered to [Pickup1|Address]. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the [item], and take it to [Dropoff1|Address] so we can properly dispose of it. 

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

Conni Ling

BlockadeRunner_Counter_Stanton3.description:
Word is that a lot of Zeta-Prolanide has been stolen from [Location|address].

Vaughn

Comm. Spec. Engler

Meteor big. It heavy. Have many guns. But Wikelo figure out way to make even better. You have things I will take to do.

ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Got a very low-risk target I need you to take care of: [TargetName].

Their last known location was [Location|Address].

Gloria Mesa

BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

CleanAir_Large_ResourceGathering_Researc.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are working around-the-clock to assist with the treatment for the current fungal outbreak in Levski. Due to logistic issues, our team at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> is running low on a key resource in their research. Losing production at that location would hamper the Alliance Aid’s effort to cure people suffering from this terrible affliction in a timely manner.

That’s why we're eager for the help of anyone who can find and deliver this vital supply to <EM4>[Destination]</EM4>.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_RR_Pyro5_Har.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Rayari_Rank1_Harvestable_Single_Horns.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal_.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton4_M.description:
One of my clients has been unhappy to learn that someone's been muscling in on their territory. Now rather than going down the more traditional route of killing some people and starting a whole thing, they’ve opted to send a different kind of message instead.

You’re gonna go down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

TheCollector_Vehicle_L22_Wolf.description: Wikelo very excited. Have idea for new material. But making it is most tricky. Very complicated. Need help fabricating a test sample. I give you blueprint, you make, bring to me, and I will trade. Give you extra special L-22 Wolf. Very powerful, very wolf.

PU_MissingPerson_Stations_Pyro_CFP_Pyro2.description:
Two locals we work with were out salvaging at [Location|Address] when they had some issues with faulty equipment. One managed to escape, but their partner, [TargetName] was unfortunately left behind.

With the state they were last reported to be in, I’m guessing they didn’t make it, but I’d like to know for sure. If you’re willing, I could use your help in finding their remains.

If you can track them down, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated for the effort.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Recently made an interesting discovery that someone set up a handful of orbital sentries at [location|address]. Guess they’re trying to grab some info about our operations there. They even have a few ships guarding to make sure nothing happens to them. 

Of course, we want these bastards gone, but I’m worried that getting rid of it ourselves would be bad for business. That’s why we’re looking for a little ‘plausible deniability’. PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_06.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Maltrox Arlington has been keeping a low profile recently, but we think he's come out of hiding. A patrol was refueling at a station when one of their ships was boosted. Maltrox is the most likely suspect. While the regtag was temporarily deactivated, we have been able to trace the ship’s quantum signature and have provided you those coordinates.

A third generation criminal, the Arlington gang has been under Maltrox’s leadership for the past six years. Be aware, this is a smart, aggressive, and very dangerous target. The more resources you can bring to bear, the more likely it is that we can bring Maltrox in one and for all. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Interesting assignment came my way. I need two separate targets taken out: [TargetName] and [TargetName2]

Thankfully, my intel says that both the targets should be traveling alone. That should help make things a bit easier on you.

PU_DestroyNarcotics_Illegal_Stanton2_M.description:
One of my clients has been unhappy to learn that someone's been muscling in on their territory. Now rather than going down the more traditional route of killing some people and starting a whole thing, they’ve opted to send a different kind of message instead.

You’re gonna go down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_XT_vs_HH_Pyro2.description:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system. 

That shipment was delivered to [Pickup1|Address]. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the [item], and take it to [Dropoff1|Address] so we can properly dispose of it. 

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_Generic_P.description:
Time is up for [TargetName]. The skav is way past due on paying back the Headhunters, so I need you to punch them out. 

Kill ‘em, not hit ‘em, just in case that’s unclear. 

Someone recently spotted [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address], so head there and take ‘em out.  

Full disclosure, we’ve gotten reports they used some of our creds to hire extra protection. Prepare accordingly. 

Stows out.

BlockadeRunner_Counter.description:
Word is that a lot of Zeta-Prolanide has been stolen from [Location|address].

If you happen to come across any, bring it over to [DropOffLocation|address] and we'll make sure you get a good price.

PU_NTLockdown_FleetDestroy_Antagonist.description:
Now that Crusader’s found their fleet, it seems the Nine Tails finally realized just how useful a bit of extra help can be.

Long story short, they’re looking for some hired muscle to keep Crusader at bay. You’ll and everyone else who volunteers get a payout for every security ship you take down. 

And on top of that, if all of you keep Crusader occupied long enough for the Nine Tails to finish up whatever the hell it is that they’re up to with this quantum blockade, you’ll get a big fat bonus.

PU_Inhabited_Derelict_Settlements_Elimin.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented security professional who can quickly and safely assist us in the complete removal of illegal occupants who have temporarily gained control of [Location|Address].

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Remove all illegal occupants found within the site; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

Phase3DebugSkipObjective1.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Once you have those, head down to the <EM4>Lab in Site-B</EM4> and <EM4>run the experiment</EM4> so you can <EM4>upload the results</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

YardRush_Mining_Intro_CFP.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you could resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

I leave it up to you to decide how best to procure and refine the resources, but the asteroid clusters near LaGrange points might be a good place to start mining.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description: Tecia Pacheco

PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_EliminateC.description:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to [Location|Address] and kill [TargetName]. What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_Terrapin_Med.description:
Wikelo not know this Human word but ship is very useful when things go danger. If you want, can give new version of it. Maybe more useful?

You fly and tell. Bye.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal_.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

The refinery at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> has been busy. They’ve processed a bunch of <EM4>Tungsten</EM4> into containers <EM4>16 SCU</EM4> or smaller, and are looking to get it shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see which ones needed this stuff and was able to put together this run.  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination2|Address]</EM4>

Should be an easy run for you, if you’re free. 

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Independent Contractors

Chase Hewitt

There’s some junk waiting at a freight elevator in <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that needs to go to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> for processing. I've confirmed that the containers won't be bigger than <EM4>1 SCU</EM4>. 

My mom would’ve loved this run. She’s one of those who thinks every scrapyard is filled with hidden treasures. Can’t even tell you how many hours I spent bored out of my mind following her around one. If that’s your thing, here’s a chance to actually make credits going to one.

PU_Defend_Lawful_Stanton3_H.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We’ve gotten word that some local muscle have been making threats against [Location|Address]. BlacJac is looking to have you put a team together and protect the site from these hostile threats.

And as much as we all love credits, I don’t recommend trying to do this one solo. Hiring a team to come along would be beneficial to your livelihood.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
Some asshole going by the name [TargetName] has been running a scheme where their cargo ship requests refueling services only to ambush our ships when they get there. Even loaded the damn thing up with real cargo to make sure it passes scans. We’ve spread the word so nobody in Rough & Ready will fall for the trap again, but I want this skag punished. 

I think [TargetName|Last] knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around [Location|Address]. Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all. 

- Smokey

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Random.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LagrangeLocation]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
While conducting a survey of Shubin claims in the sector, we were disheartened to learn that a small team of outlaws have set up shop at [Location] and have been illegal harvesting resources. Worse, they have established a defensive perimeter with several orbital sentries dotted around the site making it difficult for us to evict them. 

In order that we may repossess the claim site, we are seeking mercenary contractors to find and destroy the handful of orbital sentries. Adding additional difficulty to the task is that we are unclear as to the exact fighting strength of these outlaw miners. If they are given the chance to summon reinforcements expect anything from a small contingency to a full squad of trained fighters. 




*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

PU_NTLockdown_FleetFind_Antagonist.description:
I told the Nine Tails that blocking quantum travel to hold a whole area hostage was gonna attract the wrong kind of attention, but do they listen to me? No. Now Crusader’s got dozens of scanning ships out there poking their noses into things I’d rather stay hidden. 

That’s why I'm trying to hire as many people as I can to help me out. I wanna pay you for each Crusader scanning ship you take out. 

In fact, I’ll even up your rate per-ship if all of you hit a certain number of kills. Call it a performance incentive.

And if you're really feeling like an overachiever, take out any fools brave enough to try running cargo to the blockaded station. I've got some suppliers who'll be appreciative of the extra demand.

PU_Destroy_Items_Stanton_DC_Stanton4_mic.description:
The muckers over at [Location|Address] decided that it would be a good idea to interfere with our business, and now we need to let them know unequivocally that they were mistaken. 

A little bit of sniffin’ through their data and we were able to sus out where the idiots keep their stash. Now all we need you to do is head over there and destroy every last bit of it. 

Figure that should drive the point home.

- Bit Zeros

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_XenoThreat_vs_HeadHun.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on [TargetName]. A known member of the Headhunters gang, [TargetName|Last] has betrayed Humankind by being a known alien ally who associates with them in both a personal and business capacity. XenoThreat wants these traitorous associations stopped immediately before they bring more alien influence to Pyro. We’ll pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates [TargetName|Last] for these crimes against Humanity.  

LOCATION UPDATE: [TargetName|Last] was recently spotted with an escort at [Location|Address]. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

Pick up <EM4>Corundum</EM4> from a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and deliver it to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. In order to complete this haul in a fast and efficient manner, you'll need a ship that can haul <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Hopefully everything goes smoothly so we can welcome you back to the team.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

Covalex Shipping

PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_Stanton1.description:
A security officer by the name of [TargetName] is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at [Location|Address] along with a host of other eager types in uniforms. 

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of [TargetName] which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR_.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in Hangar 13. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

PU_ECN_Space_Stanton1_Medium.description: ATTENTION: An ECN relay in your sector has received an emergency signal broadcast from a ship in distress. Any available ships in the area capable of rendering assistance are requested to do so immediately.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Stanton1_HurSec_Intro.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Bounty Collection
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: Hurston Dynamics
RISK ASSESSMENT: Very Low-Risk Target (Single Seater Craft, Minimal Support)
RUSH CONTRACT: Hurston Dynamics

After repeated and continual misdemeanor offenses, a bounty has been issued for the following individual - [TargetName].
 
To evaluate your potential in assisting in the capture of more elusive criminals, Hurston Dynamics will be evaluating your ability to locate and apprehend [TargetName|Last] by any means at your disposal. The latest intel on [TargetName|Last]'s current whereabouts has them last seen at [Location|Address].

Payment will be released only after the bounty is dealt with. 
 

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_RR_Pyro5.description:
Not sure if you’d had the pleasure of dealing with the Rough & Ready, but the gang is laser focused on cornering the fuel market in Pyro. Smart play, but one we can’t let happen without them providing us some concessions. Since they’re currently not interested in negotiating, we’re forced to show them what happens to those who oppose us.

We’ve identified [Pickup1|Address] as a prime target for such an attack. We also know they recently received some supplies that should be a fitting price for their obstinance. Once inside the station, do whatever you need to do to confiscate the [item]. We’ll send payment once you’ve delivered them to [Dropoff1|Address].      

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_EliminateSpecific_Unlawful_EliminateC.description:

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Generic.description:
I have a delicate situation that needs handling. After years of being a loyal member of Rough & Ready, [TargetName] defected from the gang and is out there shopping secrets to our rivals. We need [TargetName|Last] ghosted immediately. 

With stuff like this, I’ve found it’s always better to pay someone unassociated with us to do the deed. Scans picked up [TargetName|Last] near [Location|Address] not too long ago. We’ll pay you well to head there now and take care ‘em for us. 

[TargetName|Last] isn’t an idiot and knows we’ll be coming after ‘em. Be prepared for a helluva fight and don’t expect ‘em to be alone.

- Smokey

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_WithHelp_Stanton2.description:
Crusader Security has learned that [Location|Address] is currently being threatened by a group of criminals.

While we have security personnel on site, we are looking to hire additional contractors to help them repel any attacks. 

Now, as a contractor, I’m not sure how used to working with a team you are, but I don’t want to hear anything about "friendly fire" or there’s going to be problems.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K
