PU_Jumptown2_Child_Illegal_S4.description:
Got some good news for you. As we speak, there’s an automated facility that is churning out package after package of primo product that’s pretty much ripe for the taking.

All you have to do is swoop down there, deal with a thug or two, grab whatever you can, and sell it for a huge profit. Shouldn’t be a problem at all. And there are plenty of people around who would pay good creds to take product like that off your hands.

Speaking of credits, I’m not gonna just give out the coordinates of this facility out of the kindness of my heart. I think it’s only fair to ask a finder’s fee for info this good.

I wouldn’t wait too long. Not sure how long the site will be left running.

-Ruto

HaulCargo_Multi4ToSingle_Waste_Waste_Sta.description:
Hi,

Need the trash collected from a few Hurston locations and then taken to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Don't worry, none of the containers are bigger than <EM4>4 SCU</EM4>.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>

One of their workers told me that the company did a cost-benefit analysis on it decades ago that determined it wasn’t worth putting a planet-wide system in place to facilitate it. Isn’t that the most Hurston thing ever?

PU_MissingPerson_Stations_Pyro_CFP_Pyro3.description:
Hey,

I’m getting pretty worried about one of our local contractors, [TargetName]. They finished up a trade at [Location|Address] and haven’t been seen since. We’re hearing reports that outlaws have been sneaking aboard there, and if that’s true, I suspect that the worst might have happened.

Either way, [TargetName|First] has done good work for us in the past and I’d hate for them to wind up as just another one of Pyro’s missing. If you’re willing to find them for me, I’ll see that you get a reward. 

Just be careful. Hate for you to go missing too.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_NoNonHostiles_.description:
A senior security official by the name of [TargetName] has been marked for termination. While they can be found at [Location|Address], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

Normally, I would recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. However, in this instance a more delicate touch is required. While you should feel free to eliminate any and all of the security forces on site, you must ensure the safety of all the civilian workers there.

Tiresome for sure, but a requirement none the less. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

Tutorial02_Shopping_Lorville.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with Lorville and take you to visit Tammany and Sons, a weapons store here in Lorville.

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

PU_MissingPerson_DerelictOutpost_Pyro_CF.description:
One of our people, [TargetName], was supposed to be doing some preliminary scouting work over at [Location|Address], but they never reported in. We’re hoping that they just ran into some bad luck, but too often out here even the smallest misstep can prove fatal.

PU_ClearCrimestat_Intro.description:
Hi there. We haven’t had a chance to work together yet but I’m in a bit of a bind here and I could use another body. Not for nothing, of course. I’m all for a good quid pro quo.

One of my associates who was serving some time in Klescher was supposed to bring me a datachip, but then they went quiet. Now I’m assuming they’re dead, but here’s the deal: if you finish his job, I wipe your crimestat. Not bad, right?

Your predecessor was apparently planning on using some old tunnels to make his escape. He made it sound like they weren't exactly the easiest thing to access, but I trust you can figure it out. I'm guessing you'll find his body somewhere in there and if we’re lucky, he'll still have the chip on him.

Once you get it, finish getting out however you can. Then get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. You might want to watch out for Hurston Security, though. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them. After I get the data and validate it, I’ll wipe your crimestat. 

Then you can go and enjoy your newfound freedom. If you do this right, maybe I’ll have more lucrative work for you down the line.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Do you value Humanity’s freedom? If so, I’m offering you a chance to prove it. Recent scans discovered orbital sentries and patrolling ships at [location|address]. We believe they’re part of a UEE espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat. It’s important that we stop their intelligence gathering before we launch our next mission.

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to eliminate these forces immediately. The sentries are the priority, but the ships might prove a bigger issue if they’re allowed to escape. You’ll have to evaluate the situation more closely once you’re on site. 

We could take care of it ourselves, but want to send in a contractor so the scum behind it don’t know who hit them. Payment will be sent promptly upon completion. Plus, the satisfaction of knowing you’re helping a good cause.

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_EliminateSpecific_Outposts_Indy_Pyro_.description:
XenoThreat’s efforts to keep outside influences from infecting this system is being tested by a group that dares to call itself Citizens for Prosperity. A prominent group member, [TargetName], has established operations at [Location|Address] and is already hard at work spreading their lies and propaganda to anyone that will listen. If we want Pyro to remain independent of UEE and alien influence, then something must be done about this now.  

That’s why XenoThreat is issuing a kill order for [TargetName|Last]. And knowing how important they are to Citizens for Prosperity’s operations, I wouldn’t be surprised if you had to fight your way through a bunch of their most fanatical followers first before you even get a shot at them. But remember [TargetName|Last] is your target, and payment hinges solely on you making sure they’re eliminated. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoTh.description:
XenoThreat recently hit a Headhunters' stronghold. I’ll spare you the details, but they did some truly heinous shit to our crew. We’ve identified the leader of the op as [TargetName] and are looking for a little payback. We don’t care what you do to get the job done. Only that [TargetName|Last] is dead. 

A source just told us that you can track down this XenoThreat scum over at [Location|Address]. This sicko’s a pro and never travels alone, so don’t expect taking them out to be a walk in the park.  

Stows out.

You fast? You deadly? You looking to make some serious creds? Then I got the race for you.

I'm talking a weapons free, old school scramble. Pilot a [RaceType|Short], collect checkpoints, steal points from the leader, and win big. Whoever gets enough points first is declared champion and gets a fat payout. 2nd and 3rd place even get prizes too.

The slimy little cretins over at Shipping Area have been selling us trash data all while trying to double deal. Can’t let it stand.

We want you to go teach them one final lesson and wipe out all the cowards you can find. Last I heard is they were holed up over near the Shipping Area. 

Spill their blood, and we’ll fill your wallet. 

-Bit Zeros

PU_Theft_Outpost_Pyro_CFP_vs_GenericOutl.description:
Hey,

We could use your help.

A local we work with was completing a delivery for us, but unfortunately, she ran into some outlaws and had to surrender her [Item]. Silver lining is the outlaws didn’t notice the trackers we placed in the cargo and now we know they’ve taken their haul to [Location|Address]. 

We’d like you to recover the packages for us and finish delivering them to [Destination|Address]. I don’t imagine the outlaws will give them up willingly, but I wouldn’t ask you to put yourself in harm’s way if these supplies weren’t of critical importance.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd suggest you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, what do you say?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

PU_Theft_Station_Pyro_XT_vs_CFP_Pyro6.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have entrenched themselves at [Pickup1|Address]. To keep them from getting too comfy at that station, we want to show them what life is really like in our system. We’ll pay you to hit the station, grab the [item], and kill anyone that gets in your way. 

Payment hinges on you delivering those supplies to [Dropoff1|Address]. Anyone you kill will just be a perk.     

Comm. Spec. Engler

Not sure if you’d had the pleasure of dealing with the Rough & Ready, but the gang is laser focused on cornering the fuel market in Pyro. Smart play, but one we can’t let happen without them providing us some concessions. Since they’re currently not interested in negotiating, we’re forced to show them what happens to those who oppose us.

We’ve identified [Pickup1|Address] as a prime target for such an attack. We also know they recently received some supplies that should be a fitting price for their obstinance. PU_MissingPerson_Pyro_RR_Pyro3_Danger.description:
After hearing rumors that we might’ve gotten a bad case of squatters over at [Location|Address], I had sent one of my more trusted people to investigate. 

Bad news is that I haven’t heard from them since. 

I’d like for you to head over and see if you can find [TargetName]’s current whereabouts.  I’ll leave it up to you how you want to deal with any scum you come across. 

Confirm where [TargetName|Last] is, and there’ll be a reward in it for you.

- Smokey

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_XenoThreat_Py.description:
Recent scans discovered several orbital sentries and ships at [location|address]. We believe they’re part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, in response to our recent actions in the Stanton system. Seems XenoThreat must be doing something right, if they’re out here spying like this.

We’re looking for an experienced and highly-skilled merc willing to eliminate this operation. If you don’t want Pyro to become a surveillance system, then this is your chance to stop it. The sentries probably won’t be too big of an issue, but pay mind to the patrol ships. If they manage to break away, you’ll have a whole lot more trouble breathing down your neck. 

You’ll have our gratitude and a sizable payment once the job is done. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

PU_EliminateSpecific_Caves_Pyro6.description:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader [TargetName] is holed up at [location|address] working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without [TargetName|Last] getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out [TargetName|Last], but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.  

Stows out.

TheCollector_Vehicle_Ground_ATLS_IKTI_GE.description:
Find very fun piece to add to big human suit that let you jump very high. Now you shoot and jump. Exciting.

If you want, bring me these to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4>. Will make.

Wikelo

PU_EliminateBoss_DC_Stanton_Lob_Abandone.description:
We’ve had our sights set on taking out [TargetName] for a while now, but we’ve never been able to find the right moment. Enough waiting. You’re going to create the right moment for us.

Head to Lobby and take out a bunch of lowlifes running around the Lobby. Kill enough of those losers, and [TargetName|Last] will have no choice but to come face you themselves. That’s when you take ‘em out and earn yourself a nice fat payday.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_Generic_P.description:
The Headhunters recently loaned credits to [TargetName] under some clear conditions. Specifically, pay us back or we’ll kill you. Wild to think that wasn’t enough of an incentive, but here we are past the payment deadline. Now as much as we like [TargetName|First], I need you to make good on our promise.

[TargetName|Last] was last seen at [Location|Address]. Track ‘em down, ghost ‘em, and get paid. It’s as simple as that. 

Stows out.

PU_MissingPerson_Cave_Pyro_CFP_Danger_Py.description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near [Location|Address] which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over [location|address].

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

PU_EliminateAll_Lawful_NoNonHostiles_Sta.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can quickly and safely assist us in the complete removal of illegal occupants who have temporarily gained control of [Location|Address].

Be aware that our intel shows there are civilian workers onsite. Since their connection with the gang is unclear, they should be considered non-combatants. Any hostile action towards them will not be tolerated. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Remove all hostile occupants found within the site; using force if necessary.
• Ensure the safety of any civilians who may be onsite. 

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

PU_RepairO2Kiosk.description:
Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.

Rayari_Rank2_Gems_Single_Carinite.description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hangar_Pyro_RR.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in [location|address]. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

PU_Defend_Lawful_Stanton3_M.description:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

One of the sites under BlacJac’s purview has been clashing with a few local outlaws. We would like you to head down to [Location|Address] and secure the site from these hostile threats.

From the early reports, I expect this will be a fairly straightforward matter, but if it makes you feel better, feel free to recruit a team to provide you with extra support.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_02.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

We have received word that Nicks Cantwell, long-time acquaintance and confident of Maltrox Arlington, was spotted trying to purchase a high-density mining laser, the kind frequently used in past ship-jacking attempts to strategically breach hulls. We have provided coordinates for Nicks’ last known location.  

Nicks is a highly regarded munitions expert among criminal circles and often leaves a path of destruction in his wake. It is advised to bring an increased level of firepower to this encounter.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:

PU_InvestigateDestroyship.description:
Been hunting down a particular parcel of data and right when I get a break the ship gets attacked by this converted Nine Tails Reclaimer called the Black Kite. I tried to hack into the servers on the Black Kite to see if they copied the data, but couldn't find a way to remotely get past their encryption protocols without the physical key.

That's where you come in. I need someone to breach their ship, get a hold of their decryption key, and decrypt the server so I can remotely pull down what I need.

You're smart enough to know who we're dealing with here, so plan accordingly. Since it's gonna ruffle some powerful feathers, let's not leave anything to chance. Destroy the Black Kite when you're done to cover both our asses.

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Pyro_CFP_Pyro6_Ea.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Hi,

I'm looking for someone to head to the Covalex Gundo station near Crusader and grab some items. I know this may sound like stealing, but it's my dad's stuff. You see, he was on Gundo station when it had its accident. My mom says that we need to wait until Covalex says so, but I don't think that's fair because I miss him so much. I would like something to remember him by and I don't want to wait any longer because I might start forgetting things. I'll pay you to get box 510 for me and take to [Destination] so I can have it.

Thank you very much,
Baylor Ward

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton3_Legal.description:
ATTN: Mercenaries with Cargo Handling Experience

Nine Tails are currently assaulting one of our facilities at [Location|address]. As they just received a delivery of confidential materials, we don’t believe this is a coincidence. BlacJac needs someone to hurry to the location and secure these important boxes before the Nine Tails do. You are authorized to use lethal force against any who attempt to stop you. 

As part of our standard security protocol, the confidential materials were integrated into another consignment and secured in the automated vault. You’ll need to find the relevant retrieval codes for the confidential materials and enter it at the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. Retrieval codes are stored locally on datapads and only given to high-ranking staff. Hopefully they’re alive to help you, but considering the complete comms blackout, we fear that’s not the case. There's a chance Nine Tails have already gotten their hands on the datapads.  

Once you’ve gathered all the confidential materials, they will need to be delivered to [dropoff1|address]. Payment is contingent upon their delivery.


Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

HexPenetrator_Comm_1.description:
One of the suspects captured during the recent attacks revealed that XenoThreat is looking to remotely access a number of comm arrays around the system.

Having XenoThreat listening into comms is extremely dangerous for the people living here, so the CDF has been enlisted to reset the comm array, then defend it from any XenoThreat Vanguards that will attempt to reconnect to the servers. 

Once those Vanguards have been defeated, clear out any remaining hostile ships in the area.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_EliminateBoss_Lawful_Stanton2_Floatin.description:

Once on site, you will need to deplete the Nine Tails forces until you are able to draw out [TargetName].

Considering the brutality deployed by Nine Tails during their recent siege, we recommend that contractors be prepared to use force and strongly encourage them to consider bringing back-up.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

PU_BlockadeRunner.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

A hostile fleet of ships equipped with quantum jammers have created a blockade around  [Location|address], disabled the station's defensive turrets, and stolen a large supply of Zeta-Prolanide. In response, the CDF has received authorization to activate its volunteer force. 

Though the overall situation is dire, the theft of the Zeta-Prolanide is our priority. Without direct action, the loss of the sector's Zeta-Prolanide stores could have a devastating effects to the wider economy of the whole system. 

While local security forces are investigating the incursion, they've tracked the stolen inventory to several locations. CDF volunteers are tasked with heading to these locations, recovering the stolen Zeta-Prolanide, and transferring it back to the station before the material completely degrades and is no longer viable. Just be careful, intel suggests that larger clusters of Zeta-Prolanide have a higher outlaw presence.

Since time is of the essence, having a tractor beam to assist in moving the cargo is highly advised.

As an added incentive, volunteers will receive regular bonus payments for their combined efforts.

Complete this contract and the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell,  Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.

Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you and a team of your choosing could deliver the needed supplies to<EM4> Pyro Gateway. </EM4>We have arranged shipment to Pyro from there.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to procure and refine the resources, but Daymar or Aberdeen might be good places to start mining.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Tutorial01_Basics_Area18.description:
Congratulations on taking your first steps into the universe!

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space. 

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
Recently made an interesting discovery that someone set up a handful of orbital sentries at [location|address]. Guess they’re trying to grab some info about our operations there. They even have a few ships guarding to make sure nothing happens to them. 

Of course, we want these bastards gone, but I’m worried that getting rid of it ourselves would be bad for business. That’s why we’re looking for a little ‘plausible deniability’. Someone from outside of R&R to eliminate the problem, so whoever is behind it can’t directly tie the attack back to us. I know this won’t be a walk in the park, especially with those guards lurking. Who knows how many reinforcements they have at the ready? But if you manage to get it done, we’re prepared to see you paid right. 

Think you’ve got the skills to pull this off? 

- Smokey

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_HeadHunters_vs_XenoTh.description:
Headhunters got word there’s a XenoThreat op in the works that's targeting one of our crews. We don’t have precise details about the plan but we know that [TargetName] is organizing it. Instead of sitting back and waiting for something to happen, we’ve decided to be proactive. 

[TargetName|Last] was just spotted with others around [Location|Address]. We can’t mobilize anyone fast enough to get there. I want you to rush there and deliver a preemptive strike.   

Stows out.

The CDF has partnered with Anvil Aerospace to find the most capable operatives in the system. 

If you find one of these Platinum certifications, you can redeem the ticket at a ship kiosk at New Deal, Astro Armada or Crusader Showroom for a free F8C.

Whoever makes it will not only receive this next generation superiority fighter, but also prove that they have what it takes for the toughest CDF assignments.

Good luck.

HexPenetrator_DataHeist_3.description:
We've received tips that XenoThreat's intending to launch another attack on Stanton system. The CDF has petitioned the Advocacy to create a new initiative called Operation Overdrive to stop this attack before it happens. 

The CDF is dispatching volunteers to infiltrate and obtain any intel that could give insight into what they're planning. Needless to say, expect heavy resistance from any XenoThreat on site.

As an added incentive, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

PU_RemoveClaimJumpers_Pyro_RoughAndReady.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at [location|address] where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.      

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it. 

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us. 

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.     

- Smokey

Wikelo recently get many blueprints in trade with human who not very smart. Now can make very big ship. 

Not cheap and need many pieces but will make. If you want, go quick, this cost much to Wikelo so won't be able to do for long but I like new Human system so I want to thank you all for welcome.

Bye.

PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_NoNonHostiles.description:
A senior security official by the name of [TargetName] has been marked for termination. While they can be found at [Location|Address], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

Normally, I would recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. However, in this instance a more delicate touch is required. While you should feel free to eliminate any and all of the security forces on site, you must ensure the safety of all the civilian workers there.

Tiresome for sure, but a requirement none the less. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_NTLockdown_FleetDestroy_Antagonist_L4.description:
Now that Crusader’s found their fleet, it seems the Nine Tails finally realized just how useful a bit of extra help can be.

Long story short, they’re looking for some hired muscle to keep Crusader at bay. You’ll and everyone else who volunteers get a payout for every security ship you take down. 

And on top of that, if all of you keep Crusader occupied long enough for the Nine Tails to finish up whatever the hell it is that they’re up to with this quantum blockade, you’ll get a big fat bonus.

PU_Bounty_PVE_Pyro_RoughAndReady_Cargo_P.description:
My associates and I brokered a deal with a hauler named [TargetName] to deliver supplies to us. Funny thing is the shipment never showed up. They claimed pirates raided their ship and took our supplies, but it turns out that story’s 100% ranta dung.

Lying to back out of our deal can’t go unanswered and you’re going to make that message abundantly clear. [TargetName|Last] was recently seen with an escort at [Location|Address]. As long as you kill [TargetName|Last], we don’t care what happens to the cargo they’re hauling. 

- Smokey

PU_EliminateSpecific_Lawful_Stanton4_Int.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is in need of new qualified bounty hunters to expand our existing roster. To evaluate your skills, we would like you to assist us in the apprehension of [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

PU_HijackedShip_Caterpillar_Stanton3_Pac.description:
Here’s the deal - A couple of long timers got snagged pulling a job for me and I want you to spring them. 

A friendly mechanic has arranged for their prison transport to run into some trouble en route, venting the front door and bringing the ship to a halt. You’re gonna go, dispatch any security escorting the transport, find the prisoner manifest aboard, and use it to locate my crew’s cryopods.

The popsicles I’m after are [NameSave2], [NameKill1], [NameSave3], and [NameSave1]. All have been loyal and deserve better than rotting in jail.

At least I think they've been loyal... I'm still wondering how they got pinched in the first place. I can't shake the feeling that one of them may have been doubling dealing. Tell you what, if you find any proof that one of my crew has been working with the Advocacy, liquidate their cryopod and I’ll see you get a bonus. 

Once you've activated the right pods and my people are starting to thaw, get the hell out of there and let the retrieval team handle the rest. This last bit is important. See, once they’re defrosted, they're gonna be sent off to retirement. No sense in them knowing any more about my business than they already do, i.e. I don’t want these lunks seeing your face or even knowing you exist. 

Once you’re back on your way, I’ll send you a hefty pile of well deserved creds.

Now just in case you’re getting any ideas along the lines of “Why don’t I just free everyone?” or “Wouldn’t it be easier to shut them all up permanently?” Forget it. The politics of this whole thing is more complicated than you need to know. Just trust me when I say that if any extra prisoners get freed or die without me ordering it, you’ll be the one who pays. Want all your money? Do what you’re told and that’s it. 

-Twitch

TheCollector_Vehicle_Medium_ZeusCL.description: Wikelo can make new version of cargo Zeus ship. If you want, bring what needed, then you can have ship. Fair. Bye.

PU_Assassination_SyncedAssassination_Sta.description:
[TargetName] and [TargetName2].

Two serious operators who've recently decided to make a move against their boss. Each of the pair are traveling with a small, highly trained armada and cutting deep into territory that doesn't belong to them.

You, and whoever you recruit to help, are going to take them out and it has to be both at the same time so they can't regroup.

PU_SalvageContractor_Lawless.description:
Fortune has shined upon us once again. I’ve just learned of a battle near [Location] that’s just transpired far from the prying eyes of any meddlesome comm arrays, and reinforcements from either of the forces involved have yet to be dispatched. This means that there is a window of opportunity for an enterprising soul to pick the graveyard clean.
 
I’d like to extend this opportunity to all my trusted contacts. Any and all interested parties can have the location… for the right price. Coordinates will be provided once you accept the contract and will remain available until you choose to terminate it.

Of course, speed will be of the essence as you will not only face potential competition from other salvagers, but also the looming possibility of reinforcements arriving to survey the battlefield. 

If you’re still hesitating, just remember, fortune favors the bold.

-cd

PU_EliminateBoss_Unlawful_Stanton1.description:
A senior security official by the name of [TargetName] is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at [Location|Address], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

PU_Delivery_Local_DerelictOutposts_Deliv.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for some important packages that were stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to different derelict outposts. We need you to head there and recover the packages. You'll be able to ID them by their serial numbers: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>, <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> and <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the packages, fly them back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for the  cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Packages <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>, <EM4>#[Item2|SerialNumber]</EM4> and <EM4>#[Item3|SerialNumber]</EM4> from <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

PU_Bounty_PVE_Family_OpenToAll.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = Miles Eckhart

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

It appears that second time's the charm for the Arlington gang. After one failed attempt, the recently escaped criminal family has managed to boost an Idris from a repair yard. Now we know what the mining laser and biometrics they stole were for. 

Since we had such success capturing them the first time, Eckhart Security has been granted the warrant for the gang’s arrest. This is going to take considerable firepower to bring down a capital ship of this ability.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to track down the Idris and neutralize the gang.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract and will be adjusted based on the final evaluation of you and your team's combat effectiveness rating. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

PU_EliminateAll_Stations_Hatch_Pyro_RR_H.description:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over [location|address].

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

PU_RetrieveConsignment_Stanton2_Illegal_.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that [location|address] received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.
